filings.headline: Promoter bought 0.20% (₹11.7cr) at about ₹123
filings.summary: Promoter Fairbridge Capital Mauritius Limited bought a 0.20% stake in the company through market purchases for ₹11.7cr at an average price of ₹123, compared to the current price of ₹135. This purchase increased their holding from 65.2% to 65.4%.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter bought 0.20% stake through open market purchases.

filings.headline: Promoter bought 3.1% (₹42.1cr) at about ₹55.0
filings.summary: Promoter Minda Capital Private Limited acquired a 3.1% stake in the company for ₹42.1 crore via allotment, raising its holding from 15.6% to 18.7%. The shares were acquired at an average price of ₹55.0, compared to the current market price of ₹709.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter acquired 3.1% stake via allotment.

filings.headline: JV with Grammer AG extended 3 yrs; Rs120.73cr business plan (related-party)
filings.summary: Ceinsys and Grammer AG signed a 6th amendment extending their JV via Allygram Systems (70:30) for 3 years from Apr 2027 to Mar 2030, with estimated business volume of Rs 120.73cr (EUR 11.9mn). The deal falls within related-party transactions, to be done at arm's length. Size is about 18% of yearly sales of ~Rs658cr spread over three years; company says no material impact or change in control.
filings.impactWhy: Routine JV extension; deal size spread over three years is small.

filings.headline: Omnitech wins BrahMos development order for airframe & canister components
filings.summary: Omnitech Engineering received a Development Order from BrahMos Aerospace for assemblies/sub-assemblies of metallic airframe components and canister subsystems. No order value was disclosed, and the company says it does not meet SEBI materiality thresholds, filing it as a voluntary update. Still, entering the BrahMos defence supply chain opens a potential new aerospace/defence business line against FY sales of ~₹626cr.
filings.impactWhy: Development order with undisclosed value; SEBI materiality threshold not met.

filings.headline: Won LOA for 120 MWp turnkey solar EPC project, due FY2027-28
filings.summary: Waaree Renewables received a Letter of Award from a domestic private company for a turnkey project covering module supply and EPC works totalling 120 MWp. The project is to be completed in FY2027-28. The filing gives no contract value, only the 120 MWp size, so rupee impact against yearly sales of ₹3935cr cannot be quantified.
filings.impactWhy: Order value is not disclosed; cannot determine financial materiality.

filings.headline: GST dept initiates section 67 investigation visit at Maharashtra office & plant
filings.summary: Maharashtra State GST Department conducted an investigation visit under Section 67 of the CGST/MGST Act, 2017 at Apar's corporate office and a Maharashtra manufacturing unit on November 26, 2026. The company says it is co-operating and that the visit has no impact on financials or operations, with no violation yet specified. A Section 67 search-type investigation is a red flag worth monitoring for any subsequent demand or order.
filings.impactWhy: GST search visit initiated; no demand or adverse outcome specified yet.

filings.headline: Court continues attachment of company properties over ₹8.27cr guarantee claim
filings.summary: UC Inclusive Credit's Section 9 application over an alleged ₹5cr corporate guarantee (disputed, linked to unauthorised transactions by Mr. Ramakant Pilani) led the Bengaluru Civil Court on Nov 25, 2026 to continue a conditional attachment of certain company properties and direct GBL to show cause why it should not furnish security of ₹8.27cr. The claim is about 1.8% of ₹465cr yearly sales; the company says expected financial implications are 'None' and merits are kept open. Matter is next listed Dec 4, 2026, with asset attachment a live risk.
filings.impactWhy: Disputed claim of ₹8.27cr is small relative to annual sales.

filings.headline: JV Kairav buys 9.57-acre Chennai land; ₹1,100cr sales potential
filings.summary: Kairav Developers, a JV of Ashiana Housing and Arihant Foundations, bought 9.57 acres off ECR at Thiruporur, Chengalpattu (Chennai) on outright purchase basis. The land will host a senior living project with ~9 lakh sq ft saleable area and sales potential of ~₹1,100cr, close to annual sales of ₹1,368cr. Adds a sizeable new project pipeline, though revenue will accrue over the build-out period.
filings.impactWhy: Routine land acquisition for senior living project pipeline.

filings.headline: EGM to approve ₹1,200cr related-party deals with subsidiary GFCL EV
filings.summary: Gujarat Fluorochemicals called an EGM on 22 Dec 2026 to approve material related-party transactions with material subsidiary GFCL EV Products Limited totalling ₹1,200cr for FY2026-27/27-28. This includes ₹600cr investment in securities, ₹290cr in preference shares, and ₹310cr of goods/services. The total is about 20% of ₹5,853cr yearly sales, a sizeable related-party exposure to watch.
filings.impactWhy: Shareholder approval for related-party transactions with material subsidiary.

filings.headline: Wins trial order for Steel Tyre Cord from another reputed tyre maker
filings.summary: Bansal Wire received a trial purchase order for its Steel Tyre Cord product from another reputed tyre manufacturer after sample evaluation. The company calls it significant as it expands its customer base and moves it a step closer to commercialisation. No order value or financial figures are disclosed, and only commercial follow-on orders would have measurable impact.
filings.impactWhy: Trial purchase order with no disclosed order value.

filings.headline: CCL project to add ₹2,000cr+ revenue by FY29; first line starts Feb 2027
filings.summary: Ratnaveer gave projections for its new Copper Clad Laminate business, one of India's first integrated CCL plants, with ₹338cr investment and five production lines (79.2 lakh sheets/yr) starting Feb 2027 through June 2028. CCL revenue is targeted at ₹49.5cr (FY27), ₹653.4cr (FY28) and ₹2,004.75cr (FY29) at ~25.9% EBITDA margin, lifting consolidated revenue to ₹3,914cr and EBITDA to ₹775cr by FY29 versus ₹1,220cr current sales. The company says it has secured orders for ~50% of planned CCL capacity and ECMS capex subsidy approval, marking a major new business line and sharp guidance uplift.
filings.impactWhy: Long-term multi-year project revenue projections rather than formal guidance revision.

filings.headline: Haridwar plant capacity expansion's first channel completed, operations started
filings.summary: SKF India completed the first channel of its capacity expansion at the Haridwar Plant, with the facility inaugurated and operations commencing on 26 November 2026. This follows its 03 November 2026 board disclosure on the expansion. A capacity start is positive for future output, though the filing gives no investment figure or added capacity numbers.
filings.impactWhy: Routine operational start of capacity expansion with unstated size.

filings.headline: Urban Company enters AC category with Native AC, priced from ₹55,499
filings.summary: Urban Company is launching residential air conditioners (Native Ultra and Ultra Air) under its Native brand, with pre-bookings from November 26, 2026 on its app, priced from ₹55,499 and backed by a 5-year unconditional warranty including gas refills plus a 10-year compressor warranty. This marks entry into a new consumer-durables business line, extending beyond its services platform. It diversifies revenue but financial impact and scale are not yet quantified against last 12 months' sales of about ₹1,874cr.
filings.impactWhy: Product launch into ACs; revenue impact is not quantified.

filings.headline: Patel Engineering L1 for ₹1,441cr 144MW Gongri hydro project (own SPV)
filings.summary: Patel Engineering declared lowest bidder (L1) by its wholly owned subsidiary Dirang Energy Pvt Ltd for the 144 MW Gongri Hydro Electric Project in Arunachal Pradesh, valued at ₹1,441.04cr (incl. GST), to be executed over 48 months. That is about 28% of last 12 months' sales of ₹5,152cr, a sizeable addition to the order book. Note it is a related-party transaction, awarded by a group SPV on arm's length basis, so it is effectively building a group asset on BOOT basis.
filings.impactWhy: Order is from wholly owned subsidiary for internal group asset.

filings.headline: Zaggle signs 5-year deal to provide Zaggle Save to Infosys
filings.summary: Zaggle entered a 5-year agreement with Infosys Limited on November 25, 2026 to provide its Zaggle Save employee expense management and benefits platform. The contract value is not quantifiable as fees depend on active user count and user spends. A marquee domestic client win within the company's core SaaS business, though the financial size was not disclosed.
filings.impactWhy: Client agreement without quantifiable financial terms or contract value.

filings.headline: CARE upgrades RACL Geartech rating to CARE A/A1 from CARE A-/A2+
filings.summary: CARE Ratings upgraded RACL Geartech's long-term bank facilities to CARE A; Stable from CARE A-; Positive, and short-term facilities to CARE A1 from CARE A2+. Rated facilities were also enhanced, with total limits rising (long-term enhanced to ₹150.94cr from ₹101.88cr; LT/ST to ₹201.50cr from ₹162.50cr). The upgrade reflects improved operational and financial performance for FY26 and H1FY27, lowering borrowing risk.
filings.impactWhy: Credit rating upgraded to CARE A/A1 from CARE A-/A2+.

filings.headline: Unimech to buy 76% of Aurai Technologies; ₹45cr entry into surface engineering
filings.summary: Subsidiary Hobel Bellows, with Innomech, will acquire a 76% stake in Visakhapatnam-based Aurai Technologies, making it a step-down subsidiary, via a ~₹45.0cr investment (~₹16.2cr equity, rest debt). The deal marks Unimech's entry into a new business line of advanced surface engineering, electroplating and metal finishing. Total outlay is ~13% of ₹347cr yearly sales and opens an adjacent value-added segment.
filings.impactWhy: Acquisition outlay of ₹45cr is not large for market cap.

filings.headline: Step-down arm Ascent to invest ~₹500cr in Tamil Nadu PCB expansion over 5 yrs
filings.summary: Ascent Circuits (WoS of material subsidiary IL JIN, step-down subsidiary of Amber) signed an MoU with Guidance, Govt of Tamil Nadu, for an expansion investment of about ₹500cr over five years from 2027. The capex aims to strengthen its Bare PCB manufacturing capabilities and expand footprint. The amount is roughly 3.7% of Amber's ₹13,606cr yearly sales and ~2% of market value, supporting growth in a key electronics component line.
filings.impactWhy: Routine MoU for ₹500cr capex spread over five years.

filings.headline: HFL to invest ~₹100cr in new Tamil Nadu greenfield home-care plant
filings.summary: Hindustan Foods announced a ~₹100 crore greenfield investment for a Home Care Liquid products facility in Tamil Nadu, on top of ₹400 crore of ongoing investments from Q2 FY27. Gross block is expected to rise from ₹1,961 crore (Sep 2026) to ₹2,447 crore by next financial year. The ₹100cr capex is about 2.2% of yearly sales of ₹4,628 crore, expanding capacity in an existing category.
filings.impactWhy: Capex of ₹100cr is small relative to annual sales.

filings.headline: USFDA closes Unit VII inspection with VAI classification
filings.summary: Shilpa Medicare received the USFDA Establishment Inspection Report for its Unit VII Analytical Services Division, Hyderabad, with a Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classification, and the surveillance inspection (16-18 Sept 2026) is now closed. Closure removes regulatory overhang on this US-facing site, though VAI indicates minor observations rather than a fully clean (NAI) outcome.
filings.impactWhy: US FDA EIR received closing inspection with VAI classification.

filings.headline: Interim CFO Prashant Pai steps down; Anand Sharma appointed CFO w.e.f. Nov 26, 2026
filings.summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films appointed Mr. Anand H. Sharma as Chief Financial Officer and KMP effective November 26, 2026; consequently interim CFO Mr. Prashant L. Pai ceases from the same date. Sharma is a Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary and Cost & Management Accountant with over 25 years' experience in finance, M&A, QIP/debt fundraising and compliance. A CFO change is material governance news, though this is an orderly transition from an interim to a permanent CFO.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of new Chief Financial Officer.

filings.headline: L1 bidder for ₹463.57cr Gujarat Wire Free City Scheme; order book over ₹2,000cr
filings.summary: Viviana Power Tech received L1 (lowest bidder) confirmation for a ₹463.57cr project from Pashchim Gujarat Vij Company for the Gujarat Wire Free City Scheme. The amount equals about 74% of yearly sales (~₹630cr), a very large potential win, and takes total unexecuted order book to over ₹2,000cr. Formal details await the Letter of Intent.
filings.impactWhy: L1 win valued at ₹463.57cr is ~74% of annual sales.

filings.headline: Preferential issue: 1.7L warrants at ₹412 to non-promoter Pooja Kohli
filings.summary: Board allotted 1,70,000 convertible warrants on preferential basis to non-promoter Mrs. Pooja Kohli at ₹412 each (₹10 face value + ₹402 premium), total ₹7.0cr, with 25% (₹1.75cr) received upfront; convertible within 18 months. The issue price of ₹412 is a premium to the current price of about ₹307.7. On the ~1.78cr share base, full conversion adds ~0.96% more shares, diluting existing holders by about 0.95%.
filings.impactWhy: Preferential warrant issue results in under 1% equity dilution.

filings.headline: Completed acquisition of 70% stake in Heidelco Medicore Pvt Ltd
filings.summary: Q-Line Biotech has completed the acquisition of 70% of the paid-up share capital of Heidelco Medicore Private Limited, which became a subsidiary with effect from November 26, 2026. The filing gives no consideration or financial figures, but an acquisition expanding the group is worth noting against ₹711cr yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Acquisition lacks financial details; no significant scale shown.

filings.headline: Promoter pledged 0.52% of shares (₹7.0cr)
filings.summary: Promoter and Director Ashish Subhash Dandekar pledged 10,00,000 shares (0.52% of the company) valued at ₹7.0cr as security to lenders at an average price of ₹69.6, compared to the current price of ₹68.9. His total holding remains unchanged at 10.3% before and after the pledge.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter created a new share pledge.

filings.headline: Juniper's arm signs 150 MW hybrid PPA with NTPC, ~₹155cr annual revenue
filings.summary: Wholly owned subsidiary Juniper Green Gem signed a 25-year Power Purchase Agreement with NTPC for a 150 MW Wind-Solar Hybrid project, with supply starting by June 30, 2028. Expected annual revenue is ~₹155cr, about 16% of the company's ₹995cr yearly sales, adding long-term recurring revenue.
filings.impactWhy: PPA contract accounts for ~16% of annual revenue.

filings.headline: Wins Rs 523cr APTRANSCO order for 95 power transformers (4,750 MVA)
filings.summary: Atlanta Electricals secured a Rs 523.21 crore order (net of GST) from APTRANSCO for 95 units of 50 MVA, 132/33 kV power transformers, totalling 4,750 MVA. The order equals about 25% of last 12 months' sales of ₹2076cr, adding strong revenue visibility, with deliveries to start within eight months. It builds on an earlier ~Rs 270 crore APTRANSCO order, deepening ties with a major state transmission utility.
filings.impactWhy: Order win equals 25% of annual sales.

filings.headline: Promoter group bought 0.19% (about ₹16.5cr) at ~₹258-260
filings.summary: Two promoter-group entities bought HEG Advanced Materials shares on 25-Nov-2026: LNJ Leasing and Finance acquired 3,48,000 shares (~₹8.98cr at ~₹258) and Redrose Vanijya LLP acquired 2,90,860 shares (~₹7.57cr at ~₹260), taking Redrose to 28.48% (from 28.40%). Combined promoter-group buying is 6,38,860 shares, roughly 0.19% of equity worth about ₹16.5cr. Promoter purchases at near current market price signal insider confidence.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter group purchased equity shares from open market.

filings.headline: Polystyrene capacity raised 66 KT to 100 KT; further expansion delayed
filings.summary: Styrenix completed debottlenecking to lift annual Polystyrene capacity from 66 KT to 100 KT, while ABS expansion continues. However, citing market conditions and demand outlook, it has decided to delay further Polystyrene expansion as it deems 100 KT sufficient for foreseeable needs. The realised capacity add is positive, but the deferral signals cautious demand expectations.
filings.impactWhy: Debottlenecking completed but future expansion deferred; mixed operational update.

filings.headline: Material subsidiary Odyssey Logistics enters defence and automotive logistics
filings.summary: Odyssey Logistics Private Limited, a material subsidiary of Skyways Air Services, will expand into Defence Logistics and Automotive Logistics, offering multimodal supply chain services tailored to defence equipment and automotive OEMs. The move opens new business lines leveraging the parent's global network and airline partnerships. No financial figures or investment amounts were disclosed.
filings.impactWhy: New logistics verticals announced without any disclosed financial commitment or revenue.

filings.headline: Zydus gets USFDA EIR for API Unit-2 plant at Ankleshwar
filings.summary: Zydus received an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) from the USFDA for its API Unit-2 manufacturing plant at Ankleshwar, following an inspection held from 19-23 January 2026. The EIR signals closure of the inspection with a clean outcome, keeping the facility clear for US-bound supplies. This supports continued US market access for the company's API business.
filings.impactWhy: Routine USFDA EIR inspection closure for single API facility.

filings.headline: GST search u/s 67 at Aurangabad units concluded; company sees no material impact
filings.summary: A GST inspection/search under Section 67 of the Maharashtra GST Act at Cosmo First's Aurangabad manufacturing units concluded on November 24, 2026. The company says it cooperated fully, operations continued as usual, and there is no material impact on financials or business. Because this involves a search proceeding rather than a routine notice, it warrants monitoring, though no demand or penalty figure has been disclosed.
filings.impactWhy: GST search concluded with no demand, penalty, or material financial impact.

filings.headline: Subsidiary Venwind bags order to supply WTGs & execute 153.7 MW wind project
filings.summary: Venwind Refex Power (a subsidiary) signed a Term Sheet with Purvah Green Power (a CESC subsidiary) to supply WTGs and Tubular Towers and execute 153.7 MW of wind projects in Madhya Pradesh, to be completed in ~24 months. The filing gives no order value, but a 153.7 MW end-to-end wind supply-and-execution contract is a large, multi-year order against yearly sales of ₹3187cr and builds the group's wind-power business.
filings.impactWhy: Term sheet signed without any disclosed contract value.

filings.headline: Beta gets Mexico COFEPRIS nod for 48 oncology formulations, sales from FY27
filings.summary: Beta Drugs received COFEPRIS certification from Mexico's Level IV regulator for 48 oncology formulations (injectables, oral solids and suspensions), with sales to begin from FY ending 2027. It opens access to Mexico's ~USD 3.5bn oncology market, growing at ~10-11% CAGR, a meaningful new export avenue against yearly sales of ~₹444cr. Marks entry into a new regulated market, supporting future growth.
filings.impactWhy: Regulatory approvals obtained with revenue expected only from FY27.

filings.headline: Craftsman inaugurates Phase II of Kothavadi plant in Coimbatore
filings.summary: Phase II of the Company's Kothavadi manufacturing facility at Coimbatore was virtually inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu. This marks a new capacity coming on stream, which can support future revenue growth. The filing gives no capex figure or added-capacity numbers.
filings.impactWhy: Plant phase inaugurated without quantified capex or capacity additions.

filings.headline: Bikaji enters premium bakery with Mahè under Bikaji Bakes, new category
filings.summary: Bikaji is entering the premium/commercial bakery and foodservice segment via subsidiary Bikaji Bakes, launching European-inspired brand Mahè in partnership with Master Baker T K Khaleel, supported by a new manufacturing facility in Karnataka. This marks a strategic diversification into a new food category beyond its core ethnic snacks. The filing gives no investment size or financial figures, so near-term impact is unquantified.
filings.impactWhy: New product segment entry without disclosed financial details or scale.

filings.headline: Capacity up 245m pieces/yr; total ~1,114m condoms, ₹75cr investment
filings.summary: Anondita installed 4 self-fabricated dipping lines adding 245 million pieces/annum of male latex condom capacity at its Noida unit, certified by a Chartered Engineer on Nov 21, 2026. This lifts total capacity to ~1,114 million pieces per annum, backed by ₹75cr of investment (debt/internal accruals), sizeable against FY sales of ~₹257cr. Current utilisation stands at 432.13m pieces (80.67%), so the expansion targets rising demand.
filings.impactWhy: Incremental capacity expansion without immediate major revenue visibility.

filings.headline: Sells 26% of semiconductor subsidiary to Japan's Restar for ₹28.1cr
filings.summary: Rashi Peripherals executed Share Purchase and Shareholders' Agreements to sell 26% of its wholly owned subsidiary Rashi Semiconductor Solutions Pvt Ltd to Restar Corporation, Japan for ₹28.08cr, closing before Dec 7, 2026. The subsidiary was only incorporated in May 2026 and contributed no revenue in FY25-26, so the consideration is small versus ₹19,806cr sales, but the deal brings a strategic Japanese partner into a new semiconductor business with a 5-year lock-in, board nominee rights and mutual non-compete.
filings.impactWhy: Stake sale consideration of ₹28.1cr is negligible vs ₹19,806cr sales.

filings.headline: Postal ballot to approve 50+ material related-party transactions with subsidiaries
filings.summary: Clean Max is seeking shareholder approval via postal ballot for over 55 material related-party transactions with subsidiaries, step-down subsidiaries and fellow subsidiaries. No transaction values are disclosed in the available text. The large number of RPTs warrants scrutiny, though these are largely intra-group deals.
filings.impactWhy: Routine shareholder approval for internal subsidiary related-party transactions.

filings.headline: GST search u/s 67 at registered office concluded; company says no material impact
filings.summary: A GST inspection/search under Section 67 of the Maharashtra GST Act began on 19 Nov 2026 at the registered office and concluded on 24 Nov 2026 at 8:30pm. The company says it cooperated fully and sees no impact on financials or operations, with no demand figure disclosed. A tax search/seizure is inherently material regardless of stated impact, as findings or demands could follow.
filings.impactWhy: GST search concluded with no financial demand or material impact disclosed.

filings.headline: Shadowfax to acquire WeFast for ₹23.3cr, entering intra-city goods logistics
filings.summary: Shadowfax is acquiring WeFast (Borzo India) for ₹23.3 crore, marking its entry into on-demand intra-city goods transportation, a new business line serving SMEs and C2C users. WeFast runs in 5+ cities with 32k+ delivery partners, 1.2cr+ annual deliveries and about ₹200cr adjusted revenue in CY2025. The consideration is tiny versus Shadowfax's ₹5293cr yearly sales, but it opens a new growth engine adjacent to its hyperlocal business (up 87.7% YoY to ₹341cr in Q2 FY27).
filings.impactWhy: Acquisition size of ₹23.3cr is immaterial relative to ₹5,293cr sales.

filings.headline: USFDA final approval for Bosutinib 400mg; US$246m market (CML drug)
filings.summary: Alembic received USFDA final approval for its sANDA for Bosutinib Tablets 400mg, a kinase inhibitor for Ph+ chronic myelogenous leukemia, therapeutically equivalent to Bosulif. The 400mg strength has an estimated US market of US$246 million (about ₹2,050cr) for the twelve months ended Sept 2026, roughly 24% of yearly sales, though that is the total market not Alembic's share. This is the company's 248th cumulative ANDA approval (230 final, 18 tentative) and complements its already-launched 100mg and 500mg strengths.
filings.impactWhy: Routine generic ANDA approval with no exclusivity stated.

filings.headline: GST search u/s 67 concluded; paid ₹8.05cr GST plus interest
filings.summary: Maharashtra GST Department's inspection/search u/s 67 at IG Petrochem's premises concluded on 24 Nov 2026. The company says no default or suppression is attributable to it, but it paid GST liability including interest of ₹8.05cr (about 0.3% of ₹2366cr yearly sales). A search action makes this worth flagging despite the small amount.
filings.impactWhy: GST liability payment of ₹8.05cr is immaterial for ₹2,366cr sales.

filings.headline: Carysil signs framework sink-supply deal with German premium retailer for EU/Swiss market
filings.summary: Carysil and subsidiary Carysilnox signed a long-term Framework Supply Agreement with a Germany-based bathroom/kitchen/lighting retailer to supply 11 SKUs of composite (quartz) and stainless steel sinks for the EU and Switzerland under a leading international premium brand, on DAP basis against purchase orders. No contract value is given (depends on actual orders), but the company says the customer could become a top-ten customer in the medium term and top-five in the long term, opening a significant new premium European channel. Terminable by either party with 12 months' notice.
filings.impactWhy: Framework supply agreement without committed order values.

filings.headline: Brigade clocks ₹1,600cr sales in launch weekend at Brigade Autograph township
filings.summary: Brigade Group recorded ₹1,600 crores in sales during the launch weekend of Floris, the first residential phase of Brigade Autograph, a 40-acre mixed-use township in East Bengaluru (JV with Krishna Priya Estates). The weekend sales equal about 30% of last 12 months' revenue of ₹5,345cr, a strong demand signal. The overall township has a GDV of about ₹12,000 crores across ~8 million sq. ft., to be launched in phases, with future phases now being advanced.
filings.impactWhy: Launch weekend sales of ₹1,600cr equal 30% of annual revenue.

filings.headline: EPFO raises ₹180.65cr demand on surrendered PF exemption; firm to contest
filings.summary: EPFO's Regional PF Commissioner issued a letter dated Nov 10, 2026 demanding ₹180.65cr over IL&FS/DHFL investment losses, bond-sale losses, use of Trust reserves (FY19-FY22) and amounts receivable from employees of the erstwhile TeamLease EPF Trust. The sum is ~11% of the ₹1586cr market value (≈1.5% of ₹12026cr sales); the company deems it untenable, having funded the shortfall at surrender, and is weighing a writ petition. Financial impact will depend on the outcome of those proceedings.
filings.impactWhy: EPFO demand of ₹180.65cr represents 11% of company's market cap.

filings.headline: GST dept begins search & seizure at wholly-owned arm Turtlemint Insurance Broking
filings.summary: GST Department, Maharashtra initiated inspection, search and seizure under Section 67 of the Maharashtra GST Act on November 23, 2026 at the premises of wholly-owned subsidiary Turtlemint Insurance Broking Services (TIB). The company says operations remain unaffected and the financial impact is not currently quantifiable as proceedings are ongoing. A search-and-seizure action is material regardless of size, and the outcome bears watching.
filings.impactWhy: Search action ongoing with financial impact unquantified.

filings.headline: USFDA closes VSEZ oncology facility inspection as 'No Action Indicated' (clean)
filings.summary: Gland Pharma received the EIR from USFDA for its VSEZ Sterile Oncology Formulations and API facility at Visakhapatnam, classifying the August 24–September 1, 2026 GMP inspection as 'No Action Indicated' (NAI), the best possible outcome. A clean USFDA close-out removes regulatory overhang and supports uninterrupted US supplies, important given the company's export-heavy CDMO model.
filings.impactWhy: Clean USFDA EIR (NAI) removes regulatory overhang for sterile oncology plant.

filings.headline: Clean Max sells 26% of Gujarat SPV to GACL; to invest up to ₹214cr
filings.summary: Board approved selling 2,600 shares (26%) of newly incorporated SPV Clean Max Gangotri to Gujarat Alkalies & Chemicals for a nominal ₹26,000, plus a Shareholders' Agreement under which Clean Max will subscribe equity of up to ₹214.49cr to build wind-solar hybrid capacity in Gujarat (retaining 74%). The ₹214.49cr commitment is about 8.5% of yearly sales of ₹2539cr. It is a related-party transaction done on an arm's-length basis, bringing in a strategic partner for new renewable capacity.
filings.impactWhy: Minor SPV stake sale and routine renewable capacity co-investment.

filings.headline: Singularity Equity Fund 1 crossed 5% (to 5.30%) via warrant conversion
filings.summary: Vinyas allotted 3,17,800 equity shares at ₹1,100 each (premium ₹1,090; vs current ₹1,436.55) on conversion of warrants by four non-promoter holders, raising ₹17.48cr balance consideration. This adds ~2.5% to the share count (12.68cr → 12.99cr shares), diluting existing holders ~2.45%. Singularity Equity Fund 1's stake rose from 3.6% to 5.30%, crossing the 5% SAST threshold as a new large holder; 9,55,200 warrants remain outstanding.
filings.impactWhy: Stake increase is under 2% and warrant dilution is below 5%.

filings.headline: Crisil upgrades Juniper Green Energy to AA-/Stable from A+/Stable
filings.summary: Crisil upgraded Juniper Green Energy's long-term bank loan rating to 'AA-/Stable' from 'A+/Stable', with rated amount enhanced to Rs 761.68 crore from Rs 118 crore. The upgrade reflects a shift to consolidated analysis, 2.1 GW operational capacity (up from 1.3 GW), H1FY27 Ebitda of Rs 574 crore (vs Rs 254 crore), and an Rs 1,800 crore IPO in August 2026 used to cut debt. A rating upgrade signals improved financial strength and lower borrowing cost for a company with heavy Rs 25,000-30,000 crore capex plans.
filings.impactWhy: Crisil upgraded long-term credit rating to AA- from A+.

filings.headline: CFO Vikas Jain resigns, last working day January 31, 2027
filings.summary: TBO Tek's CFO and KMP Vikas Jain resigned on November 23, 2026 to pursue external career opportunities, with his last working day set for January 31, 2027. A CFO departure is a senior management change relevant to investors; the filing states no other material reasons for the resignation.
filings.impactWhy: Resignation of Chief Financial Officer Vikas Jain.

filings.headline: Brigade buys 2.25-acre Secunderabad plot for ₹180cr; ~₹1000cr revenue potential
filings.summary: Brigade Group completed an outright purchase of a 2.25-acre land parcel in Secunderabad, Hyderabad for ₹180 crore, with sale deed registered. It plans a premium residential project with estimated revenue potential of about ₹1000 crore, nearly 19% of last 12 months' sales of ₹5345cr, strengthening its Hyderabad footprint.
filings.impactWhy: Routine land acquisition for real estate developer.

filings.headline: RMC wins ₹521.8cr distribution infra LOA, ~1.7x annual sales
filings.summary: RMC Switchgears received Letters of Award worth ₹521.83cr for development of distribution infrastructure and systems strengthening works (substations, transformers, HT lines), to be executed over 24 months. The order is about 170% of last 12 months' sales of ₹306cr, a transformational boost to the order book. The awarding entity is kept confidential; it is a domestic, non-related-party contract.
filings.impactWhy: Order win worth ~170% of trailing twelve-month sales.

filings.headline: ICRA cuts Oswal Pumps to A (Negative) from A+ on receivables build-up
filings.summary: ICRA downgraded the long-term rating to ICRA A (Negative) from A+ (Negative) and short-term to A2+ from A1, citing a significant build-up in receivables in H1 FY2027 plus moderation in profitability from higher raw material, employee and project costs. Material subsidiary Oswal Solar Energy was similarly downgraded in line with the parent. A downgrade signals rising credit risk and funding cost pressure.
filings.impactWhy: ICRA downgraded credit rating to A from A+.

filings.headline: Independent director Sapna Tulsiani resigns, effective Nov 23, 2026
filings.summary: Mrs Sapna Uttam Tulsiani (DIN 00023934) has resigned as Non-Executive Independent Director of Oriental Aromatics, effective close of business on November 23, 2026, citing increased personal commitments and other professional obligations. She was a member of the Audit, Nomination & Remuneration, and CSR Committees. The exit of an independent director weakens board oversight and committee composition.
filings.impactWhy: Resignation of independent director, not key managerial personnel.

filings.headline: PW enters higher education with new Physicswallah Digital University in Patiala
filings.summary: Punjab Government notified the Physicswallah Digital University, Patiala Act, 2026 (assent Oct 23, notified Oct 29, 2026), with PW's wholly-owned Nextseed Foundation as the self-financed sponsoring body. This marks PW's entry into formal higher education (UG/PG degrees across five schools), with the first session targeted for July 2027, subject to UGC recognition. It opens a new business line beyond K-12 and test prep, though no revenue or investment figures are given.
filings.impactWhy: Strategic university entry without immediate financial or revenue details.

filings.headline: JWL forms 80:20 JV with Korea's Woojin for metro trains and propulsion
filings.summary: Jupiter Wagons has formed an 80:20 joint venture (JWL 80%, Woojin Industrial Systems 20%) with complete technology transfer to build metro coaches and propulsion systems in India, extending to Vande Bharat, EMU and high-speed trains. This opens two new, technology-intensive business lines and completes JWL's rolling-stock portfolio from wheels to propulsion. The filing gives no financial figures or investment size, but the move is strategically significant for a company with ~₹3,113cr yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Joint venture formation without disclosed financial commitment.

filings.headline: Arkade wins LoI for Tardeo redevelopment with ~₹1,500cr GDV
filings.summary: Arkade received a Letter of Intent for a ~2-acre redevelopment project in Tardeo, South Mumbai, with projected Gross Development Value of ₹1,500 crore. That GDV is over 2x the company's ₹686cr annual sales, marking a strategic re-entry into the premium SoBo market. The company also flagged two Q4 launches (Arkade Ascend in Malad W and Arkade Thane) with combined GDV of ₹2,800 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Letter of Intent for redevelopment project, not confirmed contract.

filings.headline: 45 MW Assam solar project (₹291cr EPC) declared commercially operational
filings.summary: SJVN Green Energy declared commercial operation of a 45 MW (AC) solar PV project at Sonitpur, Assam, with effect from November 21, 2026, built by Solarworld as EPC contractor. The three Letters of Award dated March 20, 2024 carry an aggregate value of ₹291.44 crore (excl. GST) including O&M, about 18% of ₹1,582cr yearly sales. Completion of a project of this size supports revenue recognition and execution track record.
filings.impactWhy: Commercial operation of an EPC project for a client.

filings.headline: Titagarh bags ₹77cr JSW wagon order; approved to make auto carrier wagons
filings.summary: Titagarh won an order from JSW (South) Rail Logistics for 181 BFNSM1 and 3 BVCM wagons worth ₹77.09cr, about 2.4% of yearly sales of ₹3265cr. More significantly, it received Indian Railways route clearance to manufacture and despatch specialised auto carrier (ACT) wagons, opening a new product segment and connecting its Bharatpur unit to the DFCCIL network. This expands its freight-wagon portfolio to cover all wagon types and lets it tap the buoyant auto-carrier market it previously could not address.
filings.impactWhy: Order value is only ~2.4% of annual sales.

filings.headline: Postal ballot to approve material related-party deals with subsidiary Prognosys
filings.summary: Molbio is seeking shareholder approval via postal ballot (e-voting Nov 24 to Dec 23, 2026) for material related-party transactions with its subsidiary Prognosys Medical Systems Pvt Ltd. The filing does not state the value of the transactions. Related-party deals warrant investor attention, though the counterparty is a subsidiary.
filings.impactWhy: Routine postal ballot for related-party transactions with subsidiary.

filings.headline: SWREL wins 3 orders incl. L1 worth over ₹2,050cr (~29% of sales)
filings.summary: SWREL bagged three domestic renewable orders with combined value over INR 2,050 crore: a 600 MWh BESS turnkey project in Gujarat from a PSU, a solar project from a private IPP in Rajasthan, and L1 position for a 350 MW solar turnkey project in Madhya Pradesh. At over ₹2,050cr this is about 29% of last 12 months' sales of ₹7,156cr, a significant addition to the order book. Note the Madhya Pradesh project is only L1 (lowest bidder), not yet confirmed.
filings.impactWhy: Renewable order wins and L1 position aggregate ~29% of annual sales.

filings.headline: Statutory records (FY16-FY26 minutes, registers) not traceable; police complaint filed
filings.summary: Sanghvi Movers says certain physical statutory records - Board/Committee/General Meeting minutes, attendance registers and directors' disclosure files for various years from FY2015-16 to FY2025-26 - were found untraceable in August 2026 after office renovations, and it filed a police complaint (Property Missing No. 1680/2026) on November 19, 2026. The company says electronic and contemporaneous supporting records exist, secretarial audits FY20-FY25 had no qualification, and it sees no material financial or operational impact. Despite the 'no impact' framing, loss of a decade of statutory records plus a police complaint is a governance red flag worth watching.
filings.impactWhy: Loss of historical physical statutory records with electronic backups intact.

filings.headline: Sold out Phase 1 of 'The Bungalows', ~₹2,319cr in sales
filings.summary: Max Estates sold out all 131 residences (7.7 lakh sqft) in Phase 1 of The Bungalows, Gurugram, achieving ~₹2,319 crore in sales on an oversubscribed launch. The project has an overall GDV of ~₹4,000 crore across 243 residences. The Phase 1 sales value alone is more than 11x the company's ₹204cr trailing annual sales, a major booking milestone.
filings.impactWhy: Launch sales of ₹2,319cr exceed 11x annual revenue.

filings.headline: DBL bags ₹901cr NBCC township EPC order in Srinagar (J&K)
filings.summary: Dilip Buildcon received a Letter of Award from NBCC (India) for Phase-I Package-3 group housing at Rakh Gund Aksha, Bemina, Srinagar, worth ₹901.43cr (incl. GST) on EPC basis, with 24 months construction plus 2 years O&M. The order is about 9.9% of last 12 months' sales of ₹9066cr, a meaningful addition to the order book.
filings.impactWhy: Order win is slightly under the 10% threshold of annual sales.

filings.headline: Promoter group bought 0.62% (~₹3.5cr) via open market
filings.summary: Promoter group member Shubham Khadwalia acquired 3,00,000 equity shares (about 0.62% of the 4.81cr shares, roughly ₹3.5cr at the current ₹115.27) through open-market purchases on Nov 18-20, 2026. Promoter and promoter-group holding rose from 70.63% to 71.25% on a fully diluted basis. The purchase exceeds the 0.25% threshold and signals promoter confidence.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter group acquired 0.62% stake via open-market purchases.

filings.headline: AMSL arm issues binding EOI to buy 100% of Bengaluru's IEC Group
filings.summary: Subsidiary Apollo Defence Industries issued a binding Expression of Interest on 23 Nov 2026 to acquire 100% of Integrated Electric Co, IE Power Technologies and partnership firm M/s Integrated Services. The deal marks AMSL's entry into indigenous design and manufacture of electrical rotating machines, generators and drives for defence platforms. Consideration and commercial terms will be disclosed on execution of definitive agreements; completion is subject to due diligence, board and statutory approvals.
filings.impactWhy: Binding EOI to acquire without disclosed deal size or definitive agreement.

filings.headline: USFDA issues Form 483 with 6 observations at Verna, Goa plant
filings.summary: A USFDA cGMP inspection at Marksans' Verna, Goa facility (12-20 Nov 2026) concluded with a Form 483 citing 6 observations. The company says all observations are procedural, with no data-integrity or repeat findings, and expects no impact on pipeline or commercial supplies. Form 483 observations at a key USFDA-approved site are a regulatory risk worth monitoring until resolved.
filings.impactWhy: US FDA issued Form 483 with 6 observations at key plant.

filings.headline: Buyback of up to 11.59 lakh shares at ₹425 for up to ₹49.3cr
filings.summary: Medi Assist filed its Letter of Offer for a tender-route buyback of up to 11,59,199 equity shares (1.55% of capital) at ₹425 each, well above the current ₹273.75 price, for up to ₹49.26cr. The buyback opens November 27 and closes December 3, 2026, with settlement by December 10. The buyback size is 10.00% of standalone paid-up capital and free reserves as of March 31, 2026.
filings.impactWhy: Tender-route share buyback at significant premium to market price.

filings.headline: Promoter group pledged 1.8% of shares (₹81.7cr)
filings.summary: Promoters and directors Manukant Chandulal Zota, Himansubhai Muktilal Zota, and Ketankumar Chandulal Zota pledged 6,24,000 shares (1.8% of the company, given to lenders as security) worth ₹81.7cr at an average price of ₹1,309, compared to the current price of ₹1,288. Their total holding remains unchanged at 24.1% before and after the pledge.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter group pledged 1.8% equity stake.

filings.headline: Income-tax show-cause notice proposes ₹11.46cr addition after search & seizure
filings.summary: Interarch received a show-cause notice on 21 Nov 2026 from ACIT Central Circle-7, Delhi, in block-assessment proceedings following a Section 132 search, proposing additions of ₹11,45,82,429 (~0.6% of ₹1992cr sales) to undisclosed income over FY2019-Oct2025. Allegations relate to disputed expenditure to erectors/subcontractors, non-filer parties, and cash allegedly returned to the company. It is only a notice, not a final demand, and the company plans to contest it, but the search-and-seizure basis makes it worth watching; response due 27 Nov 2026.
filings.impactWhy: Show-cause notice of ₹11.5cr is under 1% of sales.

filings.headline: ESDS clarifies Sydney AI deal: ~$1.26bn cost, cuts profit guide to $4-5m/month
filings.summary: Responding to a Morning Context article, ESDS clarified its Sharon AI GPU deal for 8,208 NVIDIA B300 GPUs in Sydney: commitment is ~US$1.26bn over 60 months (~US$21m/month, ~₹2,400cr a year, far above ₹534cr yearly sales), not the ~₹3,000cr cited on the Nov 2 call. Customers pay ~US$30m/month on take-or-pay, and the earlier call profit figures were cut to an estimated PAT of ~US$4-5m/month (14-17% margin); handover is now mid-Dec 2026 with billing from Jan 2027. A US$140m (₹1,336cr) refundable deposit, funded by customer advances, sits with Sharon AI, and the walk-back of earlier call figures plus the revised timeline warrants scrutiny.
filings.impactWhy: Media clarification regarding GPU deal terms and timeline.

filings.headline: Filed draft letter of offer for rights issue of up to ₹150cr
filings.summary: Viviana Power Tech submitted its Draft Letter of Offer for a proposed rights issue of partly paid-up equity shares (face value ₹10) aggregating up to ₹15,000 lakhs (₹150cr). That equals about 23% of the ₹664cr market value and roughly a quarter of ₹622cr yearly sales, a large capital raise. Issue price, ratio and record date are still blank ([●]), so exact dilution cannot be computed, with calls payable on or before December 31, 2028.
filings.impactWhy: Draft letter of offer filing; issue terms and ratio not yet finalized.

filings.headline: Executive Chairman Nitin Menon passed away on 21.11.2026
filings.summary: Menon Bearings reported the demise of Mr. Nitin Ram Menon, Executive Chairman, on 21.11.2026 due to acute myocardial infarction with CKD and hypertension. His cessation from the board is effective the same day. Loss of the Executive Chairman is a key leadership change material to investors.
filings.impactWhy: Cessation of Executive Chairman due to demise.

filings.headline: Suraj Estate launches 'Suraj Nova' in Mahim, GDV about ₹175cr
filings.summary: Suraj Estate launched Suraj Nova, a G+21 residential tower in Mahim West with MahaRERA registration and an estimated Gross Development Value of ₹175cr (about 29% of ₹594cr yearly sales). The project offers 1 and 2 BHK homes (374 and 600 sq ft carpet) and adds to the company's development pipeline. A sizeable addition to its South-Central Mumbai portfolio, though revenue will accrue over the project's build-out.
filings.impactWhy: Routine residential project launch.

filings.headline: SG Finserve's WOS gets SEBI nod for Category III AIF, enters fund management
filings.summary: SEBI granted registration (No. IN/AIF3/26-27/2385) to SG Finserve Multistrategy Investment Trust as a Category III AIF, managed by wholly owned subsidiary SG Alternative Investment Fund Limited. This marks the group's entry into the Alternative Investment Fund space, broadening its financial-services footprint. The company says there is no material impact on its current financial position; certificate receipt is awaited.
filings.impactWhy: Regulatory approval for AIF category III; no immediate material impact.

filings.headline: Export order worth ₹311cr for defence explosives, ~74% of yearly sales
filings.summary: Premier Explosives received an export order of USD 33,603,000 (approx. ₹311 crore) from an international client for manufacture and supply of defence explosives, to be delivered within 12 months. At roughly 74% of its ₹418cr annual sales, this is a very large win. It also strengthens the company's defence export order book.
filings.impactWhy: Defence export order worth ₹311cr represents ~74% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Texmaco Rail bags 2 JSW LOIs for 553 wagons worth ₹230.58cr
filings.summary: Texmaco received 2 LOIs from JSW group entities totalling ₹230.58cr: ₹102.57cr (246 wagons) and ₹128.01cr (307 wagons), both domestic. The combined order is about 6% of yearly sales (₹3834cr), to be executed by Feb and May 2027. Not a related-party deal.
filings.impactWhy: Order win equals ~6% of annual sales, below 10% threshold.

filings.headline: Stallion Asset crosses 5% stake via Reg 29(1) disclosure
filings.summary: The company received a SEBI SAST Regulation 29(1) disclosure on 20 Nov 2026 from Stallion Asset Private Limited (SEBI-registered Portfolio Manager) on behalf of its discretionary clients. Regulation 29(1) is triggered when a non-promoter's holding crosses the 5% threshold, signalling a new large holder. The filing does not disclose the exact shareholding percentage or value.
filings.impactWhy: Institutional investor crosses 5% substantial shareholding threshold.

filings.headline: Wins ₹145cr 3-yr Maharashtra health manpower contract (~10% of sales)
filings.summary: Krystal received a Letter of Award from the Commissionerate of Health Services, Maharashtra, to supply skilled/unskilled manpower to the Public Health Department for 3 years (15 Dec 2026–14 Dec 2029). Estimated LOA value is ₹144.7cr excluding taxes, about 10% of ₹1446cr annual sales (roughly ₹48cr a year). Awarded in the ordinary course of business with no related-party interest.
filings.impactWhy: Three-year contract worth ~10% of annual sales, under 4% per year.

filings.headline: CCL project: orders for ~50% of capacity; commercial output from Feb'27
filings.summary: Ratnaveer secured long-term supply agreements covering nearly 50% of its planned 79.2 lakh-sheet/year Copper Clad Laminate facility, with trial runs in Dec'26-Jan'27 and commercial production expected Feb 2027. The ₹338cr project targets additional ₹750cr annual revenue and ~₹150cr EBITDA at full capacity, large versus FY sales of about ₹1220cr. This opens a new business line in the PCB value chain; Q2 FY27 also saw revenue up 35.5%, EBITDA up 38.9% and PAT up 56.1% YoY.
filings.impactWhy: Project progress update ahead of scheduled commercial production.

filings.headline: USFDA closes Shamshabad FDF inspection with VAI; EIR issued
filings.summary: USFDA issued the Establishment Inspection Report for Cohance's Shamshabad formulation (FDF) facility and classified the outcome as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI), concluding the inspection. VAI is a relatively benign outcome with no major enforcement, removing regulatory overhang on a facility serving US-regulated markets.
filings.impactWhy: Routine USFDA inspection closure with VAI classification.

filings.headline: H1FY27 rev up 51% to ₹91.4cr; semiconductor scales to ₹31.7cr, new Swiss JV
filings.summary: H1FY27 revenue rose 51% YoY to ₹91.4cr, EBITDA ₹12.2cr (+15%), PAT ₹8.3cr (+42%); semiconductor revenue jumped to ₹31.7cr from ₹2.5cr (now positive EBITDA, ~63% of ₹50cr FY27 target). Promoters formed a 55:45 JV (Sahasra Asetronics) with Switzerland's Asetronics targeting automotive, medical, industrial and railway EMS, to be folded into the listco later. Company also secured a global automotive vendor code and an EV charging project, opening new higher-value business lines; standalone order book ₹144cr with ₹86.2cr executable in FY27.
filings.impactWhy: General business and financial update for H1.

filings.headline: Ankit Nayyar appointed Group CFO effective November 4, 2026
filings.summary: GMM Pfaudler submitted the brief profile of Mr. Ankit Nayyar, appointed Group CFO and Key Managerial Personnel effective November 4, 2026. He was previously Deputy CFO from May 2026, and brings nearly two decades of experience including as CFO of PI Health Sciences. A CFO appointment is a material senior-management change.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of Group CFO is a key management change.

filings.headline: Rossell Techsys wins over ₹50cr repeat space order from overseas customer
filings.summary: Rossell received a repeat order over ₹50cr from a major overseas space & satellite customer for manufacturing electrical wire harnesses, to be executed in 4-6 months. At over ₹50cr, the order is about 8% of last 12 months' sales of ₹612cr. It strengthens the company's international presence in the space segment.
filings.impactWhy: Order value is approximately 8% of sales, below 10% threshold.

filings.headline: ICRA revises outlook to Positive from Stable; rating reaffirmed at [ICRA]A+/A1
filings.summary: ICRA reaffirmed Sanghvi Movers' long-term rating at [ICRA]A+ and short-term at [ICRA]A1, but revised the outlook to Positive from Stable across its term loan, cash credit and unallocated limits. The improved outlook signals possible future upgrade and reflects strengthening credit profile, a positive for borrowing costs. Non-fund based limits reaffirmed at [ICRA]A1.
filings.impactWhy: Outlook revision only; rating reaffirmed without upgrade.

filings.headline: Urban Company raises ₹2,500cr via QIP at ₹156, 6x oversubscribed
filings.summary: Urban Company completed a QIP, allotting 16,02,56,410 equity shares at ₹156 each (3.1% discount to floor price of ₹161.03) to raise ₹2,500cr; the issue was oversubscribed over 6x with demand of over ₹15,000cr from 60+ investors, mutual funds taking over 50%. The new shares add about 10.4% to the ~154.22cr existing share count, diluting existing holders by roughly 9.4%; issue price of ₹156 is below the current ₹172.73. Proceeds fund InstaHelp supply build-out, brand marketing, technology, training, R&D and potential acquisitions.
filings.impactWhy: QIP fund-raise results in 9.4% equity dilution.

filings.headline: NATCO gets EIR for Visakhapatnam FDF unit; FDA inspection classified VAI
filings.summary: NATCO received the Establishment Inspection Report from the US FDA for its Parawada, Visakhapatnam FDF unit, with the August 17-21, 2026 inspection (4 observations in Form-483) classified as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI). The VAI classification effectively closes the inspection without major regulatory action, removing an overhang on US exports from this facility.
filings.impactWhy: US FDA EIR with VAI classification resolves inspection overhang.

filings.headline: Won Indian Railways Mumbai CST ad rights worth ₹41.3cr over 5 years
filings.summary: Simca secured advertising rights on leave-and-license basis for Indian Railways' Mumbai CST Division, covering 15,000 sq ft of new hoardings. The contract is worth ₹41.3cr over 5 years, commencing August 2027. That totals about 15% of yearly sales (₹275cr), or roughly ₹8.3cr per year, a meaningful multi-year revenue stream for a small-cap.
filings.impactWhy: Five-year contract represents only ~3% annualised revenue.

filings.headline: Won ₹52.85cr Adani Dhamra Port signalling order, 7.5-month execution
filings.summary: E to E received a Letter of Acceptance from The Dhamra Port Company Limited (Adani Ports & SEZ) for upgradation of signalling infrastructure at Dhamra Port, valued at ₹52.85cr, to be completed by 30 June 2027 (7.5 months). That equals about 7.5% of the ₹700cr yearly sales, a meaningful win from a reputed domestic client awarded via competitive bidding. Not a related-party transaction and at arm's length.
filings.impactWhy: Order is about 7.5% of annual sales, below 10% threshold.

filings.headline: CFO Nishikant Upadhyay elevated to Executive Director & CFO for 3 years
filings.summary: The board appointed CFO Mr. Nishikant Upadhyay (DIN 07779721) as Additional Director designated Executive Director & CFO for 3 years, from November 20, 2026 to November 19, 2029. Simultaneously, Mrs. Coralie Annamichele Ansari resigned as Executive Director with effect from November 20, 2026 for personal reasons. A board-level CFO/ED appointment is material governance news for investors.
filings.impactWhy: Internal elevation of existing CFO to Executive Director, not a leadership change.

filings.headline: CRISIL reaffirms AA-/A1+; outlook revised to Positive from Stable
filings.summary: CRISIL reaffirmed Genus Power's long-term rating at AA- and short-term at A1+ on Rs 4,927cr bank facilities and Rs 100cr commercial paper, but revised the outlook from 'Stable' to 'Positive'. The positive outlook signals a potential future upgrade, strengthening the credit profile. This is a favourable change versus a plain reaffirmation.
filings.impactWhy: Rating reaffirmed; outlook revision is not a rating upgrade.

filings.headline: EGM to approve 2:1 bonus issue and raising authorised capital to ₹40cr
filings.summary: Shivalik Bimetal called an EGM on Dec 16, 2026 to approve a bonus issue of 2 new equity shares for every 1 held (2:1) by capitalising reserves, and to raise authorised capital from ₹15cr to ₹40cr (20cr shares of ₹2). The bonus triples the share count (≈5.76cr shares to ≈17.28cr) but is proportional, so no economic dilution to existing holders; price and EPS adjust accordingly. Record date to be fixed by the Board.
filings.impactWhy: Shareholder approval called for a 2:1 bonus issue.

filings.headline: CRISIL revises outlook to Positive; A- reaffirmed, A- assigned to ₹400cr NCDs
filings.summary: CRISIL revised its outlook on Pace Digitek's ₹1,400cr bank facilities to 'Positive' from 'Stable', reaffirming the long-term rating at A- and short-term at A2+, and assigned A-/Positive to proposed ₹400cr NCDs. The outlook revision reflects a strengthening business profile, with BESS and renewable projects now ~79% of the Rs 10,736cr order book and BSNL dependence down to ~14%. This is a positive signal as it marks an improvement in outlook, not merely a reaffirmation.
filings.impactWhy: Rating reaffirmed; outlook revision is excluded from high impact.

filings.headline: GST search/inspection u/s 67 at company premises by Maharashtra State Tax
filings.summary: Commissioner of State Tax, Maharashtra initiated an inspection/search under Section 67 of the Maharashtra GST Act, 2017 at the Company's premises on 19 November 2026, and it is ongoing. No violation has been communicated and the Company says there is no financial or operational impact so far. A GST search is a material event under the screening rules regardless of stated impact; outcome and any demand remain to be seen.
filings.impactWhy: Ongoing GST search with no formal demand or determined outcome yet.

filings.headline: MMP secures PGCIL approval for 132-400kV polymer insulators, new business line
filings.summary: MMP's wholly owned subsidiary MEPL received PGCIL technical approval for Composite Long Rod Insulators up to 400 kV, opening a new value-added polymer insulator vertical. Capacity is up to 10 lakh insulators (investment ~Rs 35-40 Cr), with targeted 70-80% utilisation in FY28 and 18-20% EBITDA margins. This qualification unlocks India's power transmission market and diversifies revenue beyond MMP's core aluminium business.
filings.impactWhy: Vendor technical approval without an immediate qualifying large order.

filings.headline: Commissioned 108.5 MWp solar of 75 MW hybrid project; total ~2,952 MWp live
filings.summary: Juniper Green ETA Five, a wholly owned subsidiary, commissioned the full 108.50 MWp solar component of its 75 MW wind-solar hybrid project under a PPA with Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company. Aggregate operational capacity now stands at ~2,952 MWp and ~698 MWh BESS. Added capacity should lift revenue over time for a company with ₹995cr annual sales.
filings.impactWhy: Capacity addition is small relative to existing operational base.

filings.headline: Raymond allots 33.3L warrants at ₹645 to Minerva Ventures (₹214.7cr)
filings.summary: Raymond allotted 33,28,686 convertible warrants on preferential basis to Minerva Ventures Fund at ₹645 each (₹10 face + ₹635 premium), 25% (₹161.25) paid upfront, totalling about ₹214.7cr. Each warrant converts to one equity share, lifting the ~6.66cr share count by about 5% and diluting existing holders ~4.8%. The ₹645 price is a deep discount to the current ₹1,210.5 share price; post-issue the fund would hold 4.31% on a fully diluted basis.
filings.impactWhy: Warrant issue dilution is ~4.8%, below the 5% threshold.

filings.headline: Voltas signs JV with Atomberg for AC compressors, takes 50% of AAPL
filings.summary: Voltas executed a Joint Venture Agreement to acquire 50% of Atomberg Airtech Pvt Ltd, making it a Voltas subsidiary with four of five board nominees, to develop and manufacture room-AC compressors in India. Each party's maximum funding commitment is ₹100cr, modest versus ₹15340cr yearly sales, but the deal marks entry into a new compressor-manufacturing line and vertical integration. Closing is subject to conditions precedent; not a related-party transaction.
filings.impactWhy: Investment size of ₹100cr is small compared to sales.

filings.headline: Dilip Buildcon wins ₹419cr Gurugram Metro depot order (21 months)
filings.summary: The company received a Letter of Acceptance from Gurugram Metro Rail Limited for construction of a Depot cum Workshop for the Gurgaon Metro elevated corridor, worth ₹419.47cr including GST, to be executed in 21 months. This is about 4.6% of last 12 months' sales of ₹9066cr. A domestic order that adds to the order book with no related-party interest.
filings.impactWhy: Order represents only 4.6% of annual sales.

filings.headline: MV Electro gets LOI for 9.9-acre land in Gwalior Telecom Manufacturing Zone
filings.summary: The company received a Letter of Intent from MP Telecom Manufacturing Zone Gwalior Limited for allotment of land admeasuring 40,064 sq. metres (about 9.9 acres) in the Telecom Manufacturing Zone, District Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, to set up an industrial manufacturing unit. For a company with negligible current sales this signals a new manufacturing capacity build-out, though it is only a preliminary LOI with no cost or timeline disclosed.
filings.impactWhy: Preliminary LOI for land without financial commitments.

filings.headline: Urban Company adds residential ACs to Native segment product portfolio
filings.summary: The Board approved adding residential air conditioners to the product portfolio of the Native segment, following in-principle approval on October 16, 2026. This marks entry into a new product line, though the filing gives no financial figures or investment size.
filings.impactWhy: Product portfolio addition without disclosed financial scale.

filings.headline: CRISIL upgrades long-term rating to AA/Stable from AA-, A1+ reaffirmed
filings.summary: CRISIL upgraded IRB's long-term rating on Rs.1,700cr bank loan facilities to Crisil AA/Stable from Crisil AA-/Stable, while reaffirming the short-term rating at Crisil A1+. A rating upgrade signals improved credit quality and can lower borrowing costs.
filings.impactWhy: CRISIL credit rating upgraded to AA from AA-.

filings.headline: Aurionpro bags ~₹100cr additional order from global hyperscaler for AI data centre
filings.summary: Aurionpro secured an additional ~₹100 crore order (excl. GST) from a global hyperscaler for MEP design and execution of an AI-ready data centre in Southern India, to be completed over 9 months. At about 6.7% of the ₹1,490cr annual sales, the order is sizeable and strengthens its data-centre infrastructure engagement.
filings.impactWhy: Order is about 6.7% of annual sales.

filings.headline: WOS Alcon declared L1 for ₹120.95cr NE Railway signaling order
filings.summary: Alcon Builders & Engineers, a wholly owned subsidiary of GPT Infraprojects, was declared L1 (lowest bidder) for an order worth ₹120.95cr from NER HQ/North Eastern Railway for electronic interlocking signaling work in the Lucknow Division. The order is about 9.4% of yearly sales of ₹1292cr, a meaningful win, though L1 status is a precursor to formal award.
filings.impactWhy: Order is under 10% of sales and only at L1 stage.

filings.headline: Tree-felling nod clears path to restore Ari Dongri iron ore mine to 6 MTPA
filings.summary: Godawari Power got Forest Dept permission (Letter No. 8677 dated 18.11.2026) to fell trees over 60.84 hectares at its Ari Dongri Iron Ore Mines for overburden dumping. Ground clearance is expected within 3-4 weeks, after which the company plans to ramp mining back to full capacity of 6 million tonnes per annum. This restores normal operations and secures captive iron ore supply, supporting the group's steel value chain.
filings.impactWhy: Forestry clearance for overburden dumping is operational routine.

filings.headline: Vineet Poddar appointed CFO effective November 23, 2026
filings.summary: The board approved the appointment of Mr Vineet Poddar as Chief Financial Officer and KMP w.e.f. November 23, 2026; he was previously CFO of Safari Industries. A CFO appointment is a material senior management change. The filing also notes a routine ESOP allotment of 1,900 shares and grant of 96,328 options at ₹467.15, which are immaterial to dilution.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of new Chief Financial Officer.

filings.headline: GPCB orders closure of Sudeep Nutrition unit at Poicha over water-pollution lapses
filings.summary: Sudeep Pharma received (via GPCB portal) a closure direction under Section 33A of the Water Act for its subsidiary Sudeep Nutrition's manufacturing unit at Poicha (Rania), Vadodara, following a 6 Nov 2026 inspection that found damaged wastewater pipelines, untreated discharge and open raw-material storage. GPCB has sought a ₹1.5 lakh bank guarantee for revocation; the company says corrective action is underway, other units stay operational and it anticipates no financial impact. Despite the downplayed impact, a regulatory closure of a subsidiary's plant is a real production disruption worth watching.
filings.impactWhy: Pollution control board ordered shutdown of subsidiary manufacturing unit.

filings.headline: CFO Varun Gupta resigns, effective November 30, 2026
filings.summary: Mr. Varun Gupta, President & Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel, has resigned effective close of business on November 30, 2026, citing a better opportunity. A CFO departure is a material senior-management change and leaves a key role vacant pending a successor.
filings.impactWhy: Resignation of Chief Financial Officer.

filings.headline: Beta forms 49% oncology JV in Algeria; plant buy at US$8.7m, infuses US$3m
filings.summary: Beta Drugs will hold 49% of a JV with Algeria's IMGSA (51%) that will acquire IMGSA's oncology formulation plant for US$8.7 million, with Beta infusing US$3 million over three years and transferring formulation technology. Beta appoints the CEO/MD and 3 of 5 board seats, converting a 4-year supplier relationship into an equity partnership targeting the ~US$1bn tender-driven Algerian oncology market. This opens a new manufacturing and distribution footprint in North Africa; the transaction is subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals.
filings.impactWhy: JV investment outlay is modest relative to sales.

filings.headline: Beta to form 49% oncology JV in Algeria; plant buy at USD 8.7mn
filings.summary: Board approved a JV agreement with IMGSA Groupe SPA to make and market oncology products in Algeria, with Beta owning 49% (IMGSA 51%) but running operations with 3 of 5 board seats, the CEO role and affirmative rights. Beta will invest USD 3mn over 3 years plus technology transfer valued at USD 1.26mn; the JV will acquire IMGSA's oncology plant for USD 8.7mn total. This deepens a 4-year supply tie and opens a long-term manufacturing presence in a new market, though Beta's cash outlay (~₹25cr) is small versus ₹444cr yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Investment outlay is small relative to company's annual revenue.

filings.headline: RMC bags ₹18.51cr LOA from KRYFS Power for switchgear boxes
filings.summary: RMC Switchgears received Letters of Award from KRYFS Power Components worth ₹18,50,99,684 (₹18.51cr) to manufacture and supply FSP, MSP, SFU & Meter boxes, to be executed over 60 months. The order is about 6% of ₹306cr yearly sales, adding to the order book. It is a domestic, non-related-party contract.
filings.impactWhy: Order represents only 6% of sales spread over five years.

filings.headline: Viviana wins ₹124cr DHBVNL turnkey distribution order (~20% of sales)
filings.summary: Viviana Power Tech received a new turnkey contract worth Rs.124 crore (inclusive of taxes) from Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam Limited for 11 KV feeder distribution infrastructure in Gurugram under the RDSS scheme, to be executed in 15 months from LOA. At about 20% of last 12 months' sales of ₹622cr, this is a sizeable order. The company notes the value was already reflected in its investor presentation.
filings.impactWhy: Order represents ~20% of annual sales, well above 10% threshold.

filings.headline: SKF India launches new 'Vertevo' brand; board okays capacity expansion
filings.summary: Along with Q2/H1 FY27 results (resubmitted in machine-readable format), the board approved a proposed capacity expansion by adding new channels at various locations (no figures disclosed). SKF also officially launched its new global 'SKF Vertevo' brand on 3 Nov 2026, though the company name stays unchanged. Auditors gave an unmodified limited-review opinion.
filings.impactWhy: Routine brand launch and unspecified capacity expansion.

filings.headline: Stylam to buy 51% of Haripur Kraft for up to ₹22.44cr (backward integration)
filings.summary: Stylam's board approved acquiring a 51% stake in M/s Haripur Kraft Co., a semi-kraft paper maker (125 MT/day, FY26 turnover ₹82.50cr), for a cash capital contribution not exceeding ₹22.44cr, to be completed by 31 Jan 2027. Kraft paper is a key raw material for Stylam's laminates, so the deal secures backward integration and supply/price stability. Cost is modest at ~1.8% of yearly sales (₹1221cr); the firm will be jointly controlled, with Stylam at 51% and existing partners holding 24.5% each.
filings.impactWhy: Acquisition cost is modest at ~1.8% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Postal ballot for revised material related-party transaction limits FY27-FY28
filings.summary: BASF India seeks member approval via postal ballot (e-voting 23 Nov to 22 Dec 2026) to revise/update limits for material related-party transactions for FY2026-27 and FY2027-28. The resolution modifies limits approved at the 82nd AGM held 12 August 2026. Related-party dealings warrant attention, though the filing gives no specific transaction values.
filings.impactWhy: Routine postal ballot for related-party transaction limits.

filings.headline: GlobalFoundries to invest $10m in Cyient Semiconductors at $510m valuation
filings.summary: Cyient Semiconductors approved a USD 10 million strategic equity investment by GlobalFoundries at the same pre-money valuation of USD 490 million as its recent Edelweiss-led round, giving a post-money equity valuation of USD 510 million. The deal adds a leading foundry as a strategic partner to strengthen wafer supply and custom ASIC capabilities. It validates the semiconductor arm's valuation (~₹4,500cr) though the $10m infusion (~₹88cr) is small against parent sales of ₹8,086cr; no dilution of Cyient Ltd's own shares.
filings.impactWhy: Minor minority investment into subsidiary with no dilution to parent.

filings.headline: Oriana to set up five CBG plants (110 TPD), ₹750cr investment
filings.summary: Oriana received GOBARdhan Scheme approval from the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas for five Compressed Biogas projects of 22 TPD each (110 TPD combined), via five subsidiaries across UP, Gujarat, Maharashtra and MP. Each entails ₹150cr investment, ₹750cr in total, marking entry into the green fuels segment. The planned outlay is large versus ₹3441cr yearly sales and opens a new business line, though it is at the approval/proposal stage.
filings.impactWhy: Preliminary government approvals; project execution is still in proposal stage.

filings.headline: Promoter bought 0.17% (₹8.8cr) at about ₹109
filings.summary: Promoter Fairbridge Capital Mauritius Limited bought 8,07,000 shares (0.17% of the company) via market purchase for ₹8.8cr at an average price of ₹109, compared to the current price of ₹111. This transaction increased their holding from 64.9% to 65.0%.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter purchased shares via open market

filings.headline: Promoter bought 0.61% (₹7.6cr) at about ₹152
filings.summary: Promoter Mr. Siddharth Bhaskar Shah bought a 0.61% stake in the company through a market purchase worth ₹7.6 crore at an average price of ₹152 per share, compared to the current price of ₹146. This transaction increased his holding from 3.1% to 3.7%.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter purchased shares via open market

filings.headline: GST search at Cosmo First's Aurangabad plants under Section 67
filings.summary: Maharashtra State GST officials initiated an inspection/search under Section 67 of the Maharashtra GST Act at Cosmo First's Aurangabad manufacturing units on November 18, 2026. No violations have been communicated yet and the company says there is no material financial impact at present. A GST search at operating plants is a red flag worth watching for further developments.
filings.impactWhy: Tax search ongoing without quantified demand or material outcome

filings.headline: Tonbo bags ₹35.62cr MoD order for clip-on thermal weapon sights
filings.summary: Tonbo Imaging received a supply order worth approx. ₹35.62 crore (incl. taxes) from the Ministry of Defence for clip-on thermal weapon sights and support equipment, deliverable in two lots within 52 weeks. The order is about 12% of the last 12 months' sales of ₹297cr, and carries option and repeat-order clauses each for up to 50% of ordered quantity.
filings.impactWhy: Defence order worth about 12% of annual sales

filings.headline: GST Dept search at corporate office under Section 67 of MGST Act
filings.summary: GST Department officials conducted an investigation/search at Supreme Petrochem's Mumbai corporate office on 18 Nov 2026 under Section 67 of the Maharashtra GST Act, 2017. The nature of alleged violations is not yet known and no demand figure is stated; the company says it is cooperating, operations are unaffected and it expects no material impact. A GST search is treated as material regardless of the company's reassurance, pending further developments.
filings.impactWhy: Tax search ongoing without quantified demand or material outcome

filings.headline: LT Foods to buy US brand Maya Kaimal for USD 5.8m enterprise value
filings.summary: Step-down subsidiary LT Foods Americas signed an SPA to acquire 100% of MK Foods Holdings (brand 'Maya Kaimal'), a US branded packaged foods firm, on a cash-free, debt-free enterprise value of USD 5.8m, plus an earnout tied to post-closing sales. MK had revenue of USD 17.9m for the 12 months to Sept 2026 (USD 15.5m FY2025). Though the price is small versus LT Foods' ~₹12102cr sales, it adds an established US consumer brand across sauces and ready-to-eat meals, strengthening its RTE/RTC growth pillar; completion expected within 3 months.
filings.impactWhy: Small acquisition relative to company sales

filings.headline: PW targets ₹9,000-10,000cr revenue by FY30, 25%+ CAGR, 20%+ EBITDA margin
filings.summary: At its first Investor Day, Physicswallah set an FY30 ambition of ₹9,000-10,000cr revenue (up from ₹3,900cr in FY26), a 25%+ revenue CAGR over FY27-FY30, and a pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin of 20%+, with online contributing about two-thirds of revenue. This is medium-term guidance implying more than doubling of sales versus the last 12 months' ₹4,297cr, and a shift to profitable growth. These are management ambitions, not guarantees.
filings.impactWhy: Long-term ambition at investor day, not formal guidance change

filings.headline: Titagarh bags first traction motor order from CLW worth ₹65.38cr
filings.summary: Titagarh received a Letter of Acceptance from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works for 3-Phase Asynchronous Traction Motors (Type 6FRA-6068) for WAG-9 locos, valued at ₹65.38cr incl. GST, to be executed phase-wise by 31.12.2027. Though only about 2% of yearly sales (₹3265cr), this is the company's first contract after its upgrade to a 'Regular Source' vendor by Indian Railways with approved capacity of 1,200 motors/annum, opening a new business line.
filings.impactWhy: Order is only about 2% of annual sales

filings.headline: Postal ballot to raise RPT limit with subsidiary Virtuoso Compressors
filings.summary: Company seeks member approval via postal ballot (e-voting Nov 19 to Dec 18, 2026; results Dec 20) to modify earlier-approved material related-party transaction limits with subsidiary Virtuoso Compressors Private Limited, in partial modification of Resolution No. 3 passed May 21, 2026, effective till May 20, 2027. It also proposes appointing Mr. J Vishnuvardhan as an Independent Director. The revised monetary limit is not stated in the available text; the related-party nature warrants monitoring.
filings.impactWhy: Postal ballot for related-party transaction limits

filings.headline: Om Power bags ₹46.57cr GETCO LOI for 220kV Dharampur substation
filings.summary: Om Power received a Letter of Intent from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation (GETCO) for turnkey supply, erection, testing and commissioning of 220kV & 66kV equipment for the 220kV Dharampur AIS Substation, worth ₹46.57cr including GST. The order is about 8.8% of last 12 months' sales (₹529cr), a meaningful addition to the order book. Execution period is 18 months from the date of LOA; domestic entity, not a related party.
filings.impactWhy: Order value is below the 10% sales threshold

filings.headline: Apollo signs MoU with Redon Systems for drones, loitering munitions
filings.summary: Apollo Micro Systems signed a Strategic Collaboration and Framework MoU with Redon Systems Private Limited for tethered drone systems, multi-barrel loitering munition systems and other aerial platforms for Indian defence forces. The filing says this opens a wider scope in Aerial Platforms, Loitering Munitions and ISR, combining Apollo Group's explosives/energetics expertise with its fuzes and avionics experience. It signals entry into new business lines, though no financial figures or order value are disclosed.
filings.impactWhy: Framework MoU without committed financial terms or order value

filings.headline: Vikram Kumar Khaitan appointed CFO w.e.f. Nov 14, 2026
filings.summary: EPACK Prefab Technologies appointed Mr. Vikram Kumar Khaitan as Chief Financial Officer (Key Managerial Personnel) with effect from November 14, 2026. He is a Chartered Accountant and Company Secretary with over two decades in finance, most recently CFO at Kuantum Papers. A CFO appointment is a material senior-management change for investors.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of Chief Financial Officer

filings.headline: Buyback of 47.5L shares done at ₹312 for ₹148.2cr (18% premium)
filings.summary: Genus Power completed its tender-offer buyback of up to 47,50,000 equity shares (about 1.56% of the 30.42cr shares) at ₹312 each, aggregating up to ₹148.20cr, and published the post-buyback public announcement.
