Alongside, Q2FY27 consolidated revenue rose 41.9% YoY to ₹4,588.6Mn, EBITDA up 34.4% to ₹1,181.8Mn and PAT up 51.8% to ₹808.1Mn; H1FY27 revenue grew 40.8% with PAT up 59.2%. The MD-level change plus strong growth are both relevant to the investment case.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of new Managing Director and Chairman.

filings.headline: Q2FY27 PAT up 50.5% to ₹147cr; system-wide sales up 18.8%
filings.summary: Consolidated PAT rose 50.5% YoY to Rs.1,473 million in Q2FY27 (Rs.2,761 million in H1FY27, up 43.2%), with system-wide sales up 18.8% to Rs.8,654 million and consolidated sales up 19.5% to Rs.4,253 million. Profit included a ~Rs.468 million write-back of provisions (net of tax) and higher other income; passenger traffic fell 4.8% YoY. Debt-free with Rs.10,309 million cash; presence expanded to 22 airports and 535 QSR outlets.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Kaynes signs binding term sheet with Vishay for 49% stake JV in semiconductor OSAT
filings.summary: Kaynes executed a binding term sheet with Vishay Intertechnology and its subsidiary Ecomal to form a JV through wholly owned subsidiary Kaynes Semicon (KSPL), with Vishay taking a 49% stake. The JV will provide semiconductor back-end manufacturing (post-fab wafer processing, assembly, test, packaging/OSAT) and run a Vishay captive line in India, with Raghu Panicker as KSPL's MD & CEO. This opens a new semiconductor business line with a major global partner, though it remains subject to definitive agreements and approvals; no investment figures were disclosed.
filings.impactWhy: Non-final binding term sheet for a joint venture.

filings.headline: Navin Fluorine starts new 15K MTPA R32-equivalent HFC plant at Surat
filings.summary: Navin Fluorine commenced commercial operations of its additional hydrofluorocarbons (HFC/R32) capacity of up to 15K MTPA R32-equivalent at the Surat unit, backed by ₹236.50 crore of board-approved funding. The plant will ramp up progressively. A new capacity start adds to the company's fluorochemicals output and future revenue.
filings.impactWhy: Capacity commissioning is modest relative to company size.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 consol EBITDA record ₹190cr (+86.6%); PAT up 121.7% to ₹82cr
filings.summary: Man Industries reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,216cr (+49.3% YoY) and record quarterly EBITDA of ₹190cr (+86.6%), with PAT up 121.7% to ₹82cr, aided by the NPC acquisition consolidated from 21 May 2026. Shipping disruption at the Strait of Hormuz deferred ~₹320cr of revenue; order book stands at ~₹3,500cr. Strategic expansions include a 350,000 MTPA HSAW plant in the USA ($110m capex), a Jammu seamless pipe plant (output by Apr 2027) and a Dammam coating facility (by Mar 2027).
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: EIH to build ₹777cr Trident hotel near Hyderabad airport, open by Sep 2030
filings.summary: EIH's board approved constructing a five-star Trident hotel on an 8.89-acre company-owned site near Shamshabad Airport, Hyderabad, at an estimated ₹777 crore funded by internal accruals and debt. The hotel will be operational by September 2030. The investment is sizeable at about 26% of ₹3023cr annual sales, signalling material portfolio expansion in domestic tourism, though the payoff is several years out.
filings.impactWhy: Long-term capex announcement with completion years away.

filings.headline: CFO Manoj Kumar Digga steps down from 1 Dec 2026; stays as Exec Director
filings.summary: SPML Infra's board approved the cessation of Mr. Manoj Kumar Digga as CFO w.e.f. 1 December 2026, though he continues on the board as Executive Director. Mr. Arun Kumar Agarwal, a Cost and Management Accountant with 29+ years' experience (ex-VISA Industries WTD & CFO, earlier L&T), is appointed as new CFO and KMP from the same date. A change in the CFO/KMP position is a material senior-management transition for investors to note.
filings.impactWhy: Cessation and appointment of Chief Financial Officer.

filings.headline: Three directors resign; independent directors Nandyala, Garimella and Ambuja step down
filings.summary: Sigma Advanced Systems filed additional disclosure on the resignation of Suryanarayana Raju Nandyala (DIN 01581731), Uma Garimella (DIN 02847624) and Leona Ambuja (DIN 07138817) as directors, effective November 06, 2026. Reasons cited are increasing professional commitments and pre-occupation, with confirmation of no material disagreements with the Board or management. Simultaneous departure of multiple independent/non-executive directors is a governance point worth watching.
filings.impactWhy: Resignation of independent directors, not key management personnel.

filings.headline: Independent director Uma Garimella resigns, citing time constraints
filings.summary: Sigma Advanced Systems disclosed additional details on the resignation of Independent Directors, including Ms. Uma Garimella (DIN: 02847624), effective November 06, 2026, citing increasing professional commitments. The filing also references resignations of Suryanarayana Raju Nandyala and Leona Ambuja on the same date. Each resigning director confirmed no other material reasons or disagreements with the Board or management.
filings.impactWhy: Resignation of independent director.

filings.headline: Raman K made regular CFO after interim role since Feb 2026
filings.summary: The board confirmed Mr Raman K as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel in the regular capacity w.e.f. November 12, 2026, superseding his interim designation held since February 4, 2026. This fills a key management post, though the same person has effectively served as CFO throughout.
filings.impactWhy: Regularization of existing interim CFO to regular capacity.

filings.headline: RBI grants in-principle nod to set up TReDS platform; Q2 profit ₹74.6cr
filings.summary: MSTC's board noted RBI's in-principle authorisation (letter dated 11 Nov 2026) to set up and operate a Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, opening a new business line. The board also approved Q2FY27 results with revenue from operations of ₹110.0cr (up from ₹85.0cr) and net profit of ₹74.6cr (up from ₹49.1cr). Separately, the company discontinued its BG-backed procurement (Marketing) business, so segmental reporting ends from FY27.
filings.impactWhy: In-principle regulatory approval, not final commercial launch.

filings.headline: Q3 CY26 revenue +30% to ₹660cr, PAT +38%; CY26 growth guided ~20%
filings.summary: First results as a listed company: Q3CY26 revenue rose 30.2% YoY to ₹6,602mn with EBITDA margin 19.5% and PAT up 38.2% to ₹871mn (13.1% margin); 9MCY26 revenue up 22.8% to ₹17,920mn. Management guided CY26 revenue growth of about 20% and a CY26–CY28 revenue CAGR of about 15% with EBITDA margin near 18.5%. Record performance plus explicit forward guidance makes this material to the investment case.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly results and general guidance.

filings.headline: Q2 net profit crashes 72% YoY to ₹21.6cr; revenue down to ₹348cr
filings.summary: Oswal Pumps reported Q2 FY27 standalone revenue of ₹348.1cr (vs ₹485.2cr a year earlier) and net profit of ₹21.6cr, down ~72% from ₹75.8cr. H1 net profit fell to ₹43.2cr from ₹149.8cr, with margins squeezed by higher material and finance costs. The sharp earnings decline against ~₹2025cr yearly sales is a clear negative signal for the investment case.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: ADD rate revised to 5.53%; ₹10.1cr provision, Q2 net profit crashes to ₹2.1cr
filings.summary: Q2 FY27 net profit fell to ₹211.59 lakh (₹2.1cr) from ₹2,166.53 lakh (₹21.7cr) in the prior quarter and ₹1,187.23 lakh a year ago, dragged by a ₹935.92 lakh net exceptional charge. This includes a ₹1,010.39 lakh (₹10.1cr, ~1.1% of ₹927cr sales) incremental US Anti-Dumping Duty provision after rates were revised up from 1.35% to 3.76% and 5.53%; the company has appealed to the US Court of International Trade. The sharply higher ADD rate raises ongoing costs on US shrimp exports, a lasting risk to margins.
filings.impactWhy: Routine anti-dumping duty revision and quarterly earnings drop.

filings.headline: WeWork India to add 4,256 desks in Hyderabad, ₹144cr investment
filings.summary: WeWork India signed lease deeds in Hyderabad for 3,13,633 sq ft, adding ~4,256 desks to its existing 1,45,280 desks (83.7% utilised as at Sep 30, 2026). The ~₹144cr investment, funded via internal accruals/debt, is to be operational by July 2027 to meet incremental demand. The spend is about 5% of yearly sales of ₹2782cr and expands operational capacity in line with business growth.
filings.impactWhy: Routine commercial real estate lease additions.

filings.headline: Q2 sales ₹823cr (up 108%), PAT ₹121cr (up 139%); 65p interim dividend
filings.summary: Standalone Q2FY27 net sales jumped to ₹823.1cr from ₹395.6cr a year earlier (+108%), and profit after tax rose to ₹121.3cr from ₹50.8cr (+139%); H1 sales were ₹1,451cr with PAT ₹207.8cr. The Board also declared a 65% interim dividend of ₹0.65 per ₹1 face-value share, payable within 30 days. The auditor added an emphasis-of-matter on going-concern doubt at a small Indian subsidiary, deemed immaterial to the Group.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Order book up 19% to record ₹33,081cr; Q2 consol revenue +17% to ₹2,250cr
filings.summary: Dilip Buildcon's Q2FY27 results show order book at a record ₹33,081cr (up 19% QoQ, ~3.8x yearly sales), consolidated revenue up 17% YoY to ₹2,250cr and PAT ₹101cr; standalone revenue up 19% to ₹1,686cr with PBT nearly tripling to ₹71cr. DBL 2.0 unlocks ₹1,917cr value in transmission/solar assets (Alpha Group co-invests ₹820cr) and enters oil & gas via the Paradip–Raipur LPG and ATF pipelines. FY27 standalone revenue guidance of ₹9,107cr (30% growth) and FY28 net-debt-free target reaffirmed; renewables plus transmission now 27% of the book versus roads at 15.6%.
filings.impactWhy: Earnings and order book update with reaffirmed guidance; no fresh trigger.

filings.headline: Stylam seeks postal-ballot nod for 1:5 stock split (₹5 to ₹1 face value)
filings.summary: Stylam Industries has issued a postal-ballot notice to split each ₹5 face-value equity share into five ₹1 shares, ranking pari passu, effective from a Board-fixed record date. E-voting runs November 14 to December 13, 2026, with results by December 15. A share split raises the number of shares fivefold and improves liquidity without changing total equity value or diluting holders.
filings.impactWhy: Share split approved by board subject to postal ballot.

filings.headline: Q2 consol revenue up 17% to ₹2,250cr; order book record ₹33,081cr (up 19%)
filings.summary: Q2FY27 consolidated revenue rose 17% YoY to ₹2,250cr with EBITDA margin expanding to 19.5% (from 18.1% in Q1); PBT before exceptionals up 24% to ₹176cr and PAT ₹101cr (vs ₹214cr base quarter that had ₹122cr exceptional gains). Standalone revenue up 19% to ₹1,686cr, PBT nearly tripled to ₹71cr and PAT up 28% to ₹52cr. Order book hit a record ₹33,081cr (up 19% QoQ), H1 inflow of ₹7,589cr covers 76% of FY27 guidance, and the company reaffirmed FY27 standalone revenue growth of ~30% (₹9,107cr) plus an FY28 net-debt-free target.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly results with reaffirmed guidance; sales growth is routine.

filings.headline: Astra won ₹2,036cr orders in Q2; order book ₹3,937cr (standalone)
filings.summary: In Q2FY27 Astra received orders worth ₹2,036cr, nearly double its ₹1,140cr trailing annual sales, taking standalone order book to ₹3,937cr and consolidated to ₹4,708cr as on 30 Sep 2026. Q2 standalone revenue rose 22.5% YoY to ₹261cr with PAT up 126.5% to ₹47cr (18.0% margin), its highest-ever half-year EBITDA and PAT. The large order inflow and multi-year indigenous radar/EW programmes give strong revenue visibility.
filings.impactWhy: Aggregate quarterly order intake and earnings recap, not a single large contract.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 letter: Auto debt cut to ₹337cr, cell PLI extended, FCF guided near-term
filings.summary: Ola Electric's Q2 FY27 shareholders' letter reports gross margin stable at ~29.9%, opex down to ₹369cr (from ₹390cr), and total borrowings cut from ₹3,132cr (Dec 2024) to ₹1,819cr, with Auto borrowings down from ₹2,422cr to ₹337cr. It guides to Auto free cash flow in the near term, production ramping to ~25,000 vehicles in December, 255 dealers/319 stores targeting 700 by March 2027, and Cell achieving 6 GWh SCOD with ACC PLI extended to CY2031. Supply chain, not demand, is now the constraint, with ~5,000 September deliveries slipping to October on charger unavailability.
filings.impactWhy: Shareholder letter with operational updates and debt reduction; no formal guidance change.

filings.headline: CleanMax signs MoU to invest ~₹50,000cr in AP clean energy complex for 2 GW compute
filings.summary: CleanMax signed an MoU with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board to invest ~₹50,000 crore in 3 GW of wind/solar plus 1 GW pumped storage over five years, powering a 2 GW Green Compute Factory in Kurnool anchored by Neysa (1 GW IT load). At least 1.5 GW of renewable capacity is proposed by 2029. The planned investment is roughly 20x annual sales of ₹2,539cr and far exceeds market value of ₹15,344cr, a transformative scale-up though still at MoU stage.
filings.impactWhy: Non-binding MoU for future investment, not a firm contract or commissioning.

filings.headline: Secures 12.8 MW extra data centre capacity, up 88% to 27.4 MW
filings.summary: E2E Networks secured approximately 12.8 MW of additional data centre capacity on top of its existing 14.6 MW, an 88% increase taking total capacity to roughly 27.4 MW. The expansion supports growing demand for its GPU cloud and AI infrastructure services. A near-doubling of capacity is a significant operational scale-up for a company with ₹521cr yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Data centre capacity addition, not commissioning of a company-owned facility.

filings.headline: To set up USA HSAW pipe plant, 3.5 lakh MTPA, ~USD 110mn (~₹920cr)
filings.summary: Board approved establishing a wholly owned US manufacturing facility for HSAW pipes with 3,50,000 MTPA capacity at an estimated project cost of approx. USD 110 million (~₹920cr). This is a major capex, roughly 22% of the ₹4250cr yearly sales, to cater to US and international markets within the company's main business line. Board also approved unaudited Q2/H1 FY27 results.
filings.impactWhy: Capex approval to build plant; commercial production not yet achieved.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue +28.8% to ₹276.5cr but EBITDA -81.5%, PAT near zero
filings.summary: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 28.8% YoY to Rs 2,765 million, but EBITDA collapsed 81.5% YoY to Rs 34 million (margin 1.2% vs 8.4%) and PAT fell to Rs (0.2) million from Rs 124 million, with EPS at 0.00. H1 FY27 PAT dropped 56.1% to Rs 107 million despite 33.5% revenue growth. The sharp margin erosion, driven by a shift from high-margin sea imports to low-margin sea exports, signals a material profitability problem despite strong top-line growth.
filings.impactWhy: Revenue grew; collapse was in margins, not sales or volumes.

filings.headline: HFCL wins ₹834cr OFC export order (~11% of yearly sales)
filings.summary: HFCL secured export orders worth ~₹834.36 crore (~USD 88.94 million) for supply of optical fiber cables via its overseas wholly owned subsidiary from an international customer. The order equals about 11% of last 12 months' sales of ₹7492cr and is to be executed by June 2027. It is in the normal course of business and not a related-party transaction.
filings.impactWhy: Export order worth ₹834cr exceeds 10% of annual sales.

filings.headline: H1 FY27 PAT down 8% to ₹19.6cr; 5X export growth target delayed
filings.summary: Q-Line reported H1 FY27 revenue of ₹152.18cr (+5.83%) and EBITDA ₹39.57cr (+10.02%, margin 26.0%), but PAT fell 8.06% to ₹19.60cr on higher depreciation (₹7.89cr vs ₹4.09cr) from Unit 4 capitalisation and finance costs. The Company flagged that its planned ~5X FY27 export revenue scale-up may take longer due to West Asia geopolitical disruptions, and instrument revenue fell 29.71%. It also added Unit 4 product licences (now 36) and expects the plant fully operational in H2 FY27.
filings.impactWhy: Routine earnings commentary; delay of internal export target without formal guidance change.

filings.headline: Board approves buying 70% of group firm Heidelco Medicore (related-party deal)
filings.summary: Q-Line Biotech's board approved acquiring 6,12,500 equity shares (70% paid-up capital) of Heidelco Medicore Private Limited, a group company, valued on a Net Asset Value basis as on 30.09.2026. As a related-party transaction it falls under Section 188 and SEBI LODR, recommended by the Audit Committee. The filing gives no deal value, so size versus sales cannot be assessed; related-party deals warrant scrutiny.
filings.impactWhy: Related-party acquisition without disclosed deal value.

filings.headline: Harsh Garg appointed CFO w.e.f. Nov 19, 2026
filings.summary: OSEL Devices appointed Mr. Harsh Garg, a Chartered Accountant with over four years of post-qualification experience, as Chief Financial Officer and KMP effective November 19, 2026. CFO appointments are material governance events; he is not related to any director or KMP.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of Chief Financial Officer (CFO).

filings.headline: Apsis Aerocom bags new order/contract (value not disclosed)
filings.summary: Apsis Aerocom informed the exchange it has bagged/received an order or contract. The filing text provides no order value, counterparty or timeline, so its size cannot be judged against the roughly ₹61cr yearly sales. Order wins in a ₹587cr aerospace-defence firm are generally positive, but materiality depends on the undisclosed amount.
filings.impactWhy: Order win value is undisclosed; materiality cannot be established.

filings.headline: Auditor flags SEBI/NSE queries on ₹339cr of IPO proceeds in Q2 results
filings.summary: Q2 FY27 standalone results show revenue from operations of ₹166.4cr (down from ₹203.7cr a year ago) and net profit of ₹9.47cr (vs ₹7.13cr). The auditor's limited review draws attention to queries from NSE and SEBI over deposits/advances of ₹3,391.44 million (₹339cr) given from IPO proceeds till June 30, 2024; management, relying on legal opinions, says the classification complies with the offer document. The regulatory scrutiny of IPO-proceeds use, large versus yearly sales of about ₹985cr, is a governance risk worth watching.
filings.impactWhy: Auditor emphasis of matter on regulatory queries, not an outcome.

filings.headline: Q2FY27 revenue up 60% to ₹2,627cr but adjusted loss of ₹57cr
filings.summary: Amber posted Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹2,627cr (up 60% YoY) and Operating EBITDA of ₹127cr (up 30%), but reported an adjusted loss after tax of ₹57cr for the quarter and an exceptional loss of ₹9.5cr (₹132.7cr for H1). H1FY27 revenue was ₹6,515cr (up 28%) with adjusted PAT of ₹69cr. Strong top-line growth (Electronics +94%, Consumer Durables +41% YoY) is offset by the quarterly bottom-line loss and heavy exceptional charges tied to recent acquisitions.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly earnings report.

filings.headline: Q2FY27 revenue +19.9% to ₹452cr; PAT flat at ₹15.9cr on deferred tax
filings.summary: Wakefit reported Q2FY27 revenue of INR 4,519.9 mn, up 19.9% YoY, with H1FY27 revenue of INR 8,569.0 mn (+18.4%). Reported PAT was flat at INR 158.9 mn (-0.4% YoY) due to a INR 64.3 mn deferred tax charge; excluding deferred tax, PAT rose 39.9% to INR 223.2 mn. Gross margin fell to 53.9% from 57.7% on higher Polyol/TDI prices, and part of festive demand shifted to Q3, making YoY less comparable; store network grew to 205 COCO stores.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue ₹37.4cr, up 18% YoY; two new IVF hubs opened, EBITDA margin down 737bps
filings.summary: Q2 FY27 revenue ₹37.4cr (+17.9% YoY) with PAT flat at ₹9.4cr; EBITDA fell to ₹13.5cr as margin dropped 737bps to 36.0% on rollout costs for two new hubs. H1 FY27 revenue ₹56.8cr (+14.7%), but EBITDA down 16.1% and PAT down 10.5% to ₹11.2cr. Company commenced operations at South Extension (July) and Gurgaon (Sept) hubs under its planned 19-centre IPO expansion, now running 9 hubs and 28 spokes; management expects a stronger H2 as new hubs ramp up.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results and normal branch additions.

filings.headline: Q2FY27 PAT up 50.5% to ₹147cr, system-wide sales up 18.8%
filings.summary: TFS reported Q2FY27 consolidated PAT of Rs.1,473mn (up 50.5% YoY) and consolidated sales of Rs.4,253mn (up 19.5% YoY); H1FY27 PAT was Rs.2,761mn on sales of Rs.8,775mn. System-wide sales grew 18.8% YoY despite a 4.8% YoY fall in passenger traffic, driven by net contract gains and premiumisation; airport presence expanded to 22 and outlets to 535. PAT included a ~Rs.468mn (net of tax) write-back of provisions in Q2, and the balance sheet is debt-free with Rs.10,309mn cash.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Q2FY27: platform premium +55%, revenue +35% to ₹342cr, Service EBITDA +47%
filings.summary: Turtlemint reported Q2FY27 results: platform premium grew 55% YoY to ₹1,214cr, revenue from operations rose 35% to ₹342cr, and Service EBITDA grew 47% to ₹45cr. Adjusted EBITDA margin improved from -14% to -6% YoY, showing narrowing losses and operating leverage. H1FY27 revenue grew 38% to ₹637cr with Service EBITDA up 66% to ₹85cr, signalling strong momentum though the company is still not fully profitable.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results without record performance stated.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 19% to ₹883cr; PAT ₹163cr incl. ₹50cr exceptional gain
filings.summary: Standalone Q2 FY27 (Sept 2026) revenue from operations rose to ₹883.5cr from ₹741.1cr a year ago (+19%), with profit before exceptional items of ₹165.4cr vs ₹137.5cr. A ₹50cr exceptional gain lifted PAT to ₹163cr (vs ₹103.9cr), with Q2 standalone basic EPS of ₹13.70 vs ₹8.73. Half-year revenue was ₹1,665cr and PAT ₹281.6cr; auditors issued an unmodified limited review conclusion.
filings.impactWhy: Regular quarterly financial results with routine growth.

filings.headline: Q2 net profit up 32% to ₹84.2cr; revenue up 31% to ₹937cr
filings.summary: Fiem reported Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026) standalone revenue from operations of ₹936.9cr vs ₹714.8cr a year ago (+31%) and net profit of ₹84.2cr vs ₹63.8cr (+32%), with EPS of ₹31.98. H1 profit was ₹149.4cr on revenue of ₹1,712cr. An ₹82.3cr insurance claim for the Aug-2025 Tapukara fire remains pending settlement.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly earnings announcement with standard growth.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 PAT down 41.7% YoY to ₹53cr; margins fall to 17.5% from 26.3%
filings.summary: Q2 FY27 revenue fell 3.0% YoY to ₹491cr as exports dropped 46.6%; EBITDA margin collapsed to 17.5% from 26.3% and PAT fell 41.7% to ₹53cr on weaker product mix and higher costs. H1 revenue rose 6.4% to ₹934cr but PAT fell 32.9% to ₹104cr. Offsetting this, order booking hit a record ₹764cr (+17.2%) and closing order book reached ₹2,453cr (+10.5%), with aftermarket orders doubling; management expects margin pressure to ease in H2.
filings.impactWhy: Sales down 3% YoY; order record alone does not trigger criteria

filings.headline: Alivus closes IQGEN-X deal; buys 65.01% stake, now a subsidiary
filings.summary: Alivus has initiated closing of the SPA to acquire a 76% stake in IQGEN-X Pharma Private Limited, acquiring 7,36,096 shares (65.01% of IQGEN-X) so far, with the rest to follow. IQGEN-X becomes a subsidiary with effect from today. This completes a previously announced acquisition (August 18, 2026 letter).
filings.impactWhy: Routine closing of previously announced acquisition

filings.headline: Promoters to give ₹60cr interest-free unsecured loans to Glottis
filings.summary: Board approved availing unsecured, interest-free loans of up to ₹60cr from the two MDs/promoters (₹30cr each) for working capital, in tranches with tenure up to 5 years. The deal is a related-party transaction and the company states it is not at arm's length as the loans are interest-free. Size is about 7.6% of ₹790cr yearly sales; funding is cost-free to the company but flagged as a non-arm's-length RPT.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter loan to company; not a purchase or sale of shares

filings.headline: Madras HC dismisses Tamil Nadu's appeal; DCW keeps disputed lands
filings.summary: The Madras High Court (Madurai Bench) by order dated November 3, 2026 dismissed the Tamil Nadu Government's Writ Appeal WA(MD) 1436/2025, upholding the earlier order that DCW cannot be evicted and must be allowed to buy the lands at government-determined market value. The court found proprietary estoppel fully established and no merit in the appeal. The favourable outcome removes a resumption/eviction risk to the company's land, though no financial figure is disclosed.
filings.impactWhy: Favourable court ruling upholding land possession lacks disclosed financial impact

filings.headline: Preferential issue of 39L warrants to promoters at ₹164 (₹64cr)
filings.summary: Board allotted 39,00,000 fully convertible warrants to promoters on a preferential basis at ₹164 each, total ₹63.96cr, convertible within 18 months; 25% (₹15.99cr) received upfront. Bulk goes to Tati Balakrishna (27,00,000). Full conversion adds ~2.66% more shares (3.9L on 14.65cr), about 2.59% dilution to existing holders; issue price ₹164 is a slight premium to the current ₹159.96.
filings.impactWhy: Preferential warrant issue causes ~2.6% dilution, below 5% threshold

filings.headline: Q2 revenue +23% to ₹267cr, PAT +43%; ₹1,000cr new order book over 5 yrs
filings.summary: TACL posted its strongest-ever quarter: Q2 FY27 revenue ₹267.5cr (+23% YoY), EBITDA ₹47.2cr (+33%, margin 17.6%), PAT ₹32.9cr (+43%); H1 revenue ₹509.7cr (+19%), PAT ₹63cr (+39%). With JVs it has secured new orders over ₹1,000cr (incl. ~₹700cr exports, ₹100cr EV) to execute over five years, against yearly sales of ~₹902cr. Management guides H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1, a positive guidance signal.
filings.impactWhy: New orders over ₹1,000cr exceed yearly sales alongside positive guidance

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue up 52.8% to ₹142cr; normalised PAT ₹24cr, up 52.2%
filings.summary: Rentomojo reported Q2 FY27 Revenue from Operations of ₹1,421 million, up 52.8% YoY, with normalised EBITDA up 52.7% to ₹588 million and normalised PAT up 52.2% to ₹240 million. H1 FY27 operating cash flow was ₹1,099.7 million (109.8% of reported EBITDA); net debt fell to ₹1,306 million and net worth rose to ₹4,662 million post-IPO. These are the company's second results after its September 2026 listing, showing strong broad-based growth and improving balance-sheet metrics.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly earnings results without guidance change or record turnover

filings.headline: Declared L-1 bidder for NBCC Srinagar township EPC order worth ₹901cr
filings.summary: Dilip Buildcon has been declared L-1 bidder for NBCC's 'Development of Satellite Township Phase-I, Package-3' at Srinagar (J&K) on EPC basis, worth ₹901.43cr including GST, to be completed in 24 months plus 2 years O&M. The order is about 10.3% of last 12 months' sales of ₹8,742cr, making it sizeable. Note it is an L-1 (lowest bidder) status, not yet a formal award.
filings.impactWhy: L-1 EPC order win exceeds 10% of annual sales

filings.headline: MD Arvind Nanda elevated to Executive Chairperson; CEO Garg made MD & CEO
filings.summary: Interarch's Board approved elevating Arvind Nanda from Managing Director to Whole-Time Director designated Executive Chairperson, and Manish Kumar Garg from Executive Director & CEO to Managing Director & CEO, both for 5-year terms from 05 Nov 2026 (subject to shareholder approval). Ms. Sonali Bhagwati Dalal resigned as Chairperson but stays on as Non-Executive Independent Director. Auditors flagged an emphasis of matter on an Income Tax search/survey (Aug 2025) under Sections 132/133A.
filings.impactWhy: Exit of chairperson and appointment of new MD & CEO

filings.headline: Q2 revenue ₹863cr (+14.6% QoQ); order book ₹10,940cr; CRISIL upgraded to A+
filings.summary: Q2 FY27 standalone revenue rose 14.6% QoQ to ₹863cr with PAT of ₹52cr and EBITDA margin 10.2%; consolidated order book grew 10.2% to ₹10,940cr. New wins include a ₹412cr IR wagon order plus ₹349cr/₹337cr/₹25cr recent orders and large South Africa contracts (₹4,045cr + ₹1,282cr) — large versus ₹3,834cr yearly sales. CRISIL upgraded the long-term rating to A+/Stable, reinforcing the diversification and growth case.
filings.impactWhy: Credit rating upgraded to A+ by CRISIL

filings.headline: TACC gets ₹609.5cr ECMS incentive for synthetic graphite anode plant in Dewas
filings.summary: HEG's wholly owned subsidiary TACC received an approval letter for a ₹609.50cr incentive under MeitY's ECMS for its synthetic graphite anode material project at Dewas, MP. The incentive is large versus yearly sales of ~₹1985cr (~31%) and backs a new battery-materials business line, with phase-one 20,000 MTPA targeted by June 2027 and committed scaling beyond 30,000 MTPA by FY2028-29.
filings.impactWhy: Government subsidy incentive approval, not an order or acquisition

filings.headline: Board gives in-principle nod to migrate from NSE Emerge SME to Main Board
filings.summary: Vinyas's board gave in-principle approval on 11 Nov 2026 to migrate its equity shares from the NSE Emerge SME platform to the NSE Main Board, plus listing on BSE. The move is subject to shareholder, statutory and regulatory approvals. A main-board shift typically widens the investor base and improves liquidity for the ~1.26cr shares.
filings.impactWhy: Migration from SME platform to main board is routine procedural milestone

filings.headline: Q2FY27 results: prior-period errors restated under Ind AS 8
filings.summary: Titagarh reported Q2 (Sept 2026) standalone revenue of ~₹772cr and profit of ₹63.44cr; half-year PAT ₹115.43cr. Auditors drew attention to Note 4, flagging a restatement of prior-period comparatives correcting certain prior-period errors under Ind AS 8. The error correction/restatement is the notable item, warranting attention on accounting controls even though the review conclusion was unmodified.
filings.impactWhy: Prior-period error restatement with unmodified auditor review conclusion.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 29.6% to ₹294cr but margins squeezed; EBITDA pressure flagged ahead
filings.summary: Standalone Q2FY27 revenue hit a record ₹294.3cr (+29.6% YoY) and H1 ₹530.7cr (+20.1%), but EBITDA margin fell to 8.2% and PAT of ₹14.5cr included a ₹2.7cr one-off from the Dehradun plant sale. Consolidated EBITDA margin was just 4.3% as Elventive France integration, raw-material costs and adverse mix weigh; management expects consolidated EBITDA margins to stay under pressure over the next few quarters. Order book of ₹795.2cr (about 76% of ₹1043cr yearly sales) gives revenue visibility, but the explicit margin-pressure guidance is a red flag.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly earnings with margin pressure; not a formal standalone guidance revision.

filings.headline: Q2 PAT up 167% y/y to ₹20.7cr; revenue up 17.6% to ₹134.8cr
filings.summary: Matrimony.com posted consolidated Q2FY27 (quarter ended Sept 30, 2026) revenue of ₹134.8cr (up 17.6% y/y, 3.3% q/q) and PAT of ₹20.7cr (up 167.3% y/y, 8.6% q/q). Billing rose 10.7% y/y to ₹131.1cr and the company added 3.02 lakh paid subscriptions (up 26.6% y/y). The sharp profit growth and sustained double-digit revenue growth strengthen the earnings trajectory against ~₹476cr annual sales.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly revenue growth of 18% is not sharply higher.

filings.headline: Matrimony to buy extra 50% of Astro-Vision for ₹8cr, raising stake to 76.09%
filings.summary: Board approved acquiring an additional 50% stake in associate Astro-Vision Futuretech (from 26.09% to 76.09%), making it a subsidiary, for ₹8cr all-cash. Astro-Vision had FY26 revenue of ₹20.57cr (FY25 ₹20.02cr, FY24 ₹21.65cr), about 4% of Matrimony's ₹476cr yearly sales. Astrology is core to match-making, so the deal adds strategic synergies; completion expected in about 3 months.
filings.impactWhy: Small acquisition size of ₹8cr relative to company scale.

filings.headline: Board OKs up to €2m (~₹18cr) corporate guarantee to related-party Elventive France
filings.summary: Board approved issuing a corporate guarantee/standby letter of credit of up to EUR 2 million (about ₹18cr) in favour of subsidiary Elventive France, a related party in which promoter-group entity Elventive Tech holds 20% and promoters Suramya/Akshada Nevatia with Caelora Capital hold 14%. It is a contingent liability stated at arm's length with no present impact; the sum is roughly 1.8% of yearly sales. The board also approved unaudited Q2 results (revenue ₹294cr vs ₹227cr YoY) and a routine change of RTA from Adroit to Bigshare.
filings.impactWhy: Routine corporate guarantee of ₹18cr to subsidiary.

filings.headline: Subsidiary Kinam bags USD 42-48M heat-exchanger order for N.American energy storage
filings.summary: HLE Glascoat's subsidiary Kinam Engineering won an order worth USD 42-48 Million (about ₹375-425cr) to design and supply specialized shell-and-tube heat exchangers for a large-scale North American energy storage project. That is roughly 28-31% of the group's ₹1367cr annual sales, a very large order to be executed progressively through November 2028. The customer is a leading international long-duration energy storage entity, name withheld for confidentiality.
filings.impactWhy: Order worth ₹375-425cr is approximately 30% of annual sales.

filings.headline: Buyback up to ₹130cr via open market at max ₹750/share (vs ₹596)
filings.summary: MedPlus will buy back equity shares from non-promoter shareholders through the open market route for up to ₹130cr at a price not exceeding ₹750/share, a premium to the current ₹596. The size is 9.87% of standalone paid-up capital and free reserves (within the 10% limit) and about 1.8% of market value; the buyback opens Nov 13, 2026. At the max price this covers roughly 0.17cr shares (about 1.4% of the 12.01cr shares in issue).
filings.impactWhy: Share buyback announced at significant premium to market price.

filings.headline: 50:50 JV with DCX Chrome, France for high-purity chromium metal (aero/defence)
filings.summary: Vishnu entered a 50:50 JV with DCX Chrome SAS, France to build a first-of-its-kind high-purity Chromium Metal facility in India for niche aerospace and defence applications, opening a new business line. Q2FY27 revenue was ₹429.5cr (+7% YoY) with PAT ₹35.5cr (+8.1%) and EBITDA +10%; H1FY27 PAT rose 15.5% to ₹75.2cr. The company's credit profile improved, with ICRA assigning A (Stable) versus the earlier CARE A- (Stable); consolidated D/E at 0.67x.
filings.impactWhy: JV and rating transition from different agency are not major price movers.

filings.headline: WOS Alcon declared L1 for ₹103.58cr railway signalling order
filings.summary: GPT Infraprojects' wholly-owned subsidiary Alcon Builders & Engineers has been declared L1 (lowest bidder) in an order worth ₹103.58cr from CSTE, North Eastern Railway for Electronic Interlocking and signalling work in the Varanasi Division. The order is about 8% of the ₹1292cr trailing 12-month sales, a meaningful addition to the order book. Being L1 is a step toward award but not yet a confirmed contract.
filings.impactWhy: L1 status for order below the 10% annual sales threshold.

filings.headline: Promoter pledged 0.56% of shares (₹8.2cr)
filings.summary: Promoter and Director Ashish Subhash Dandekar pledged 10,80,000 shares (0.56% of the company) valued at ₹8.2cr at an average price of ₹76.0, compared to the current price of ₹78.5. His shareholding remains unchanged at 10.3% before to 10.3% after the pledge.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter pledged shares; any new pledge or increase is high impact.

filings.headline: Ashoka Buildcon wins ₹865.9cr NHAI expressway EPC order
filings.summary: Ashoka Buildcon received an LoA from NHAI for balance work on the 8-lane Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway (Karvad to Jujuwa, Pkg-IX) in Gujarat, with an accepted EPC price of ₹865.90 crore excluding GST. The order is about 12% of last 12 months' sales of ₹7132cr, to be executed over 18 months with a 10-year defect liability period. A sizeable addition to the order book.
filings.impactWhy: Order win of ₹865.9cr is ~12% of annual sales (above 10% threshold).

filings.headline: CFO Rahul Agarwal resigns effective November 9, 2026
filings.summary: Rahul Agarwal has resigned as Chief Financial Officer (KMP) of EPACK Prefab Technologies, effective close of business on November 9, 2026, citing personal reasons and other professional opportunities. His resignation was tendered via letter dated July 15, 2026. A CFO departure is a senior management change and leaves the role vacant with no successor named in the filing.
filings.impactWhy: CFO resignation is a key management exit.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 14% to ₹1,873cr but EBITDA margin down 140bps to 2.1%
filings.summary: Consolidated Q2 FY26-27 revenue rose 14% YoY to ₹1,873cr, but EBITDA fell to ₹40cr (2.1% margin, down 140bps) and PBT before exceptionals to ₹34cr (1.8%, down 110bps) on commodity inflation, currency and new energy-regulation costs. The company took a ~5% price increase effective Nov 1, 2026, and Elica subsidiary grew revenue 12% and PBT 22%. Strong top line but notable margin compression.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial performance summary.

filings.headline: Subsidiary JPEPL wins ₹63cr order from Jindal Steel; group order book tops ₹1,000cr
filings.summary: Jash's subsidiary JPEPL secured its largest-ever order worth over ₹63cr from Jindal Steel, about 8% of ₹794cr yearly sales, lifting its order book to nearly ₹100cr. With this, Jash Engineering's consolidated order book has crossed ₹1,000cr for the first time. The company reiterated its target of exceeding ₹1,500cr revenue by 2031.
filings.impactWhy: Order represents ~8% of yearly sales, below the 10% threshold.

filings.headline: Vivid bags ₹24.25cr order for SCADA panels for Noida data center
filings.summary: Vivid Electromech received purchase orders totaling Rs. 24.25 crores (approx, excluding taxes) from Secutech Automation (India) Pvt. Ltd. for supply of SCADA and automation panels for a data center project in Noida, to be executed within 3 months. The order is about 6.2% of the company's ₹394cr yearly sales, a meaningful win. It is a domestic, non-related-party order.
filings.impactWhy: Order represents ~6.2% of annual sales, below 10% threshold.

filings.headline: Subsidiary JAEL signs deal for 40% of Zettaone, entering EDMS sector
filings.summary: Jubilant Ingrevia's WOS JAEL executed the Share Subscription and Purchase Agreement for a 40% strategic stake in Zettaone Technologies India, with an option to raise it to 51% in FY28. This marks the company's entry into the Electronics Design and Manufacturing Services (EDMS) sector, a new business line serving semiconductors, aerospace & defense and automotive. Deal value and terms were disclosed in the earlier Oct 1 letter and not restated here.
filings.impactWhy: Execution of previously disclosed acquisition agreement.

filings.headline: CRISIL upgrade to BBB+/Stable; record order book ₹768cr, H1 PAT +23%
filings.summary: CRISIL upgraded SWPEL's rating to BBB+/Stable/A2 from BBB/Positive/A3+ during H1 FY27. Order book hit an all-time high of ₹767cr (~2.9x the ₹264cr annual sales), and H1 revenue grew 16% YoY to ₹119.4cr with PAT up 23% to ₹13.3cr. The upgrade plus record visibility strengthens the credit and growth case.
filings.impactWhy: Credit rating upgraded by CRISIL from BBB to BBB+.

filings.headline: GPCB revokes fire-plant direction; grants CC&A for new MPP-5 at Dahej SEZ
filings.summary: Following the March 2025 fire at its Dahej SEZ MPP3 plant, Neogen received a GPCB order on Nov 7, 2026 revoking the earlier direction (which had imposed Rs 34.60 lakh EDC and a Rs 7.5 lakh bank guarantee) after DISH clearance. GPCB also granted a provisional CC&A amendment valid to March 2030 for the replacement MPP-5 plant, now in trial production adjacent to the affected site. This resolves the regulatory restriction and clears operations at the rebuilt facility, though the original plant location is now open land.
filings.impactWhy: Routine regulatory clearance and revocation of earlier minor direction.

filings.headline: Promoter bought 0.05% (₹7.0cr) at about ₹698
filings.summary: Promoter Riddhi Portfolio Private Limited bought a 0.05% stake (1,00,000 shares) for ₹7.0cr via a market purchase at an average price of ₹698, compared to the current price of ₹694. This increased their holding from 34.1% to 34.2%.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter market purchase of shares.

filings.headline: Promoter bought 0.77% (₹5.4cr) at about ₹180
filings.summary: Promoter Jitendrakumar Jashbhai Patel bought a 0.77% stake (3,00,150 shares) off market for ₹5.4 crore at an average price of ₹180 per share, compared to the current price of ₹195. This purchase increased his holding from 9.0% to 9.8%.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter acquired 0.77% stake.

filings.headline: India Ratings revises credit rating outlook to Negative (IND BBB+)
filings.summary: India Ratings reaffirmed Vikran Engineering's rating at 'IND BBB+' but revised the outlook from 'Stable' to 'Negative' on ₹470 crore bank facilities and ₹100 crore NCDs, while assigning 'IND BBB+/Negative' to ₹150 crore proposed NCDs. The revision reflects substantial equity infusion requirements and elevated working capital intensity with high fund-based limit utilisation in 1HFY27. The company noted that recent financial closure of a solar SPV is expected to support liquidity.
filings.impactWhy: Rating reaffirmed; outlook revision is excluded.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue up 85% YoY to ₹119.5cr; PBT down 25% to ₹8.49cr
filings.summary: Standalone revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 jumped 84.9% YoY to ₹119.46 crore from ₹64.61 crore (and up 57.6% QoQ). Profit before tax fell 25.2% YoY to ₹8.49 crore from ₹11.35 crore, driven by a sharp rise in stock-in-trade purchases. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue reached ₹195.28 crore with PBT of ₹15.22 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine financial results.

filings.headline: India Ratings upgrades bank loan rating to IND A+/Positive/IND A1+
filings.summary: India Ratings and Research has upgraded Manorama Industries' credit rating for its ₹496.77 crore bank loan facilities to IND A+/Positive/IND A1+. The upgrade reflects improved financial strength and borrowing terms across its bank facilities.
filings.impactWhy: Credit rating upgraded to IND A+.

filings.headline: Q2 standalone net profit down 53% YoY to ₹178.5cr on 28% drop in revenue
filings.summary: Standalone revenue from operations for Q2 ended September 30, 2026, fell 28.3% YoY to ₹862.94cr from ₹1,203.16cr. Standalone net profit declined 53.3% YoY to ₹178.46cr compared to ₹382.20cr in the prior-year period, with basic EPS dropping to ₹6.44 from ₹13.78. Sequentially, revenue grew 39.3% from ₹619.54cr and net profit rose 69.2% from ₹105.47cr in Q1.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Secured landmark ₹300cr 7-year order from Stellantis N.V.
filings.summary: Remsons Industries reported securing a ₹300 crore (₹3,000 mn), 7-year control cable order from Stellantis, alongside an estimated ₹160 crore lifetime pedal box programme in the UK. The Stellantis contract alone represents over 61% of last 12 months' sales of ~₹489 crore. For Q2, consolidated revenue rose 17% YoY to ₹135.5 crore with net profit of ₹4.7 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Order value represents over 61% of annual sales.

filings.headline: Allots 60.8 lakh warrants worth ₹289cr to promoters at ₹475
filings.summary: The board approved allotting 60,82,600 warrants at ₹475 each to the promoter group, raising up to ₹288.92cr, with ₹75.12cr (26%) received upfront. Upon full conversion, this adds 9.33% more shares, resulting in an 8.53% dilution to existing holders and taking promoter holding to 46.69%. The warrant issue price of ₹475 represents a 5.0% discount to the current share price of ₹500.20.
filings.impactWhy: Preferential warrant issue involves 8.53% equity dilution.

filings.headline: Secured EPC work order for 285 MWp solar power project
filings.summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies has received a commercial work order for engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) of a 285 MWp solar power project from a leading domestic Independent Power Producer. The project is scheduled to be completed during FY 2027-28. The company did not disclose the financial value of the contract.
filings.impactWhy: Order value not disclosed.

filings.headline: Material subsidiary IL JIN Electronics files DRHP for proposed IPO
filings.summary: Amber Enterprises announced that its material subsidiary, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, has filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) with SEBI, BSE, and NSE for a proposed Initial Public Offer. The offering remains subject to regulatory approvals. The filing does not disclose the proposed issue size or dilution terms.
filings.impactWhy: Subsidiary IPO filing without disclosed transaction size.

filings.headline: TPG to invest up to ₹800cr in subsidiary Arka Fincap
filings.summary: TPG's The Rise Funds will invest up to ₹800 crore in KOEL's NBFC subsidiary, Arka Fincap, comprising ₹525 crore in tranche 1 and ₹275 crore in tranche 2 via equity and CCPS. Post-investment, KOEL's indirect holding in Arka Fincap will dilute from 90.28% to 68.59% after tranche 1 and to 62.61% after tranche 2. Arka Fincap currently has an AUM of approximately ₹8,000 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Fund-raise at subsidiary level without parent dilution.

filings.headline: 400 MW TOPCon module line starts commercial production, taking capacity to 1.2 GW
filings.summary: The company commenced commercial production at its second 400 MW TOPCon module line on October 13, 2026, scaling total module capacity to 1.2 GW. For H1, total income rose 45.05% YoY to ₹439.41 crore and PAT increased 15.80% to ₹33.12 crore. The company also announced entry into battery energy storage systems (BESS) via its 90%-owned subsidiary.
filings.impactWhy: Incremental module capacity expansion.

filings.headline: TPG to invest up to ₹800cr in Arka Fincap; KOEL stake cut to 62.6%
filings.summary: KOEL's board approved and executed a Shareholders' Agreement for TPG (The Rise Funds) to invest in step-down NBFC subsidiary Arka Fincap: ₹525cr first tranche and a further ₹275cr second tranche (total up to ₹800cr) via equity and compulsorily convertible preference shares. KOEL's holding through AFHPL falls from 90.279% to 68.587% after tranche one and to 62.607% after tranche two. Arka has ~₹8,000cr AUM and is CRISIL AA/Stable; the filing states no impact on KOEL's own management or control.
filings.impactWhy: Subsidiary-level minority dilution through external fundraise.

filings.headline: Promoter group sold 4.4% (₹258cr) at about ₹160
filings.summary: Promoters Ram Chandra Agarwal and Ricon Commodities Private Limited sold 4.4% of the company (1,61,25,000 shares) for ₹258cr in a block deal at an average price of ₹160, compared to the current price of ₹174. This sale reduced their combined holding from 40.4% to 36.0%.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter group sold a 4.4% stake in a block deal.

filings.headline: Amit Srivastava appointed CEO of SSD & ASEAN Business
filings.summary: Minda Corporation has appointed Amit Srivastava as CEO of its SSD & ASEAN Business, effective November 6, 2026. He is designated as Senior Management Personnel and brings over three decades of experience in the automotive and manufacturing sectors.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of business unit CEO, not company-level CEO or MD.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue falls 55% to ₹141cr; order book surges to ₹2,698cr
filings.summary: Q2 total revenue dropped 55% YoY to ₹141.44cr, with PAT falling 55% to ₹21.97cr. However, the company recorded massive fresh order inflows of ₹929cr during the quarter (nearly matching its ₹941cr yearly sales), taking its total order book including negotiated orders to ₹2,698cr.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly earnings results announcement.

filings.headline: Positive Phase 2b trial results for Saroglitazar in MASH patients
filings.summary: Zydus announced positive Phase 2b clinical trial results for investigational drug Saroglitazar in adults with MASH and fibrosis. The data showed that 39.1% of patients receiving the 4 mg dose achieved resolution of steatohepatitis without worsening of fibrosis, compared to 13.7% on placebo. The treatment was generally well tolerated, supporting further evaluation in larger studies.
filings.impactWhy: Clinical trial results announcement without regulatory approval or ban.

filings.headline: Shareholders reject proposed ESOP and RSU Scheme 2026
filings.summary: Shareholders have rejected special resolutions to implement the company's ESOP and RSU Scheme 2026 and extend grants to subsidiary employees. The proposals failed to secure the required 75% approval, receiving only 53.46% votes in favour and 46.54% against.
filings.impactWhy: Shareholder rejection of employee stock option scheme.

filings.headline: Allotted shares and warrants to raise ₹90 crore at ₹135 each
filings.summary: Manba Finance has allotted 42.59 lakh equity shares to public investors and 24.07 lakh fully convertible warrants to promoters at an issue price of ₹135 each, raising a total of ₹90 crore. The issue price is slightly below the current market price of ₹142.89. Full conversion of the warrants will increase the total share count by 13.3%, causing an 11.7% dilution for existing shareholders.
filings.impactWhy: Preferential issue and warrant allotment causing 11.7% dilution.

filings.headline: Madhavan Hariharan appointed as CEO and MD
filings.summary: Birlasoft has appointed Madhavan Hariharan as its Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director, effective December 8, 2026. He succeeds Angan Guha in the role. Hariharan was previously the Group CFO of the CK Birla Group and has been closely associated with Birlasoft's leadership team.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of new Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director.

filings.headline: Samar Vijay Pupala appointed CFO; Venkatesh Ramachandran elevated to Strategy Officer
filings.summary: Venkatesh Ramachandran has stepped down as Group CFO to be elevated to Group Chief Strategy and Transformation Officer. Samar Vijay Pupala, an executive with over 30 years of experience, has been appointed as the new Chief Financial Officer effective November 6, 2026.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of new Chief Financial Officer.

filings.headline: Jayant Balan to succeed Mukundan Menon as MD; Noel Tata to retire as Chairman
filings.summary: Voltas has announced a planned leadership succession. Mr. Noel N. Tata will retire as Chairman on November 11, 2026, and will be succeeded by Mr. Sunil Alaric D’Souza. Additionally, Mr. Jayant Balan will take over from Mr. Mukundan Menon as Managing Director for a five-year term starting May 25, 2027.
filings.impactWhy: Succession and appointment of Managing Director and Chairman.

filings.headline: USFDA issues 3 observations for subsidiary's Baddi facility
filings.summary: The US FDA inspected the formulations manufacturing facility of wholly owned subsidiary Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited in Baddi from November 2 to 6, 2026. The inspection resulted in three Form 483 observations, none of which relate to data integrity. The company expects no financial or operational impact and will work to resolve the points.
filings.impactWhy: USFDA Form 483 observations without data integrity issues.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 PAT jumps 58% YoY to ₹291cr, revenue rises 23% to ₹1,834cr
filings.summary: Gland Pharma reported strong Q2 FY27 results with revenue of ₹1,834 crore (up 23% YoY) and profit after tax of ₹291 crore (up 58% YoY). The company also secured new CDMO contracts for microspheres and respiratory products, and announced that its Dundigal facility received four procedural observations from a recent USFDA audit.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly financial results announcement.

filings.headline: October 2026 monthly sales update
filings.summary: The company released its monthly sales update for October 2026. Key volume changes on a YoY basis included a 20.4% increase in Stainless Steel to 7,671 MT, a 78% increase in Carbon Steel (Flat) to 23,968 MT, and a 15.8% decrease in Carbon Steel (Long) to 1,11,926 MT. Average realizations increased across all product segments compared to the same month last year.
filings.impactWhy: Routine monthly volume update with mixed product trends.

filings.headline: CARE upgrades long-term credit rating to AA; Stable
filings.summary: CARE Ratings has upgraded the company's credit rating for its long-term bank facilities to CARE AA; Stable from CARE AA-; Stable. The rating for short-term bank facilities and commercial paper was reaffirmed at CARE A1+.
filings.impactWhy: CARE upgraded long-term credit rating to AA.

filings.headline: Satish Kumar Kaushik appointed as Chief Financial Officer
filings.summary: CMR Green Technologies has announced the appointment of Satish Kumar Kaushik as its Chief Financial Officer, effective November 6, 2026. This fills a key senior financial leadership position at the company.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of new Chief Financial Officer.

filings.headline: MobiKwik subsidiary secures RBI registration for NBFC operations
filings.summary: MobiKwik's wholly owned subsidiary has received the Certificate of Registration from the RBI to operate as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC). The company expects to commence operations in 3-6 months using an asset-light co-lending model and aims to disburse ₹5,000 crore in loans over the next three to four years.
filings.impactWhy: Grant of NBFC license to subsidiary.

filings.headline: Won 3-year ONGC contract for rig deployment at ₹52 lakh per day
filings.summary: Jindal Drilling has received an award from ONGC to deploy its rig Discovery-I for three years. The contract is at an Effective Day Rate of ₹52 lakh (USD 54,633), which implies an estimated total value of roughly ₹569 crore. This is a substantial win, equivalent to about 56% of the company's yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Three-year contract worth approximately 56% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Starts commercial production at Gujarat Phase-2, adding 20,000 MT capacity
filings.summary: The company has commenced commercial production at Phase-2 of its Kheda, Gujarat Unit-1 facility on November 5, 2026. This expansion adds 20,000 MT, raising total installed manufacturing capacity from 245,000 MT to 265,000 MT. The Rs 15 crore project was funded through internal accruals and IPO proceeds.
filings.impactWhy: Capacity addition is small relative to total installed capacity.

filings.headline: Inaugurated new greenfield technical textiles facility
filings.summary: Kanpur Plastipack has inaugurated a new greenfield manufacturing facility for non-woven fabrics in Kanpur Dehat. This marks the company's expansion into a new segment with applications in automotive interiors, geo-textiles, artificial leather, and other industrial sectors.
filings.impactWhy: Greenfield facility inauguration without significant disclosed scale.

filings.headline: Wholly owned subsidiary receives approval for ₹609.5cr manufacturing incentive
filings.summary: HEG's wholly owned subsidiary, TACC Limited, has received approval for an incentive of ₹609.50 crore under the government's Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS). The incentive is for its Anode Material manufacturing project in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh. The approved amount is substantial, equivalent to about 23% of the company's trailing 12-month sales.
filings.impactWhy: Government scheme incentive approval for subsidiary.

filings.headline: Board approves sale of an unused land plot for ₹20.67 crore
filings.summary: Sirca Paints has agreed to sell an unused 3,899 sq. mt. plot in Sonipat, Haryana to Dawer Propack for a total consideration of ₹20.67 crore. The sale, which represents about 4% of the company's yearly sales, is expected to be completed by November 30, 2026.
filings.impactWhy: Land sale represents only 4% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Secures 5.5-acre mixed-use land parcel in Noida for ₹272cr
filings.summary: Max Estates has successfully bid for a 5.5-acre land parcel in Sector 132, Noida, for approximately ₹272 crore. The mixed-use project is estimated to generate a Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹1,500-2,000 crore. This is a highly material acquisition, as the land cost alone exceeds the company's trailing 12-month sales of about ₹200 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Land acquisition cost exceeds company's annual sales.

filings.headline: Appointment of Mangesh Vaze as Chief Operating Officer
filings.summary: Supriya Lifescience has appointed Mr. Mangesh Vaze as Chief Operating Officer (COO) and Senior Management Personnel, effective November 6, 2026. He has over 34 years of experience in API manufacturing and operations at companies including Zydus, Cipla, and Lupin.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of COO, not CEO, MD, CFO, or Chairman.

filings.headline: Board approves ₹130cr open-market share buyback at up to ₹750/share
filings.summary: The board has approved an open-market share buyback of up to ₹130 crore at a maximum price of ₹750 per share. The buyback will cover an indicative 17.33 lakh shares, representing 1.44% of the company's paid-up equity capital. The maximum price is at a premium to the current market price of about ₹605.
filings.impactWhy: Board approved open-market share buyback of ₹130 crore.

filings.headline: Vishal Begwani appointed CFO as Nilesh Hirapara transitions to larger Group role
filings.summary: Nilesh Hirapara has stepped down as Chief Financial Officer to take on an elevated role within the Group. The company has appointed Vishal Begwani, who brings over 20 years of experience and was formerly CFO of EIMCO Elecon, as the new CFO effective November 6, 2026.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of new Chief Financial Officer.

filings.headline: Secured erection contract worth ₹492 crore in Saudi Arabia
filings.summary: Power Mech Projects' Saudi Arabian subsidiary has secured an erection contract worth ₹492 crore, including optional work. The order represents about 7.7% of the company's yearly sales and is to be executed over 20 months starting January 2027.
filings.impactWhy: Order value represents 7.7% of yearly sales, below 10% threshold.

filings.headline: Signed 10-year take-or-pay CDMO contract with a European innovator
filings.summary: Symbiotec has signed a 10-year take-or-pay contract development and manufacturing agreement with a European alternative protein innovator. The deal reserves dedicated capacity at the company's Ujjain biomanufacturing campus for the full term, starting with existing facilities and expanding to a new dedicated plant. Financial details were not disclosed due to confidentiality obligations.
filings.impactWhy: CDMO contract without disclosed contract value.

filings.headline: Raised FY27 bookings guidance to ₹2,600-2,700cr (70-75% growth)
filings.summary: Arvind SmartSpaces has upgraded its FY27 bookings guidance to ₹2,600-2,700 crore, up from the earlier target of ₹2,100-2,200 crore, aiming for 70-75% year-on-year growth. The company reported record Q2 bookings of ₹906 crore and reiterated its EBITDA margin guidance of 22-25%.
filings.impactWhy: Upward revision of FY27 annual bookings guidance.

filings.headline: TGPCB orders closure of Suryapet manufacturing site after fatal accident
filings.summary: The Telangana State Pollution Control Board has ordered the company to suspend manufacturing at its Suryapet site with immediate effect. The closure order follows an industrial accident that resulted in the death of an employee. The company is assessing the financial impact and taking corrective measures to seek cancellation of the order.
filings.impactWhy: Pollution control board ordered immediate shutdown of manufacturing plant.

filings.headline: Q2 PAT falls 42% YoY to ₹29.3cr as EBITDA margin drops to 22%
filings.summary: Revenue grew 3.2% YoY to ₹206.30 crore in Q2 FY27, but EBITDA declined 37.5% to ₹45.40 crore with margins contracting from 36.4% to 22.0%. Profit after tax dropped 42.0% YoY to ₹29.25 crore, hit by regulatory shifts in LATAM, high raw material and solvent costs, and ramp-up expenses at the Ambernath site. Finished dosage commercial production has commenced at the Ambernath facility, and H1 FY27 revenue stood at ₹396.04 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Shareholder nod sought for material related-party deals with Neogen Morita
filings.summary: Neogen Chemicals has issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for material related-party transactions with its step-down subsidiary, Neogen Morita New Materials Limited. The transactions involve both the parent company and its wholly owned subsidiary, Neogen Ionics Limited. Voting runs from November 7, 2026 to December 6, 2026; specific transaction values were not disclosed in the notice extract.
filings.impactWhy: Routine related-party transaction approval notice.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 31.6% YoY to ₹188cr; standalone PAT down 6.6% to ₹30.8cr
filings.summary: Azad Engineering reported standalone revenue from operations of ₹187.80cr for Q2 ended September 30, 2026, up 31.6% YoY from ₹142.67cr. Net profit for the quarter declined 6.6% YoY to ₹30.82cr from ₹32.99cr due to higher finance and depreciation costs, with basic EPS at ₹4.77 versus ₹5.11 a year ago. For the half year, revenue reached ₹358.32cr and net profit stood at ₹67.17cr.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Seeks shareholder approval to divest Tritium business
filings.summary: Exicom Tele-Systems has issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval to divest its Tritium business. The sale will be executed either via the divestment of its entire stake in material subsidiary Exicom Power Solutions B.V. (Netherlands) or through that subsidiary selling its stake in the target entities. Voting runs from November 7 to December 6, 2026.
filings.impactWhy: Postal ballot seeking approval for proposed divestment.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 PAT up 50% YoY to ₹48cr; revenue up 14% to ₹2,746cr
filings.summary: Voltas reported consolidated total income of ₹2,746 crore for Q2 FY27, up 13.8% YoY from ₹2,412 crore. Net profit rose 50% YoY to ₹48 crore from ₹32 crore, driven by 29% revenue growth in Unitary Cooling Products and 32% volume growth in Room ACs. For H1 FY27, PAT grew 51% YoY to ₹260 crore on total income of ₹7,511 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Q2 standalone revenue fell 32% YoY to ₹397cr; PAT up 10% to ₹45.7cr
filings.summary: Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 declined 32.4% YoY to ₹397.19 crore (vs ₹587.93 crore in Q2 FY26), though it rebounded 20.8% QoQ from ₹328.81 crore. Profit after tax rose 10.3% YoY to ₹45.65 crore (vs ₹41.40 crore in Q2 FY26) and 42.6% sequentially from ₹32.01 crore. For H1, revenue was down 19.7% YoY to ₹725.99 crore while net profit grew 9.2% YoY to ₹77.66 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Wholly owned subsidiary receives RBI license to operate as an NBFC
filings.summary: MobiKwik Financial Services Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of One MobiKwik Systems, has received a Certificate of Registration from the RBI to operate as an NBFC. The subsidiary plans to launch an asset-light co-lending model in partnership with banks and NBFCs within three to six months. The license is perpetual and enables greater product flexibility and improved lending margins.
filings.impactWhy: Receipt of routine regulatory operating license.

filings.headline: Sirca Paints to sell Kundli plot for ₹20.67 crore
filings.summary: Sirca Paints has approved the sale of an unused 3,899.70 sq. metre plot in Kundli, Haryana, to Dawer Propack Private Limited for ₹20.67 crore. The transaction is expected to be completed by November 30, 2026. The company noted that no business operations were conducted on the property, so the sale will have no impact on operations.
filings.impactWhy: Small non-core land sale with no operational impact.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 PAT up 12% YoY to ₹20.3cr; revenue up 22% to ₹160.2cr
filings.summary: Revenue from operations rose 22.1% YoY to ₹160.20 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to ₹131.17 crore in the year-ago period. Net profit increased 12.3% YoY to ₹20.33 crore from ₹18.10 crore, with basic EPS rising to ₹3.58 from ₹3.24. For the half-year, revenue reached ₹290.20 crore with net profit of ₹36.53 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Q2 consolidated PAT up 65% YoY to ₹104.4cr; revenue rises 21% to ₹1,009cr
filings.summary: TTK Prestige reported Q2 consolidated revenue from operations of ₹1,008.96cr, up 21.0% YoY from ₹833.70cr. Consolidated net profit grew 65.3% YoY to ₹104.44cr (profit attributable to owners was ₹111.11cr vs ₹64.24cr in Q2 FY26). The company also recorded an exceptional impairment of ₹13.53cr on the planned divestment of its 51% subsidiary Ultrafresh Modular Solutions.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Q2 standalone net profit jumps 42% YoY to ₹128.9cr; revenue up 25%
filings.summary: Elgi Equipments reported standalone revenue from operations of ₹708.0 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, up 24.6% YoY from ₹568.2 crore. Net profit rose 42.0% YoY to ₹128.9 crore from ₹90.8 crore, driving basic EPS to ₹4.09 from ₹2.88. For the half-year, revenue reached ₹1,352.8 crore with net profit of ₹219.3 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Q2 consolidated revenue up 16.7% to ₹2,995cr; PAT rises 24.4% to ₹115.2cr
filings.summary: Godrej Agrovet reported consolidated revenue from operations of ₹2,994.98 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, up 16.7% from ₹2,567.42 crore in the year-ago period. Profit attributable to owners of the company grew 24.4% to ₹115.21 crore from ₹92.59 crore, with basic EPS rising to ₹5.99 from ₹4.81. For the first half of the year, consolidated revenue stood at ₹5,850.20 crore and attributable profit was ₹249.71 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: PCMC WtE facility disrupted; ₹20cr exceptional charge pushes Q2 to net loss
filings.summary: Antony Waste reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹330.3cr (up 25% YoY) but posted a net loss of ₹1.7cr compared to a ₹17.3cr profit last year. The loss was impacted by a ₹20cr exceptional item covering PPE impairment, restoration costs, and compensation following an incident in July 2026 that disrupted the PCMC Waste-to-Energy facility. Energy operations remain suspended and are expected to resume by December 2026.
filings.impactWhy: Plant disruption and suspended operations causing net loss.

filings.headline: Q2 net profit jumps 214% YoY to ₹16.00cr; revenue triples to ₹272.07cr
filings.summary: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations surged 211% YoY to ₹272.07cr (from ₹87.42cr in Q2 FY26), and net profit rose 214% YoY to ₹16.00cr (from ₹5.10cr). For the half year, revenue reached ₹483.29cr (up from ₹138.27cr) and net profit reached ₹29.97cr (up from ₹8.63cr). filings.summary: Rashi Peripherals reported its highest-ever quarterly profit in Q2 FY27, with net profit surging 120.8% YoY to ₹130.7 crore and revenue rising 48.8% to ₹6,185.1 crore. For H1 FY27, revenue rose 54.5% to ₹11,287 crore and PAT grew 94.6% to ₹235.3 crore. Profitability was driven by operating leverage and strategic expansion into enterprise digital infrastructure and semiconductor distribution.
