filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 24% YoY to ₹220cr; net profit flat at ₹7.7cr
filings.summary: Revenue from operations rose 23.9% YoY to ₹220.13 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, while net profit remained nearly flat at ₹7.70 crore compared to ₹7.64 crore a year earlier. For H1, revenue stood at ₹424.12 crore with net profit of ₹25.54 crore. The statutory auditor included an emphasis of matter regarding ongoing litigation over the recoverability of ₹26.36 crore in trade receivables, which management considers recoverable.
filings.impactWhy: Flat net profit and routine emphasis of matter, not a qualification.

filings.headline: Q2 consolidated revenue rose 12% to ₹1,063cr; PAT fell 47% to ₹52cr
filings.summary: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue from operations grew 11.6% YoY to ₹1,063.40 crore, while net profit attributable to shareholders declined 46.5% YoY to ₹51.64 crore (diluted EPS ₹5.41 vs ₹10.11). Profit before tax stood at ₹77.77 crore compared to ₹81.22 crore in the prior-year quarter. For the half year, revenue reached ₹2,679.52 crore with shareholder net profit of ₹166.98 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Moderate revenue growth alongside a decline in net profit.

filings.headline: Q2 standalone revenue up 23% YoY to ₹540cr; PAT jumps 59% to ₹45cr
filings.summary: TCPL Packaging reported standalone revenue from operations of ₹539.55 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, up 23.3% YoY from ₹437.70 crore. Profit after tax rose 59.2% YoY to ₹45.09 crore compared to ₹28.33 crore in the year-ago quarter, with basic EPS increasing to ₹49.55 from ₹31.13. For H1 FY27, revenue reached ₹1,013.51 crore (versus ₹847.16 crore) and net profit stood at ₹82.72 crore (versus ₹51.07 crore).
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly earnings growth within ordinary performance ranges.

filings.headline: Q2 standalone PAT surges 214% YoY to ₹206.5cr; revenue up 92% to ₹1,741cr
filings.summary: Standalone revenue from operations for Q2 ended September 30, 2026 jumped 92.5% YoY to ₹1,741.39 crore from ₹904.65 crore. Standalone profit after tax rose 214% YoY to ₹206.49 crore compared to ₹65.77 crore in the prior-year period. The board also approved acquiring a 30% stake in KGraph AI Solutions Private Limited for ₹45.39 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Exceptional growth with revenue up 92% and PAT surging 214% YoY.

filings.headline: Board declared interim dividend of ₹10 per share; record date Nov 13
filings.summary: The Board of Directors declared an interim dividend of ₹10 per equity share (100% of face value ₹10) for FY 2026-27. The record date for the payment is set for November 13, 2026. The total payout amounts to approximately ₹30.8 crore across roughly 3.08 crore shares, representing about 1.7% of the company's market value.
filings.impactWhy: Routine interim dividend representing only 1.7% dividend yield.

filings.headline: Q2 PAT surges to ₹90.4cr vs ₹1.4cr YoY; ₹10 interim dividend declared
filings.summary: IG Petrochem reported standalone Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹758.96 crore, up 63% YoY from ₹465.34 crore, with net profit rising to ₹90.39 crore from ₹1.42 crore in Q2 FY26. For H1 FY27, net profit stood at ₹161.37 crore against a net loss of ₹6.79 crore in H1 FY26. The board also declared an interim dividend of ₹10 per equity share (100% of face value) with a record date of November 13, 2026.
filings.impactWhy: PAT surged dramatically to ₹90.4cr from ₹1.4cr YoY alongside strong turnaround.

filings.headline: Q2 standalone revenue up 33% to ₹994cr; net profit rises 55% to ₹109cr
filings.summary: Sansera Engineering reported standalone revenue from operations of ₹993.81 crore for Q2 ended September 30, 2026, up 33.1% from ₹746.45 crore in the year-ago period. Standalone net profit rose 55.3% YoY to ₹109.25 crore from ₹70.35 crore. For the first half of the fiscal year, revenue reached ₹1,904.98 crore with net profit of ₹195.93 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Solid financial performance but within normal quarterly expectations.

filings.headline: Q2 PAT up 45% YoY to ₹15.4cr; ₹1/share interim dividend declared
filings.summary: Revenue from operations rose 14.1% YoY to ₹135.62cr for Q2 FY27, while net profit grew 45.2% to ₹15.40cr (up from ₹10.60cr in Q2 FY26). The board declared an interim dividend of ₹1 per share (10% of face value), fixing November 12, 2026 as the record date. Half-year PAT reached ₹28.13cr on revenue of ₹261.83cr.
filings.impactWhy: Routine financial results and small interim dividend.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 net profit up 23% YoY to ₹105cr; revenue up 20% to ₹1,000cr
filings.summary: VA Tech Wabag reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations of ₹1,000.2 crore, up 19.9% YoY from ₹834.5 crore. Consolidated net profit attributable to owners rose 23.3% YoY to ₹104.6 crore from ₹84.8 crore. For the first half of the fiscal year, revenue reached ₹1,887.0 crore and profit stood at ₹194.7 crore compared to ₹1,568.5 crore and ₹150.6 crore in H1 FY26.
filings.impactWhy: Moderate, expected growth in revenue and profit.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 31% to ₹97.7cr; net profit up 7.7% to ₹18.5cr
filings.summary: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations grew 31.3% YoY to ₹97.67 crore, while net profit rose 7.7% YoY to ₹18.48 crore. For H1, revenue reached ₹185.37 crore (up 24.0% YoY), while net profit dropped 12.5% YoY to ₹30.23 crore. Basic EPS for the quarter was ₹15.40 versus ₹14.30 in the year-ago period.
filings.impactWhy: Modest profit growth of 7.7% YoY.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 standalone PAT up 32% YoY to ₹60.6cr; revenue up 14% to ₹383.6cr
filings.summary: Rubicon Research reported Q2 FY27 standalone revenue from operations of ₹383.57cr, an increase of 14.0% YoY from ₹336.47cr, though down 10.3% QoQ. Net profit after tax rose 32.3% YoY to ₹60.62cr compared to ₹45.81cr in Q2 FY26, declining 26.5% from the preceding quarter. For the first half of FY27, revenue stood at ₹811.30cr with net profit reaching ₹143.07cr.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly results show sequential decline despite YoY growth.

filings.headline: Q2 order intake up 51% to ₹1,265cr; EBIT falls 23% to ₹56cr
filings.summary: Schneider Electric Infrastructure reported Q2 FY27 order intake of ₹1,265 crore (+50.9% YoY) and sales of ₹779 crore (+19.8% YoY), pushing its order backlog to ₹2,701 crore. However, Q2 EBIT fell 22.7% YoY to ₹56 crore (and H1 EBIT dropped 50.7% to ₹64 crore) due to commodity price volatility and cost pass-through lags. The company also announced a ₹211 crore capex plan at its Kolkata facility through FY29.
filings.impactWhy: Mixed operational performance with order growth offset by EBIT decline.

filings.headline: Binding offer signed with Neo Alternative to sell step-down subsidiary
filings.summary: Ceigall India's board approved in-principle execution of a binding offer letter with Neo Alternative Asset Managers for the sale of a step-down subsidiary held through Ceigall Infra Projects. The board also approved an enabling resolution to raise up to ₹1,000 crore via equity and/or convertible securities, subject to shareholder approval. Detailed transaction values and terms for the subsidiary sale were not provided in the filing excerpt.
filings.impactWhy: Enabling resolution for fundraising and non-binding/in-principle subsidiary sale without deal value.

filings.headline: Q2 net profit falls 12% YoY to ₹22.8cr on revenue of ₹291.7cr
filings.summary: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, standalone revenue from operations declined 7.4% YoY to ₹291.65 crore from ₹315.05 crore. Net profit fell 11.8% YoY to ₹22.77 crore compared to ₹25.83 crore in the year-ago period, with basic EPS dropping to ₹26.31 from ₹29.92. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, revenue stood at ₹605.05 crore and net profit was up 2.2% YoY at ₹71.50 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Modest decline in revenue and quarterly PAT.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 31% to ₹309cr; net profit fell 55% to ₹0.63cr
filings.summary: Apollo Pipes reported Q2 consolidated revenue from operations of ₹309.40 crore, up 31.3% YoY from ₹235.71 crore. Profit before tax dropped 83.4% YoY to ₹0.68 crore (from ₹4.11 crore), with net profit falling 54.5% YoY to ₹0.63 crore amid higher operating and material costs. For the first half, the company posted a net loss of ₹10.48 crore compared to a profit of ₹9.55 crore in H1 FY26.
filings.impactWhy: Drop in profitability amid higher costs, though revenue increased.

filings.headline: Q2 consol revenue down 31% YoY to ₹868cr; PAT ₹111cr aided by ₹76cr exceptional gain
filings.summary: Consolidated revenue from operations fell 31.0% YoY to ₹867.75 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to ₹1,258.10 crore a year earlier. Net profit rose to ₹111.04 crore from ₹63.92 crore, primarily driven by an exceptional gain of ₹76.01 crore; pre-exceptional profit before tax fell 49.0% to ₹50.07 crore. The board also approved the re-appointment of Executive Director Udyavar Vittal Kamath for a one-year term.
filings.impactWhy: Sharp 31% drop in revenue with core pre-exceptional PBT down 49%.

filings.headline: Q2 standalone net profit rose 18.5% YoY to ₹127.6cr; revenue up 17.6% to ₹2,583cr
filings.summary: Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, increased 17.6% YoY to ₹2,582.65 crore from ₹2,195.21 crore in Q2 FY26. Net profit rose 18.5% YoY to ₹127.57 crore versus ₹107.66 crore, though it declined sequentially from ₹137.55 crore in Q1. For the first half of the fiscal year, revenue reached ₹5,136.78 crore with a net profit of ₹265.12 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Standard quarterly results with modest profit growth.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 standalone PAT up 18.5% YoY to ₹127.6cr; revenue up 17.7% to ₹2,583cr
filings.summary: Cemindia Projects reported Q2 FY27 standalone revenue from operations of ₹2,582.65cr, an increase of 17.7% YoY from ₹2,195.21cr. Net profit grew 18.5% YoY to ₹127.57cr from ₹107.66cr in Q2 FY26, but softened 7.3% sequentially compared to ₹137.55cr in Q1 FY27. For H1 FY27, standalone revenue stood at ₹5,136.78cr with net profit of ₹265.12cr.
filings.impactWhy: Duplicate filing; modest quarterly profit growth.

filings.headline: Q2 standalone net profit rises 27% YoY to ₹387.29cr
filings.summary: Standalone revenue from operations grew 16.9% YoY to ₹2,255.61 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to ₹1,930.32 crore in Q2 FY26. Standalone net profit increased 27.1% YoY to ₹387.29 crore from ₹304.74 crore. For the half year, standalone revenue reached ₹4,374.85 crore with net profit of ₹760.58 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Steady earnings growth in line with large-cap pharma norms.

filings.headline: Q2 standalone net profit rises 149% to ₹40.2cr; revenue up 19% to ₹1,899.7cr
filings.summary: Electronics Mart India reported standalone Q2 revenue from operations of ₹1,899.74 crore, up 19.4% YoY from ₹1,590.97 crore. Standalone net profit for the quarter jumped 148.8% YoY to ₹40.16 crore from ₹16.15 crore in the prior-year period. For the first half, revenue stood at ₹4,318.69 crore with net profit of ₹160.79 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Net profit sharply higher, surging 149% YoY.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 25% YoY to ₹385cr; H1 revenue reaches ₹676cr
filings.summary: M & B Engineering reported standalone/consolidated revenue from operations of ₹384.67 crore for Q2 ended September 30, 2026, up 25.4% from ₹306.85 crore in the year-ago period. Half-year revenue grew 26.4% to ₹675.77 crore compared to ₹534.51 crore in H1 of the previous year. Complete bottom-line profit figures were truncated in the filing excerpt.
filings.impactWhy: Routine revenue growth with truncated bottom-line data.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 net profit falls 50% to ₹7.3cr despite 13% revenue growth
filings.summary: Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 rose 12.8% YoY to ₹107.4cr, but EBITDA dropped 11.1% to ₹22.5cr and net profit fell 49.7% to ₹7.3cr. For H1 FY27, net profit declined 47.6% YoY to ₹13.9cr on revenue of ₹210.9cr (up 11.4%). The company attributed the profit drop to higher revenue contribution from its London subsidiary and increased depreciation and amortisation.
filings.impactWhy: Profit decline due to subsidiary expansion and amortization, but revenue grew.

filings.headline: H1 net profit falls 29% YoY to ₹17.24cr; revenue up 6% to ₹242.48cr
filings.summary: Standalone revenue from operations for the half year ended September 30, 2026 rose 6.0% YoY to ₹242.48 crore from ₹228.76 crore. Net profit declined 29.3% YoY to ₹17.24 crore from ₹24.38 crore in the previous year's corresponding period, driven by higher material and operating expenses. Half-year revenue accounts for roughly 30% of trailing annual sales.
filings.impactWhy: Half-yearly results show modest revenue growth and profit decline.

filings.headline: Promoter group bought 0.20% (₹5.0cr) at about ₹252
filings.summary: Promoters and directors, including Gandhar Coals & Mines Private Limited, Ramesh Babulal Parekh, and Samir Ramesh Parekh, bought 0.20% of the company in the open market for ₹5.0cr. They paid an average price of ₹252 per share compared to today's ₹270, increasing their combined holding from 32.5% to 32.7%.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter group purchased 0.20% shares in open market.
