filings.summary: Promoter group member Mahalakshmi Electronics Private Limited bought 10,45,741 shares (a 2.0% stake) for ₹25.7cr via market purchase. They paid an average of ₹245 per share—below the current price of ₹266—raising their total holding from 1.2% to 3.2%.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter group acquired a 2.0% stake.

filings.headline: Promoter bought 2.0% (₹159cr) at about ₹16.2
filings.summary: Promoter and Director Bhavish Aggarwal bought 2.0% of the company (9,81,99,966 shares) for ₹159cr via a public right at an average price of ₹16.2, which is less than half the current price of ₹35.0. This purchase increased his total holding from 24.6% to 26.5%.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter acquired a 2.0% stake in the company.

filings.headline: Agreement with IFC to fund middle-income housing projects via NCDs
filings.summary: Brigade Enterprises has entered into an investment framework agreement with the International Finance Corporation (IFC) to fund middle-income residential projects. Under the agreement, a wholly-owned subsidiary will issue unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures to IFC in one or more tranches. IFC will also gain customary lender rights, including the ability to appoint a director to the subsidiary's board.
filings.impactWhy: Framework agreement for debt funding via NCDs.

filings.headline: Board approves entry into Solar IPP & EPC; plans 4 GW capacity expansion
filings.summary: Websol's board has approved the company's strategic entry into the EPC, Solar IPP, and energy trading businesses. The company also announced securing 54.2 acres in West Bengal for a massive 4 GW greenfield solar cell expansion and the full prepayment of its ₹110 crore IREDA term loan, which released the associated pledge on promoter shares.
filings.impactWhy: Release of pledge on promoter shares following loan prepayment.

filings.headline: Records ₹2,092cr Q2 pre-sales and ₹420cr Delhi land acquisition via share swap
filings.summary: Max Estates achieved Q2 FY27 pre-sales of ₹2,092 crore, taking its H1 FY27 total to ₹3,184 crore. The company also signed MOUs for an 84.71-acre land acquisition in Delhi for ₹420 crore via a share swap, and a 9.76-acre joint development in Ghaziabad with an estimated GDV of ₹2,500-3,000 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly pre-sales update and preliminary land acquisition MOUs.

filings.headline: Arvind Gautam appointed MD of material subsidiary TAIPL, replacing R.C. Subramaniam
filings.summary: Mr. R. C. Subramaniam has stepped down as Managing Director of material subsidiary Tenneco Automotive India Pvt Ltd (TAIPL) to take a new leadership role within the Tenneco Group. Mr. Arvind Gautam has been appointed as the new Managing Director of the subsidiary.
filings.impactWhy: Management change is at subsidiary level, not listed entity.

filings.headline: Joint venture receives EU certification to market dental products in Europe
filings.summary: Kids-e-Dental LLP, a joint venture in which the company holds a 60% stake, has received EU Quality Management System and ISO 13485:2016 certifications. This regulatory approval enables the joint venture to market its dental products across the European Union and European Economic Area.
filings.impactWhy: Routine regulatory certification for JV products in Europe.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue at ₹52.77cr; net profit drops to ₹4.68cr
filings.summary: The company reported Q2 revenue from operations of ₹52.77 crore, up from ₹48.77 crore a year earlier. Net profit for the quarter was ₹4.68 crore, down from ₹7.81 crore in the same period last year.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Allotted 66.57 lakh warrants (₹409cr) to promoter group at ₹614
filings.summary: Raymond Realty has allotted 66.57 lakh convertible warrants to J K Investors (Bombay) Limited on a preferential basis. The issue price of ₹614 per warrant is at a premium to the current share price of ₹561.7, with 25% paid upfront. Full conversion will add 10% more shares, diluting existing holders by 9.1%, and increase the allottee's stake from 29.83% to 35.99%.
filings.impactWhy: Warrant allotment causes over 5% equity dilution.

filings.headline: Wins ₹480.7cr turnkey order (135% of sales); Q2 revenue rises 28%
filings.summary: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹114.3 crore, up 28% year-on-year, and profit after tax of ₹35.6 crore. Alongside the results, the company announced a massive ₹480.7 crore turnkey order for a 1,200 TPD Air Separation Unit, which exceeds its trailing 12-month sales of ₹356 crore. Additionally, it commissioned a new 320 TPD onsite plant in East India during the quarter.
filings.impactWhy: Turnkey order exceeds 100% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Board approves ₹185cr capex to expand winding wire capacity by 25%
filings.summary: The board has approved a capital expenditure of ₹185 crore to expand its specialized magnet winding wire capacity at the Supa facility. The expansion will increase total capacity from 57,845 MT to 72,200 MT by Q1 FY29, driven by increasing customer demand.
filings.impactWhy: Capex approval without immediate commissioning.

filings.headline: Board approves ₹185cr Phase-3 capacity expansion to 72,200 MTs
filings.summary: The Board has approved a Phase-3 expansion at the Supa facility to increase total specialized wire capacity from 57,845 MTs to 72,200 MTs by Q1 FY2029. The ₹185 crore (Rs 1,850 million) investment will cover additional land, buildings, and machinery, and will be funded through internal accruals and long-term debt.
filings.impactWhy: Capex expansion approval.

filings.headline: Board approves ₹185cr capex for Phase-3 expansion at Supa facility
filings.summary: The board has approved a capital expenditure of up to ₹185 crore for the Phase-3 expansion of Specialized Magnet Winding Wires at the Supa facility. The project is expected to increase the company's total capacity to approximately 72,200 MTs by Q1 FY2029.
filings.impactWhy: Capex expansion approval.

filings.headline: Raised ₹300cr via preferential allotment to SBI funds at ₹1,166/sh
filings.summary: The company has allotted 25.73 lakh equity shares on a preferential basis to SBI Mutual Fund and SBI Alternative Equity Fund to raise ₹300 crore. The issue price of ₹1,166 per share is at a discount to the current market price of about ₹1,457. This increases the total share count by 6.8%, resulting in a 6.4% dilution to existing shareholders.
filings.impactWhy: Preferential allotment resulting in over 5% equity dilution.

filings.headline: Raised FY27 revenue and EBITDA margin guidance after strong Q2
filings.summary: SMS Pharmaceuticals reported a 30% YoY revenue growth to ₹316 crore and a 57% YoY jump in PAT to ₹40 crore for Q2FY27. Backed by this strong performance, the company announced it expects its full-year FY27 revenue and EBITDA margins to exceed earlier guidance. It also announced its Peptides R&D facility is fully operational and a new wholly owned subsidiary was formed for its CDMO platform.
filings.impactWhy: Company raised its full-year revenue and margin guidance.

filings.headline: Manish Kumar Garg elevated to MD & CEO for a five-year term
filings.summary: The board has approved the change in designation and elevation of Manish Kumar Garg from Executive Director & CEO to Managing Director & CEO. He has been appointed for a consecutive term of five years with effect from November 5, 2026, subject to shareholder approval.
filings.impactWhy: Internal re-designation of current CEO to MD & CEO.

filings.headline: Wins ₹69.5cr underground cabling contract from DGVCL
filings.summary: Advait Energy Transitions has received a turnkey contract from Dakshin Gujarat Vij Company Ltd (DGVCL) to convert overhead power networks to an underground cable system. The order is valued at ₹69.53 crore, representing about 8% of its yearly sales. It is to be executed over 24 months (excluding monsoons).
filings.impactWhy: Order value is below 10% of annual sales.

filings.headline: AUM crosses ₹10,000 crore milestone
filings.summary: The company announced that its Assets Under Management (AUM) have crossed the ₹10,000 crore mark. This scale has been supported by its AI-led digital lending platform and the recent ₹832.2 crore preferential issue that strengthened its capital base.
filings.impactWhy: Milestone update without new financial guidance or deal.

filings.headline: Group CFO Alexander Poempner steps down; Ankit Nayyar appointed
filings.summary: Mr. Alexander Poempner has requested early relieving from his position as Group Chief Financial Officer due to personal exigencies. The board has appointed Mr. Ankit Nayyar as the new Group CFO effective November 4, 2026. Unplanned changes in key management personnel warrant investor attention.
filings.impactWhy: Exit and appointment of Group CFO.

filings.headline: Enters maritime sector with offshore safety consultancy order
filings.summary: Engineers India has been awarded a contract to provide consultancy services for the development of Indian Standards for Offshore Safety Training and Certification. Although the order value is not disclosed, the company stated this marks its strategic entry into the new and diversified maritime sector.
filings.impactWhy: Order value is undisclosed.

filings.headline: CEO & CFO Naveen Malik and CS Payal Puri resign for internal transfer
filings.summary: Mr. Naveen Malik (CEO & CFO) and Ms. Payal M Puri (Company Secretary) have resigned from the company effective November 3, 2026. This is part of an internal reorganization, and both executives will be transferred to the subsidiary Hindware Limited, where they will continue to manage its affairs.
filings.impactWhy: Resignation of CEO and CFO.

filings.headline: Acquires up to 25% additional stake in subsidiary Somany Sanitary Ware
filings.summary: The board has approved the acquisition of up to 24.75 lakh equity shares (a 25% stake) in its subsidiary Somany Sanitary Ware Private Limited from existing shareholders. This will increase the company's holding in the subsidiary from 51% to up to 76%. The exact transaction value was not disclosed in the provided text.
filings.impactWhy: Internal acquisition of additional stake in existing subsidiary.

filings.headline: Initiated plan to sell 100% stake in four completed road assets
filings.summary: Ircon International has initiated an asset monetisation plan under DIPAM guidelines. The company plans to strategically sell its 100% stake in four completed road assets: Ircon Shivpuri Guna Tollway, PB Tollway, Davanagere Haveri Highway, and Vadodara Kim Expressway.
filings.impactWhy: Initiation of monetisation process; no finalized transaction.

filings.headline: Appointed Ravi Kumar Shingari as Chief Financial Officer
filings.summary: Apollo Tyres has appointed Mr. Ravi Kumar Shingari as Chief Financial Officer, effective November 4, 2026. He has been with the company since 2018, most recently serving as Vice President of Accounts, Tax, Finance, Legal and Investor Relations.
filings.impactWhy: Appointment of Chief Financial Officer.

filings.headline: Closing Gurugram plant to consolidate output at Hyderabad and Solan
filings.summary: Exicom Tele-Systems is transitioning its manufacturing operations from its Gurugram facility to existing plants in Hyderabad and Solan by mid-November 2026. The Gurugram unit accounted for ₹86.3 crore (9.64%) of standalone turnover in FY26. The consolidation aims to optimise capacity utilisation and improve operational efficiency without disrupting overall production.
filings.impactWhy: Consolidation of manufacturing operations across existing plants.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 34%; to relocate Italy plant and acquire stake in Forsee Power India
filings.summary: Varroc reported strong Q2 FY27 results with consolidated revenue of ₹2,948 crore, up 33.6% YoY, driven by a 130% growth in EV-related revenue. Strategically, the company is relocating its Italy two-wheeler lighting manufacturing to Romania and Vietnam to improve cost efficiency. It is also acquiring a stake in Forsee Power India to expand its capabilities in EV battery packs and BMS.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly performance and operational restructuring.

filings.headline: Board approves divestment of Tritium business at $85 million valuation
filings.summary: Exicom's board has approved a non-binding term sheet to divest its Tritium global DC fast-charging business at an indicative enterprise valuation of USD 85 million. The deal will allow the company to redeploy capital for aggressive growth in its core Indian and export markets and paves the way for it to become debt-free.
filings.impactWhy: Non-binding term sheet for divestment.

filings.headline: Board approves 2:1 bonus share issue, interim CFO appointment, and ₹2 dividend
filings.summary: The board approved a 2:1 bonus issue, offering two new shares for every one held, by capitalizing ₹23.04 crore from retained earnings. This will increase the total shares in issue by 200% with zero ownership dilution for existing shareholders. Additionally, Whole-time Director Sumer Ghumman was appointed interim CFO until a new candidate joins in January 2027, and an interim dividend of ₹2 per share was declared.
filings.impactWhy: Board approved a 2:1 bonus share issue.

filings.headline: Executive Director and Group CFO Anand Sharma resigns
filings.summary: Executive Director and Group Chief Financial Officer Anand H. Sharma has resigned, effective November 16, 2026. He cited personal reasons for being unable to relocate to the company's Bhavnagar headquarters, as required by the leadership.
filings.impactWhy: Resignation of Executive Director and Group CFO.

filings.headline: Raised FY27 EBITDA margin guidance to 29-30% and started new capacity
filings.summary: The company raised its FY27 EBITDA margin guidance to 29-30% from 27-28% earlier, though it adjusted its revenue growth outlook to 1.2-1.5x industry growth. It also announced that its new chrome plating facility commenced commercial production and the Bangalore capacity expansion is completed. Additionally, the company won new export orders from Stellantis, Whirlpool, and Toyota Middle East, and acquired the remaining 9.9% stake in subsidiary WPI.
filings.impactWhy: Raised FY27 EBITDA margin guidance and commissioned new capacity

filings.headline: Board approves term sheet to divest Tritium business for $85 million
filings.summary: The board has approved the proposed divestment of its Tritium EV charging business via its subsidiary Exicom Power Solutions B.V. A non-binding term sheet has been received at an indicative enterprise valuation of $85 million on a cash-free and debt-free basis. Additionally, the company will consolidate its Gurugram manufacturing operations into its existing facilities in Hyderabad and Solan.
filings.impactWhy: Divestment of Tritium EV business for $85 million is large

filings.headline: Board approves 2:1 bonus issue and names interim CFO
filings.summary: The board approved a 2:1 bonus share issue, capitalizing ₹23.04 crore from retained earnings to triple the outstanding share count to 17.28 crore. The company also declared a ₹2 interim dividend and appointed Whole-time Director Sumer Ghumman as interim CFO until a permanent candidate joins in January 2027.
filings.impactWhy: Board approved 2:1 bonus share issue

filings.headline: Board approves 51:49 JV with Korea's DYA to supply seats to Kia and Hyundai
filings.summary: The board has approved forming a 51:49 joint venture with Korea's DYA Co. Ltd to manufacture passenger car seats in India, targeting supplies to Kia and Hyundai. Additionally, the company will invest ₹18.53 crore in capital expenditure at its Gujarat and Haryana plants for new Maruti Suzuki programmes.
filings.impactWhy: Joint venture and small capex below materiality threshold

filings.headline: Board approves ₹147cr share buyback at ₹215 per share
filings.summary: The board has approved a buyback of up to 68.37 lakh equity shares (1.86% of total shares) at ₹215 per share through the tender offer route. The total buyback size is ₹147 crore, representing a 14% premium to the current share price. The promoter group has confirmed it will not participate in the offer.
filings.impactWhy: Board approved ₹147 crore share buyback at a premium

filings.headline: Board approves ₹147cr share buyback at ₹215 per share
filings.summary: The board has approved a buyback of up to 68.37 lakh equity shares (1.86% of the total shares) for ₹147 crore through the tender offer route. The buyback price is set at ₹215 per share, a premium to the current market price of ₹188. The promoter group has expressed its intention not to participate in the buyback.
filings.impactWhy: Board approved ₹147 crore share buyback at a premium

filings.headline: Received a ₹306cr construction order from Puravankara in Mumbai
filings.summary: Capacit'e Infraprojects has secured a Letter of Award worth ₹306 crore (excluding GST) from Puravankara Limited. The contract involves the construction of the Estrella residential project in Andheri West, Mumbai. This significant order win amounts to about 11.5% of the company's yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Order win exceeds 10% of annual sales

filings.headline: Demise of Chairman & Executive Director Ishwar Chand Agarwal
filings.summary: Genus Power Infrastructures announced the sad demise of Mr. Ishwar Chand Agarwal, Chairman and Executive Director, on November 4, 2026. The company noted that his passing is an irreparable loss and acknowledged his immense contribution to its growth over the years.
filings.impactWhy: Demise of Chairman and Executive Director

filings.headline: Forms 51:49 JV with Korea's DYA to supply car seats to Kia and Hyundai
filings.summary: NDR Auto Components has entered a 51:49 joint venture agreement with South Korea's DYA Co. to manufacture and supply passenger car seats in India, primarily for Kia and Hyundai. The board also approved ₹18.53 crore in capital expenditure for its plants in Gujarat and Haryana to support new programs for Maruti Suzuki and Suzuki Motorcycle.
filings.impactWhy: Joint venture and small capex below materiality threshold

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 30% YoY to ₹316cr; net profit jumps 55% to ₹39cr
filings.summary: SMS Pharmaceuticals reported strong Q2 results with revenue from operations rising 30% year-on-year to ₹316.07 crore. Net profit for the quarter grew 55% year-on-year to ₹39.13 crore. The company also announced the routine resignation and replacement of its company secretary.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results

filings.headline: Commissioned 6 GWh lithium-ion cell gigafactory; Q2 revenue up 20%
filings.summary: Exide Industries has completed the commissioning of its 6 GWh lithium-ion cell gigafactory in Bengaluru through its subsidiary EESL. The company also reported strong Q2 FY27 results, with standalone revenue growing 20.3% year-on-year to ₹5,026 crore and net profit rising 75.1% to ₹386 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Commissioned flagship 6 GWh lithium-ion cell gigafactory

filings.headline: Commissioned SteriPort Line 3, expected to add ₹110-120cr in peak annual revenue
filings.summary: Alongside its Q2FY27 earnings, the company announced the commissioning of SteriPort Line 3 at its Kheda facility in September 2026. This increases SteriPort capacity by 75% to 11.6 crore bottles and is projected to generate ₹110-120 crore annually at optimal utilization, significant against its ₹303 crore trailing sales. A 10.8 MW captive solar plant is also fully operational, expected to save around ₹9 crore annually.
filings.impactWhy: Commissioned line adding over 35% to annual sales

filings.headline: Ravi Kumar Mutaka appointed as Chief Operating Officer.
filings.summary: Chembond Chemicals has appointed Ravi Kumar Mutaka as its Chief Operating Officer, effective November 4, 2026. He is a chemical engineer with over 30 years of experience in plant operations and manufacturing across the chemicals and FMCG industries.
filings.impactWhy: COO appointment is not MD, CEO, CFO, or Chairman

filings.headline: CARE upgrades ratings on ₹1,474cr bank facilities to CARE A; Stable / A1
filings.summary: CARE Ratings has upgraded its credit ratings on DEE Development Engineers' long-term bank facilities of ₹169.19 crore to CARE A; Stable from CARE A-; Stable. Ratings on the company's long-term/short-term and short-term facilities, totalling ₹1,305 crore, were also upgraded to CARE A; Stable / CARE A1 and CARE A1.
filings.impactWhy: Credit rating upgraded across bank facilities by CARE

filings.headline: Secured ₹186cr EPC order from Power Grid for substation extensions
filings.summary: SPML Infra has secured an order worth ₹186.41 crore (excluding GST) from Power Grid Corporation of India. The EPC contract involves extending substations at Ramgarh and Bhadla and is equivalent to about 19% of the company's yearly sales. The project is to be executed within 27 months.
filings.impactWhy: Order win accounts for about 19% of yearly sales

filings.headline: Wins government order to supply 4.2 crore condoms
filings.summary: Anondita Medicare has received a purchase order from the Central Medical Services Society (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare) to supply 4.20 crore condoms. Half the order is to be delivered within 90 days and the balance within 180 days. The exact financial value of the contract was not disclosed.
filings.impactWhy: Order contract value not disclosed

filings.headline: Q2 consolidated revenue grows 35% YoY to ₹1,334cr, net profit rises 33% to ₹85cr
filings.summary: Pricol reported strong Q2 financial results, with consolidated revenue rising 35% year-on-year to ₹1,334.02 crore from ₹987.93 crore. Net profit for the quarter increased by 33% to ₹85.21 crore compared to ₹63.99 crore in the corresponding period last year.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Q2FY27 PAT jumps 91% YoY to ₹35cr; revenue up 16% to ₹132cr
filings.summary: The company reported Q2FY27 revenue from operations of ₹131.7 crore, up 15.8% YoY. EBITDA grew 60.1% YoY to ₹45.0 crore, and PAT increased by 90.6% YoY to ₹35.3 crore, driven by strong growth in its Automotive and Enterprise verticals.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly earnings release.

filings.headline: Expands US complex generics collaboration with DifGen Pharmaceuticals
filings.summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals has expanded its strategic collaboration with DifGen Pharmaceuticals to commercialize a portfolio of over 20 complex generics in the US. DifGen will handle development and manufacturing, while Alembic will commercialize the products, which target an aggregate reference market of about $5 billion. Initial product launches from this partnership are expected to begin in FY28.
filings.impactWhy: Commercial collaboration expansion with launches planned for FY28.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue up 31% to ₹940cr, EBITDA up 48% to ₹214cr
filings.summary: Marksans Pharma reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹940 crore in Q2 FY27, up 30.5% YoY. EBITDA grew 48.3% to a record ₹214 crore, while half-year PAT nearly doubled to ₹303 crore, driven by strong growth in the US, UK, and Europe markets.
filings.impactWhy: Reported highest-ever quarterly revenue and record EBITDA.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue up 29% YoY to ₹7,910cr; net profit drops 27% to ₹925cr
filings.summary: Zydus Lifesciences reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹7,910 crore (up 29.2% YoY) and a net profit of ₹925.5 crore (down 26.6% YoY). The US formulations business grew 21% to ₹3,314 crore, driven by volume expansion and specialty products. The company also noted recent USFDA inspections at its SEZ II and Moraiya facilities concluded with one and five observations, respectively.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly results with lower net profit.

filings.headline: Q2 PAT jumps 80% YoY to ₹120cr; revenue grows 36%
filings.summary: Galaxy Surfactants reported a strong performance for Q2 FY27, with PAT growing 80.1% YoY to ₹119.8 crore and total revenue up 36.4% YoY to ₹1,816.8 crore. EBITDA rose 68.4% YoY to ₹195.9 crore, driven by high-single-digit volume growth and an improved specialty care product mix.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Exiting TLS certificate segment following a security incident
filings.summary: eMudhra reported Q2 FY27 total income of ₹209.3 crore (up 19.6% YoY) and PAT of ₹33.4 crore. Crucially, the company disclosed a certificate security incident in its TLS business in October, leading it to revoke affected intermediary certificates and appoint KPMG as an external reviewer. As a result, eMudhra will cease selling TLS certificates and completely exit this business line, which accounts for approximately 1% of its global revenue.
filings.impactWhy: Discontinued segment accounts for only 1% of global revenue.

filings.headline: Board approves Q2 financial results, posts ₹1,042cr revenue
filings.summary: The board of directors has approved the unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of ₹1,042.86 crore for the quarter.
filings.impactWhy: Routine approval of quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 18% YoY to ₹1,242cr; profit doubles to ₹142cr
filings.summary: Physicswallah reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹1,242.26 crore for Q2 FY27, up 18.2% year-on-year. Profit after tax doubled to ₹142 crore, while EBITDA margin improved to 28.0% from 21.7% a year ago.
filings.impactWhy: Reported highest-ever quarterly revenue with profit doubling.

filings.headline: Q2 standalone revenue grew 23% YoY to ₹585cr; net profit rose 37% to ₹29cr
filings.summary: Stove Kraft reported Q2 standalone revenue from operations of ₹584.67 crore, up 23.2% YoY from ₹474.42 crore. Net profit for the quarter increased by 36.5% to ₹29.16 crore, compared to ₹21.36 crore in the same period last year.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Promoter freed 3.1% of shares from pledge
filings.summary: Promoter Rahul Saraogi freed 16,25,000 shares (3.1% of the company, worth ₹41.7cr) that were previously given to lenders as security. The release was recorded at an average price of ₹257 versus today's price of ₹264, leaving his holding unchanged at 18.9% before and after the event.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter released 3.1% pledge of company shares

filings.headline: Board approves major capex plan of ₹2,581cr for new carbon materials
filings.summary: The board approved significant capacity expansions through its subsidiaries, including a ₹1,606 crore expansion of its anode project to 44,000 MT and a new ₹475 crore crucible plant. It also approved a ₹500 crore graphene manufacturing plant and altered its Memorandum of Association to include these new business objects.
filings.impactWhy: Board approval of future capex plan, not commissioning

filings.headline: H1 PAT jumps 6x to ₹120cr; commissions 550 MW capacity and raises ₹2,500cr
filings.summary: The company announced its H1 FY27 results, with profit after tax growing more than six-fold to ₹120 crore and EBITDA rising 58% to ₹1,011 crore. During the half-year, it commissioned 550 MW of renewable capacity and raised ₹2,500 crore through a green bond issuance, while maintaining its FY28 EBITDA guidance of above ₹3,000 crore.
filings.impactWhy: H1 financial results and green bond debt raise

filings.headline: To invest ₹140.4cr in capacity expansion at Haridwar and Pune plants
filings.summary: SKF India has approved a capacity expansion to add new production channels at its Haridwar and Pune plants. The company will invest a total of ₹140.4 crore (funded via internal accruals) to meet customer demand and reduce trading volumes, with production starting in phases between December 2026 and July 2027.
filings.impactWhy: Modest capex expansion relative to company sales

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 32% to ₹2,056cr; bags ₹1,747cr in new orders post-quarter
filings.summary: Transrail Lighting reported a 32% year-on-year increase in Q2 FY27 revenue to ₹2,056 crore, alongside a profit after tax of ₹104 crore. The company secured new orders worth ₹1,747 crore (roughly 25% of its yearly sales) after the quarter ended, taking its unexecuted order book to ₹14,218 crore. It also announced a significant expansion of its tower and conductor manufacturing capacities.
filings.impactWhy: New orders worth ₹1,747cr represent roughly 25% of yearly sales

filings.headline: Won 'Major' overseas order worth ₹300-600cr from promoter JNK Global
filings.summary: The company has received an order for the design, supply, and transportation of a heater package for a project in Nigeria from its promoter, JNK Global Co., Ltd. The order is classified as 'Major' (worth between ₹300 crore and ₹600 crore), which represents a massive 33% to 67% of its trailing 12-month sales. The related-party transaction is on an arm's length basis and is to be executed over 18 months.
filings.impactWhy: Order worth ₹300-600cr represents 33% to 67% of yearly sales

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 26.6% YoY to ₹467cr; order book hits record ₹2,268cr
filings.summary: INOX India reported Q2 FY27 revenue grew 26.6% YoY to ₹467cr and PAT rose 7.8% to ₹66cr. The company secured major order inflows of ₹1,028cr during the quarter, pushing its total order book to a record ₹2,268cr (about 1.4x yearly sales). It also announced a three-year global supply agreement for beverage kegs and its entry into the semiconductor infrastructure space with initial work at a Dholera facility.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly earnings and cumulative order inflow without single 10% contract

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue grows 28% YoY to ₹905.6cr; EBITDA up 41%
filings.summary: V2 Retail announced its Q2 FY27 results, reporting a 28% YoY increase in revenue to ₹905.6 crore and a 41% YoY growth in EBITDA to ₹120.3 crore. For the half-year ended September 2026, revenue surged 42% YoY to ₹1,902.8 crore with net profit up 43% to ₹60.1 crore. The company achieved strong volume growth of 31% in Q2 despite the festive season shifting to Q3.
filings.impactWhy: Regular quarterly financial results

filings.headline: Summons to company and all directors in Drugs and Cosmetics Act case
filings.summary: Balaji Amines and all its directors have received a summons from a sessions court in Ahmedabad for alleged violations of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940. They are ordered to appear in court on November 4, 2026. Although the company claims there is no material financial impact, a legal case involving the entire board is a notable risk.
filings.impactWhy: Court summons with no financial demand or penalty outcome yet

filings.headline: Subsidiary wins tax appeal, ₹65.4cr tax liability deleted
filings.summary: The Commissioner of Income-tax (Appeals) has passed an order deleting a ₹62.15 crore addition to the income of the company's wholly owned subsidiary, Surya Energy, for AY 2022-23. This favorable outcome removes a proposed tax liability of ₹65.45 crore and resolves the dispute with no financial impact.
filings.impactWhy: Favorable tax appeal outcome is relatively small for company size

filings.headline: Cyber fraud leads to ₹5.1 crore in unauthorized bank transactions
filings.summary: SG Finserve reported a cyber fraud incident involving 15 unauthorized debit transactions totaling ₹5.1 crore from its Yes Bank current accounts via a payment API. The company has isolated the affected systems, is working to recover the funds, and has reported the breach to the RBI and cyber authorities. It stated that core business operations and customer data remain unaffected.
filings.impactWhy: Fraud amount of ₹5.1cr is immaterial to company size

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 results: Standalone revenue ₹572cr, PAT ₹221cr
filings.summary: Anthem Biosciences reported Q2 FY27 standalone revenue from operations of ₹572.1 crore, up 3.5% year-on-year from ₹552.7 crore. Net profit for the quarter stood at ₹220.9 crore, an 11.3% increase compared to ₹198.4 crore in the same period last year.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results

filings.headline: Promoter with 9.42% stake seeks reclassification to public
filings.summary: Mr. Bhaskar Srinivasan and three associated family trusts have requested to be reclassified from the promoter group to the public shareholder category. Together, they hold 63.04 lakh shares, representing 9.42% of the company's share capital, and state they are not involved in the company's management or daily affairs.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter reclassification request to public category

filings.headline: Board approves ₹997cr budget for new 500-bed hospital in Ghaziabad
filings.summary: The board has approved a project budget of ₹997 crore to build a new 500-bed hospital on a 10,560 sq. meter land parcel in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh. This major capacity expansion represents a planned investment equal to about 21% of the company's yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Board approval of capex budget for hospital project

filings.headline: Q2 revenue down 11% YoY to ₹457cr, PAT drops 47% to ₹51.1cr
filings.summary: Neuland Laboratories reported an 11.4% YoY decline in Q2 FY27 revenue to ₹457.2 crore, with Profit After Tax falling 47% to ₹51.1 crore as EBITDA margins contracted to 22.9%. The company also announced the inauguration of a new peptide manufacturing facility and the acquisition of 134 acres of land in Kakinada for long-term expansion.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results

filings.headline: Approved ₹997cr budget for new 500-bed hospital in Ghaziabad
filings.summary: The board has approved a project budget of ₹997 crore to construct a 500-bed hospital in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh. The cost includes a 10,560 sq. meter land parcel allotted by the UP Housing & Development Board. This major expansion represents a capital expenditure equal to roughly 21% of the company's yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Board approval of capex budget for hospital project

filings.headline: Board approves up to ₹250 crore fund-raise via rights issue
filings.summary: The board has approved raising up to ₹250 crore through a rights issue to eligible shareholders. The detailed terms, including the issue price and entitlement ratio, will be determined at a later date. The proposed issue size represents about 14% of the company's current market value.
filings.impactWhy: Rights issue of ₹250cr implies ~14% equity dilution

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 44% YoY to ₹1,264cr, but net profit drops 75% to ₹13.6cr
filings.summary: Dhoot Transmission reported its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations grew 44% year-on-year to ₹1,263.6 crore. However, net profit fell 75% year-on-year to ₹13.6 crore, significantly impacted by an exceptional expense of ₹39.8 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results

filings.headline: Secured 15-year PPP project from MCD for CT & MRI facilities at three Delhi hospitals
filings.summary: Krsnaa Diagnostics has received a Letter of Award from the Municipal Corporation of Delhi to set up and operate CT Scan and MRI facilities at three public hospitals. The cash-collection PPP contract is for a concession period of ten years, extendable by up to five years, with revenues depending on actual investigation volumes.
filings.impactWhy: PPP award with variable revenue and unspecified contract value

filings.headline: Board approves ₹600cr investment in EV battery chemicals subsidiary
filings.summary: Gujarat Fluorochemicals' board has approved an investment of up to ₹600 crore in its 96.14%-owned material subsidiary, GFCL EV Products. The cash will fund capital expenditure and operational requirements for the subsidiary's expansion in battery chemicals. The investment is classed as a material related-party transaction and requires shareholder approval.
filings.impactWhy: Inter-corporate equity investment in majority-owned subsidiary

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 52% YoY to ₹431cr; highlights ₹3,150cr Advent investment
filings.summary: Yatharth Hospital reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹431.4 crore, up 52% YoY, and profit after tax of ₹48.5 crore, up 17% YoY. The filing highlights a definitive agreement for a ₹3,150 crore primary capital investment from Advent International via equity and warrants for a 24.9% stake. This implies issuing approximately 3.2 crore new shares (a 33% increase) at roughly ₹986 per share, a slight premium to the current share price, causing 24.9% dilution to existing holders.
filings.impactWhy: Preferential issue to Advent International causes 24.9% equity dilution

filings.headline: Guides for ~33% FY27 revenue growth despite reporting H1 net loss of ₹15cr
filings.summary: The company provided full-year FY27 guidance alongside its Q2 results, expecting revenue to grow by approximately 33% year-on-year and PBDIT margins to improve by 100 basis points. However, despite a 20% increase in H1 FY27 total income to ₹192.02cr, the company reported a net loss of ₹15.19cr compared to a profit of ₹5.74cr last year, heavily impacted by steep input costs, depreciation, and finance charges.
filings.impactWhy: Routine guidance update alongside quarterly results

filings.headline: Q2FY27 net profit grew 14.3% YoY to ₹23,038cr
filings.summary: State Bank of India reported its Q2FY27 financial results, with net profit rising 14.28% year-on-year to ₹23,038 crore. Net Interest Income increased by 14.69% to ₹49,143 crore, while the Gross NPA ratio improved by 34 basis points YoY to 1.39%.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results

filings.headline: Seeks nod for ₹1,000cr investment, loan or guarantee to JV
filings.summary: Marathon Nextgen Realty is seeking shareholder approval for a material related-party transaction. The company proposes to invest, loan, or provide guarantees up to ₹1,000 crore to its joint venture, Swayam Realtors and Traders LLP. This amount is highly significant, representing nearly double the company's yearly sales of ₹566 crore and about 38% of its market value.
filings.impactWhy: Seeking shareholder approval for potential funding to JV

filings.headline: Commenced commercial production at expanded Acetonitrile and DME plants
filings.summary: Along with its Q2 results, Balaji Amines announced the start of commercial production at its expanded Acetonitrile (ACN) facility, increasing installed capacity to 1,440 TPM. The company has also successfully commissioned its 100,000 TPA Dimethyl Ether (DME) plant.
filings.impactWhy: Commissioning of expanded chemical capacity alongside results

filings.headline: Acquires WTIL for ₹146cr for Bhandup West land parcel with ₹1,800cr GDV
filings.summary: Arkade Developers has acquired 100% shares of Woollen and Textile Industries Ltd for ₹146 crore. The acquisition includes a 14,363 sq. m. land parcel in Bhandup West, Mumbai. The proposed premium residential development on this land has an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹1,800 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine land parcel acquisition for real estate business

filings.headline: USFDA approval for Methylprednisolone Acetate injection
filings.summary: Gland Pharma has received USFDA approval for Methylprednisolone Acetate Injectable Suspension USP (single- and multiple-dose vials). The product is bioequivalent to Pfizer's Depo-Medrol and targets a US market estimated at $214 million for the 12 months ending August 2026.
filings.impactWhy: Routine US FDA product approval

filings.headline: Secured two new EPC orders worth ₹583 crore
filings.summary: Man Infraconstruction has won two EPC work orders totaling ₹583 crore, comprising a ₹508 crore residential tower project in South Mumbai and a ₹75 crore reclamation works project at JNPA. This is highly material as it equals about 74% of the company's trailing 12-month sales and boosts its total EPC portfolio to ₹858 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Order wins worth ₹583cr equal roughly 74% of yearly sales

filings.headline: Auditor issues qualified conclusion on Q2 results over ₹76cr unbilled revenue
filings.summary: The statutory auditor issued a qualified conclusion on the company's financial results for the quarter ended September 30. The qualification relates to unbilled revenue of ₹76.38 crore (about 7% of yearly sales) for which customer confirmations were still awaited.
filings.impactWhy: Statutory auditor issued a qualified conclusion on financial results

filings.headline: Auditor qualifies Q2 results over ₹76.38cr unbilled revenue
filings.summary: The statutory auditor has issued a qualified conclusion on the company's financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The qualification relates to ₹76.38 crore of unbilled revenue for which customer confirmations were still awaited at the time of review. This unconfirmed amount represents roughly 7% of the company's yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Statutory auditor issued a qualified conclusion on financial results

filings.headline: 10-year ITPO concession agreement expected to yield ₹15cr annual revenue
filings.summary: OSEL Devices has signed a 10-year concession agreement with ITPO under a public-private partnership model for 15,000 sq. ft. of digital LED screens at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. The company expects to generate approximately ₹15 crore in annual revenue from the project with an anticipated 25% growth trend, representing a significant long-term contract against its ₹479 crore yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Annual contract value is only ~3% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Auditor flags CBI Anti-Corruption Bureau search in Q2 results
filings.summary: The company's statutory auditor drew attention to search proceedings conducted by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), Anti-Corruption Bureau, Patna, in its review of the Q2 financial results. The company has appointed an external firm to review certain aspects of the matter due to the uncertainty of the outcome.
filings.impactWhy: Auditor emphasis of matter is not a formal qualification

filings.headline: Board approves new 500-bed hospital in Ghaziabad; Q2 revenue up 34%
filings.summary: Medanta's board has approved the development of a new 500-bed super-specialty hospital in Ghaziabad. The announcement comes alongside strong Q2 FY27 results, with revenue from operations growing 33.6% year-on-year to ₹1,469 crore and operating EBITDA rising 60.2%.
filings.impactWhy: New hospital expansion announcement alongside routine earnings

filings.headline: Q2 revenue jumps 47% YoY to ₹1,561cr; PAT up 27% to ₹102cr
filings.summary: The company reported its highest-ever quarterly results for Q2 FY27, with total income rising 47.5% YoY to ₹1,561 crore. PAT grew 27.3% YoY to ₹102 crore and EBITDA increased 30% to ₹185 crore. ASK Automotive also commenced supply of its high-pressure die-casted alloy wheels and operationalized a new 11.55 MWp captive solar power plant in Rajasthan.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results

filings.headline: Executive Chairman Rajesh Sharma to take non-executive role in Jan 2027
filings.summary: Ion Exchange announced that Mr. Rajesh Sharma will transition from Executive Chairman to Non-Executive Non-Independent Chairman effective January 1, 2027. He has served the company for five decades, including as Managing Director from 2000 to 2024, and expressed a desire to step back into a non-executive role.
filings.impactWhy: Transition from executive to non-executive chairman, not an exit.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 results: Revenue at ₹176.6cr, Net profit of ₹14.3cr
filings.summary: Nephrocare Health Services reported its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations rose to ₹176.6cr, up from ₹155.9cr in Q2 FY26. The company posted a net profit of ₹14.3cr for the quarter, turning around from a net loss of ₹32.4cr in the same period last year.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results.

filings.headline: Starts production at Ghiloth panel line; pending order book at ₹1,462cr
filings.summary: Along with its Q2 results, the company announced the commissioning of its Ghiloth sandwich panel line, with commercial production starting in November 2026. This takes total sandwich panel capacity to 2.1 million sq. m. The pending order book stood at ₹1,462.5 crore (about 91% of yearly sales), providing strong revenue visibility.
filings.impactWhy: Incremental capacity commissioning and routine quarterly update.

filings.headline: Q2 fresh orders of ₹867cr; outstanding order book reaches ₹2,711cr
filings.summary: The company reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹208.6 crore and PAT of ₹53.9 crore. During the quarter, it secured fresh orders worth ₹867.3 crore, taking the outstanding order book to ₹2,711.2 crore (executable over 24-30 months), and reiterated its FY27 revenue guidance of around ₹950 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Reiterated revenue guidance and regular quarterly order inflow update.

filings.headline: Emerged as lowest bidder for ₹400cr Sri Lanka Railways tender
filings.summary: RITES has emerged as the lowest bidder for a tender from Sri Lanka Railways to supply Diesel Multiple Unit train sets. The estimated order value is approximately ₹400 crore, which represents about 16% of the company's yearly sales. The contract is expected to be executed within 12 months from the opening of the letter of credit.
filings.impactWhy: Lowest bidder for contract worth 16% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Q2 PAT rises 69% YoY to ₹18.8cr; company sells Hyderabad plant
filings.summary: Ganesh Consumer reported Q2 FY27 PAT of ₹18.8cr, up 68.7% YoY, while total income declined 4.8% YoY to ₹228.5cr. EBITDA margins expanded by 302 bps to 13.0% and the board declared an interim dividend of ₹3.7 per share. The company also announced the sale of its Hyderabad plant to redeploy proceeds into its core markets in eastern India.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly earnings results and non-material plant sale.

filings.headline: Board approves ₹45cr warrant issue to promoter and ₹70cr chemical plant expansion
filings.summary: The board approved issuing 8.54 lakh fully convertible warrants to the promoter at ₹526.90 each to raise up to ₹45 crore. This represents a 2.6% increase in outstanding shares (a 2.6% dilution to existing holders), with the issue price at a discount to the current ₹570 market price. The funds will support a new ₹70 crore capex plan for a 3,000 MTPA chemical plant, while the company also announced it has commenced commercial production at a 6,000 MTPA dyes facility.
filings.impactWhy: Preferential warrant issue causes only 2.6% dilution, below 5% threshold.

filings.headline: Q2 PAT falls 81% YoY to ₹30cr; record order book at ₹39,946cr
filings.summary: KEC International reported a sharp decline in Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT to ₹30 crore from ₹161 crore a year ago, as revenue fell to ₹5,468 crore from ₹6,092 crore. Management cited geopolitical issues, supply chain disruptions, and land acquisition challenges as near-term headwinds. However, the company noted a record order book of ₹39,946 crore with year-to-date order intake exceeding ₹13,500 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly earnings decline without change to guidance or record turnover.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 59% to ₹1,051cr; PAT at ₹82cr; pre-sales double to ₹2,762cr
filings.summary: Puravankara's Q2FY27 revenue surged 59% year-on-year to ₹1,051 crore, and the company posted a net profit of ₹82 crore compared to a loss of ₹42 crore last year. Pre-sales jumped 109% to ₹2,762 crore, boosted by the ₹626 crore divestment of its Purva Zentech commercial asset. The company also expanded into the Delhi-NCR market, adding new projects with a potential gross development value of ₹8,900 crore during the quarter.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly earnings and pre-sales update without formal record declaration.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 124% YoY to ₹91.3cr; secures ₹151cr debt funding for R&D
filings.summary: ideaForge reported strong Q2 FY27 results, with revenue growing 124% YoY to ₹91.3 crore and turning PAT positive at ₹6.5 crore. The company also announced securing ₹151 crore in long-term, low-interest debt funding from the Technology Development Board for its YETI logistics UAV. This funding raise is highly material, equating to over 50% of the company's trailing 12-month sales.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly results and debt funding, not equity dilution or customer order.

filings.headline: License agreement with Japan's Yamato for new automotive components
filings.summary: Belrise Industries has signed a license and technical assistance agreement with Japan's Yamato Co. The deal grants Belrise the know-how to manufacture and sell air filters, oil filters, and resin air intake manifolds to Indian automotive and industrial OEMs. The company will pay consideration in the form of royalties and technical assistance fees.
filings.impactWhy: Licensing agreement without disclosed material financial terms.

filings.headline: Starts commercial production of 1.3 GW solar PV modules at Gopalpur facility
filings.summary: The company's wholly owned subsidiary has commenced commercial production of solar PV modules at its new facility in Gopalpur, Odisha. Phase I operations have begun with a capacity of approximately 1.3 GW out of the proposed 4 GW. The new capacity forms part of the company's IPO objects and will significantly enhance its production scale.
filings.impactWhy: Commercial production begins at major 1.3 GW solar facility.

filings.headline: Signs MoUs for four redevelopment projects in Bihar worth ₹2,000cr
filings.summary: NBCC has signed MoUs with the Bihar government for four redevelopment projects in Patna on a self-financing basis. The estimated project cost is ₹2,000 crore, equal to about 16% of the company's yearly sales. The company will earn 6% in project management charges and a 1.25% marketing fee on expected sale proceeds of ₹5,152 crore.
filings.impactWhy: MoU for redevelopment projects where PMC fee is under 10% of sales.

filings.headline: Joint auditor departs over fee dispute; ₹210cr ICICI Pru investment secured
filings.summary: Raymond Realty ended its joint auditing arrangement with Chaturvedi & Shah LLP following a commercial disagreement over a requested audit fee revision. Walker Chandiok & Co. LLP will continue as the sole statutory auditor. The company also highlighted a recent ₹210 crore investment from the ICICI Prudential Real Estate Development Fund.
filings.impactWhy: Joint statutory auditor departs following a fee dispute.

filings.headline: CFO Chetan Modi resigns effective November 2, 2026
filings.summary: Mr. Chetan Modi has resigned from his position as Chief Financial Officer, effective November 2, 2026, to pursue professional goals outside the organization. He will also cease to be a Key Managerial Personnel and the authorized person for determining materiality disclosures. The departure of a CFO is a significant governance event that investors should monitor.
filings.impactWhy: Resignation of Chief Financial Officer.

filings.headline: Record ₹1,087cr order book; secures €20.5m order and plans ₹45cr capex
filings.summary: HLE Glascoat reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹346.7 crore and a 15% YoY rise in PAT to ₹16.0 crore. The consolidated order book jumped 64% QoQ to a record ₹1,087.3 crore, boosted by a €20.56 million (approx. ₹185 crore) contract won by its German subsidiary. The company also announced a ₹42-45 crore capex to manufacture heavy engineering products in Gujarat.
filings.impactWhy: Order win of ₹185cr represents over 13% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Subsidiary approves ₹2,320cr capex for battery capacity expansion
filings.summary: The company's wholly owned subsidiary has approved a ₹2,320 crore capex to increase battery pack capacity from 4 GWh to 9 GWh and build a new LFP cell plant in Telangana. This major investment equals about 16% of the company's yearly sales and will be completed within 30 months. The board also declared an interim dividend of ₹4.30 per share.
filings.impactWhy: Capex approval announcement rather than commissioning or commercial production.

filings.headline: Approved ₹2,320cr capex to expand cell and battery capacity
filings.summary: The company's wholly-owned subsidiary approved a ₹2,320 crore capital expenditure to increase battery pack capacity from 4 GWh to 9 GWh and set up an LFP cell plant in Telangana. The project will be completed within 30 months and funded through a mix of debt and equity. The board also declared an interim dividend of ₹4.30 per share.
filings.impactWhy: Duplicate capex approval announcement.

filings.headline: Commissioned 19,642 MTPA Besan manufacturing unit at Nagpur facility
filings.summary: The company commissioned a new Besan manufacturing unit at its existing Nagpur facility with an installed capacity of 19,642 MTPA to strengthen backward integration and reduce transportation costs. Additionally, it received a final insurance claim of ₹36.4 crore for the Rajkot fire incident, bringing its total aggregate recovery to ₹77.4 crore. For Q2 FY27, the company reported revenue of ₹461.5 crore, up 22.9% year-on-year.
filings.impactWhy: Routine backward-integration capacity commissioning.

filings.headline: October sales bookings at ₹107cr; YTM hits ₹1,299cr
filings.summary: Ashiana Housing reported area booked of 1.23 lakh sq. ft. in October 2026, valued at ₹107.21 crore. This monthly booking represents about 11% of the company's last 12 months' revenue, taking the year-to-month booking value to a strong ₹1,299.24 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Monthly sales bookings update without record designation.

filings.headline: Promoter to sell up to 5.89% (₹691cr) via OFS at ₹240 floor price
filings.summary: Promoter Anand Kamalnayan Pandit is proposing to sell up to 4.87% of the company's shares (2.37 crore shares) with an oversubscription option for another 1.02% (50 lakh shares), totaling 5.89%. The Offer for Sale (OFS) has a floor price of ₹240, a slight discount to the current market price of ₹248.03, and could raise up to ₹691 crore if fully exercised. The sale is being undertaken to achieve the minimum public shareholding requirements.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter selling up to 5.89% stake via OFS.

filings.headline: Ponneri plant capacity to expand from 40,000 to 60,000 TPA by Jan 2027
filings.summary: Nelcast has installed an additional furnace at its Ponneri Plant to increase production capacity from 40,000 to 60,000 tonnes per annum. The company is currently awaiting enhancement of its sanctioned power supply to commission the new furnace. The expanded capacity is expected to be available for production from January 2027.
filings.impactWhy: Capacity expansion not yet commissioned.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue grows 24% to ₹969cr; five novel antibiotics complete Phase 3
filings.summary: Wockhardt reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹969cr, up 24% year-on-year, with a net profit of ₹73cr and EBITDA of ₹165cr. The growth was driven by a 52% jump in the Emerging Markets business and strong biotech operations. The company also announced that five of its novel antibiotics have successfully completed Phase 3 clinical trials.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly results and Phase 3 completion without commercial drug launch.

filings.headline: Wins ₹324cr wagon orders from GATX and Chetak
filings.summary: Jupiter Wagons has secured orders worth ₹324 crore to manufacture and supply 15 rakes of ACT2 Wagons. The orders include ₹215 crore from GATX India and ₹109 crore from Chetak International. The total order value represents about 10.4% of the company's trailing 12-month sales.
filings.impactWhy: Order wins worth ₹324cr exceed 10% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Board approves ₹45cr capex for a new manufacturing unit
filings.summary: The board has approved a capital expenditure of up to ₹45 crore to establish a new manufacturing unit in Anand, Gujarat. The new facility will produce heavy engineering and allied products, representing a growth investment equal to about 3.3% of yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Board capex approval representing only 3.3% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Shareholders reject resolution on related-party loans by subsidiaries
filings.summary: Shareholders rejected an ordinary resolution to approve limits for granting loans to related parties by the company's wholly owned subsidiaries. With promoters abstaining as interested parties, 66.08% of the public votes polled were against the proposal, including 99.04% of institutional votes.
filings.impactWhy: Shareholder rejection of internal related-party subsidiary lending limits.

filings.headline: Long-term credit rating upgraded to ICRA A (Stable)
filings.summary: ICRA has assigned a rating of ICRA A (Stable) for the company's long-term bank facilities and ICRA A2+ for short-term facilities, covering a total amount of ₹630 crore. This represents a one-notch upgrade from the previous long-term rating of CARE A- (Stable).
filings.impactWhy: Credit rating upgraded to ICRA A (Stable).

filings.headline: Auditor flags tax demand and ₹10.27cr deposit after IT search assessment
filings.summary: The independent auditor's review report highlighted an income tax demand for AY 2017-18 to 2023-24 following search assessment proceedings for alleged undisclosed income. The company is appealing the order with the ITAT and has deposited ₹10.27 crore (Rs 102.77 million) under protest.
filings.impactWhy: Routine auditor emphasis of matter regarding disputed tax proceedings.

filings.headline: Subsidiary KPL buys remaining 16.67% in two step-down entities for ₹52.5cr
filings.summary: Kalpataru Properties (a wholly-owned subsidiary) will acquire the remaining 16.67% stakes in step-down subsidiaries Agile Real Estate and Agile Real Estate Dev for ₹52.5 crore in cash. The acquisition makes the two entities wholly-owned, entitling the company to 100% of the cash flows from the Kalpataru Parkcity project in Thane.
filings.impactWhy: Small step-down subsidiary buyout valued at ₹52.5 crore.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 results: PAT hits ₹11.8cr vs ₹28.6cr loss YoY; revenue up 9%
filings.summary: One MobiKwik Systems reported its highest-ever quarterly PAT of ₹11.8 crore for Q2 FY27, swinging from a loss of ₹28.6 crore a year earlier. Revenue from operations grew 9% YoY to ₹295.7 crore, and EBITDA improved to ₹22.7 crore from a loss of ₹6.4 crore. Platform GMV reached an all-time quarterly high of ₹59,677 crore, up 35% YoY.
filings.impactWhy: Achieved all-time quarterly high GMV and record quarterly PAT.

filings.headline: Commercial production begins at new Hoshiarpur plywood unit
filings.summary: Century Plyboards has successfully started commercial production at its newly set-up plywood manufacturing unit in Hoshiarpur, Punjab. Operations at the facility commenced on November 2, 2026.
filings.impactWhy: Commercial production at unit without indication of company-altering scale.

filings.headline: Highest-ever monthly net turnover of ₹647cr in Oct 2026, up 55.6% YoY
filings.summary: Steel Strips Wheels reported its highest-ever monthly net sales turnover of ₹647.05 crore for October 2026, rising 55.6% year-on-year. Gross turnover surged 56.7% to ₹753.65 crore, driven by record sales in the aluminium and commercial vehicle segments as well as a 179% jump in export value.
filings.impactWhy: Reported highest-ever monthly net turnover, up 55.6% YoY.

filings.headline: Declared lowest bidder for ₹71.35cr signaling contract from SECR
filings.summary: E To E Transportation Infrastructure has been declared the lowest bidder (L1) by South East Central Railway for a signaling and electronic interlocking works contract. The project is valued at ₹71.35 crore and is to be executed within 9 months. This is a highly significant order, equating to about 17% of the company's current market value.
filings.impactWhy: L1 status on railway contract with no yearly sales baseline provided.

filings.headline: Allotted 37.03cr partly paid shares in rights issue at ₹27
filings.summary: Ola Electric has allotted 37.03 crore partly paid-up equity shares through a rights issue at an issue price of ₹27 each, compared to the current share price of ₹34.59. Subscribers paid ₹16.20 per share on application, with the balance due on a final call. The allotment adds 8.0% more shares to the company's existing base, resulting in a 7.4% dilution to existing shareholders.
filings.impactWhy: Rights issue allotment results in 7.4% equity dilution at a discount.

filings.headline: Q2 revenue up 46%; highlights include Citelum acquisition and ₹296cr EPC orders
filings.summary: The company reported a 46% year-on-year increase in Q2 revenue to ₹414.4 crore, with PAT up 42% to ₹18.6 crore. Key H1 business highlights include the 100% acquisition of Citelum India with a planned investment of ~₹100 crore, and winning a ~₹296 crore share in two sewage treatment EPC orders (about 20% of yearly sales).
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results and recap of previously initiated corporate actions.

filings.headline: Seeks shareholder approval to amend main business objects and shift registered office
filings.summary: Goodluck India has issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval to amend the main object clause of its Memorandum of Association. The company is also seeking approval to shift its registered office from Delhi to Uttarakhand.
filings.impactWhy: Routine administrative changes to memorandum objects and registered office location.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue grows 51% YoY to ₹271cr, PAT surges to ₹22cr
filings.summary: Capillary Technologies announced its Q2 FY27 results, reporting a 51% YoY increase in operating revenue to ₹271.35 crore. PAT jumped to ₹21.92 crore from ₹0.29 crore a year earlier, and adjusted EBITDA grew 103% to ₹44.86 crore. The growth was driven by new enterprise contract wins and the recent acquisition of SessionM.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly earnings results without declared record milestones or new guidance.

filings.headline: Q2 total income at ₹404cr; net profit ₹94cr aided by exceptional item
filings.summary: Puravankara reported Q2 FY27 standalone total income of ₹404.46 crore, up from ₹349.23 crore a year ago. The company posted a net profit of ₹94.31 crore, compared to a net loss of ₹36.21 crore in the same quarter last year, boosted by an exceptional item of ₹144.99 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results

filings.headline: Q2 consolidated net profit falls 38% YoY to ₹200cr despite 49% revenue growth
filings.summary: GSFC reported its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations increased by 49% year-on-year to ₹4,740.94 crore from ₹3,187.37 crore. However, consolidated net profit declined 38% year-on-year to ₹200.24 crore from ₹324.11 crore, driven by a sharp increase in the cost of raw materials and lower profit margins across both fertilizer and industrial product segments.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly financial results

filings.headline: Q2 revenue jumps 99% to ₹345cr; order book reaches ₹1,376cr
filings.summary: Zen Technologies reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹345.13 crore for Q2 FY27, up 98.8% year-on-year, with a net profit of ₹89.54 crore. Order inflow during the quarter was ₹481.81 crore, taking the total order book to a robust ₹1,375.70 crore, representing over twice the company's trailing 12-month sales.
filings.impactWhy: Reported highest-ever quarterly revenue, surging 99% year-on-year.

filings.headline: Unit III expansion completed; Australian OTC supply contract renewed for AUD 30m
filings.summary: Sai Parenterals completed its Unit III expansion, increasing production capacity by 81% from 85.5 to 155 million units a month. Its subsidiary Noumed also renewed a three-year Australian OTC supply agreement valued at AUD 30 million (₹204 crore), bringing total contracted supply to AUD 232 million (₹1,506 crore). Furthermore, the company completed the acquisition of 60% stakes in Saicriti Pharma and Prathyak Laboratories using ₹98.8 crore of IPO proceeds.
filings.impactWhy: Capacity expansion and contract renewal over multi-year period.

filings.headline: To acquire Perion Network for ~$420 million in an all-cash transaction
filings.summary: Affle 3i will acquire all outstanding shares of Israel-based Perion Network for US$ 11.70 per share, implying an equity value of ~$420 million. The all-cash deal will be funded through committed bank financing and available cash resources. The transaction is expected to close in early 2027, making Perion a wholly-owned subsidiary.
filings.impactWhy: Transformational ~$420 million all-cash acquisition exceeding yearly sales.

filings.headline: Doubled capacity at KIMS Saveera Hospital to 500 beds
filings.summary: The company's subsidiary has expanded the bed capacity at KIMS Saveera Hospital in Anantapur from 250 to 500 beds. The newly inaugurated facilities feature an advanced Oncology Block and a dedicated Mother and Child Block.
filings.impactWhy: Routine 250-bed expansion at a regional hospital.

filings.headline: October total sales decline 24.5% YoY to 3,519 units
filings.summary: VST Tillers Tractors reported a 24.5% year-on-year drop in total sales for October 2026, falling to 3,519 units from 4,664 units last year. Power tiller sales decreased to 3,114 units, while tractor sales dropped to 405 units. Despite the monthly decline, year-to-date total sales remain slightly higher at 33,103 units.
filings.impactWhy: Sharply lower monthly sales volumes down 24.5% YoY.

filings.headline: Promoter group bought 0.34% (₹15.3cr) at about ₹362
filings.summary: Promoter group member Vintex Tools & Machineries Private Limited bought 0.34% of the company (4,23,000 shares) for ₹15.3 crore, increasing its holding from 4.0% to 4.3%. The open-market purchase was made at an average price of ₹362 per share, which is slightly above the current price of ₹354.
filings.impactWhy: Promoter group purchased 0.34% stake in the company.

filings.headline: Raised FY27 revenue guidance to ₹3,300-3,500cr and doubled BESS capacity
filings.summary: The company reported H1 FY27 order inflows of ₹2,437 crore, taking its executable order book to ₹10,735 crore (nearly four times its yearly sales). It doubled operational BESS manufacturing capacity to 5 GWh and consequently raised its FY27 revenue guidance from ₹3,200-3,400 crore to ₹3,300-3,500 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Raised FY27 revenue guidance and doubled BESS manufacturing capacity.

filings.headline: Board approves early redemption of ₹200cr NCDs
filings.summary: The board has approved the voluntary early redemption in full of outstanding non-convertible debentures aggregating to ₹200 crore. It also cleared material related-party transactions with a step-down subsidiary, including corporate guarantees up to ₹500 crore, subject to shareholder approval.
filings.impactWhy: Early debenture redemption and subsidiary guarantee approvals.

filings.headline: Commenced operations at new manufacturing facilities in Sangli and Türkiye
filings.summary: The company commenced manufacturing operations at its new Global Coil Factory in Sangli and a Power Conversion Systems facility in Türkiye in October 2026. The earnings release also highlighted a strong consolidated order book of ₹2,010 crore, which is twice the trailing twelve-month sales.
filings.impactWhy: Routine commencement of manufacturing facilities.

filings.headline: Seeks nod for major related-party deals and ₹200cr NCD early redemption
filings.summary: Neogen Chemicals is seeking shareholder approval for related-party transactions with its step-down subsidiary, Neogen Morita, including up to ₹500 crore in corporate guarantees and ₹1,000 crore in goods trading. The board also approved the premature voluntary redemption of ₹200 crore in non-convertible debentures. The proposed related-party deal limits are large compared to the company's yearly sales of ₹926 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Shareholder approval sought for related-party transactions and debenture redemption.

filings.headline: Board approves ₹500cr guarantee to step-down subsidiary, ₹200cr NCD early redemption
filings.summary: The board approved a ₹500 crore corporate guarantee for step-down subsidiary Neogen Morita New Materials Limited. It also cleared material related-party transactions between subsidiaries, including up to ₹500 crore each for the sale and purchase of goods. Additionally, the company announced the premature full redemption of ₹200 crore in non-convertible debentures.
filings.impactWhy: Subsidiary corporate guarantee and debenture redemption approval.

filings.headline: Acquires remaining 60% stake in Monte South from Adani Group for ₹335cr
filings.summary: The board of Marathon Nextgen Realty has approved the acquisition of Adani Group's 60% stake in the Monte South project for approximately ₹335 crore. This transaction will increase the company's ownership in the Byculla mixed-use development from 40% to 100%. The acquisition size is highly significant, equating to roughly 59% of the company's annual sales.
filings.impactWhy: Substantial acquisition valued at roughly 59% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Christoph Stoller replaces Amrut Naik as Head of International Markets
filings.summary: Zydus Lifesciences announced the resignation of Dr. Amrut Naik as President and Business Unit Head of International Markets, effective November 7, 2026. Mr. Christoph Stoller, an industry veteran formerly with Glenmark and Teva Pharmaceuticals, has been appointed to the role starting November 2, 2026.
filings.impactWhy: Exit and appointment of business unit head, not CEO/CFO/MD.

filings.headline: Appellate order vacates ₹45.63 crore income tax demand
filings.summary: SMS Pharmaceuticals has successfully appealed an income tax assessment order for the assessment year 2023-24. As a result, an outstanding tax demand of ₹45.63 crore, representing about 5% of yearly sales, has been completely vacated.
filings.impactWhy: Vacated tax demand represents only about 5% of yearly sales.

filings.headline: Subsidiary approves ₹193.58cr capex for new manufacturing facility
filings.summary: Wholly-owned subsidiary AE Components Pvt Ltd has approved a capital expenditure of ₹193.58 crore to set up a new manufacturing plant for transformer tanks and radiators. The project aims at backward integration, targets completion within one year, and represents a notable investment at nearly 10% of the company's annual sales.
filings.impactWhy: Subsidiary capex approval for backward integration.

filings.headline: Won eight new orders totaling ₹1,862cr
filings.summary: NCC has received eight new orders totaling ₹1,862.45 crore (excluding GST) during October 2026 across its water, buildings, and transportation divisions. This is in addition to a previously announced ₹1,286 crore order, with the new wins alone amounting to about 8.7% of the company's yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Order wins aggregate to under 10% of annual sales.

filings.headline: Q2 PAT jumps 96% to ₹511cr; commissions new capacities
filings.summary: Shyam Metalics reported a 96.2% YoY jump in Q2 PAT to ₹511 crore, with revenue rising 33.4% to ₹5,960 crore. The company commissioned a 1.5 MTPA beneficiation plant and 18,000 TPA of aluminium foil capacity at its Sambalpur facility. It also announced the acquisition of a 51% stake in Alom Solar for ₹183.6 crore to secure a captive coal block.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly earnings results and routine operational capacity commissioning.

filings.headline: Dhule fertilizer plant commissioned but awaits license for commercial production
filings.summary: Madhya Bharat Agro Products has successfully commissioned its DAP/NPK fertilizer plant at Dhule, Maharashtra. However, the start of commercial production has been postponed as the company awaits a requisite statutory license for raw materials, which is expected anytime.
filings.impactWhy: Plant commissioned but awaiting routine statutory raw material license.

filings.headline: Acquires 51% stake in coal mine SPV; plans ₹184cr initial capex
filings.summary: Shyam Metalics will acquire a 51% stake in Alom Solar Private Limited for a nominal ₹51,000 to secure mining rights for the Phutamura Coal Block, which holds estimated reserves of 170 million tonnes. As a strategic backward integration, the company will fund ₹183.6 crore of the ₹360 crore initial capex budget to develop the block for captive use.
filings.impactWhy: Acquisition size is immaterial relative to company's annual sales.

filings.headline: Income tax demand of ₹112.32cr for AY 2019-20
filings.summary: Bajaj Electricals has received an income tax assessment order for the 2019-20 assessment year imposing a tax demand of ₹112.32 crore, including interest. This demand is significant at roughly 2.5% of the company's yearly sales. The company plans to pursue legal remedies, noting the assessing officer did not grant credit for taxes already paid.
filings.impactWhy: Tax demand is relatively small at 2.5% of sales.

filings.headline: Forensic audit confirms €3.04 million payment-diversion fraud at subsidiary
filings.summary: KPMG's forensic audit confirmed a payment-diversion fraud at step-down subsidiary Session M Czech Republic totaling €3.04 million. External parties impersonated a senior executive and an outside lawyer to divert funds, with no internal system compromise or employee involvement found.
filings.impactWhy: Forensic audit confirms previously known cyber fraud incident.

filings.headline: Cyber fraud diverts €3.04m at Czech subsidiary; KPMG audit clears systems
filings.summary: Capillary Technologies disclosed a KPMG forensic audit report concerning a payment-diversion fraud at its Czech step-down subsidiary. The capex will be funded through internal accruals and external borrowings.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue up 12% YoY to ₹402.6cr; enters BESS segment with 150MW order
filings.summary: GK Energy reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹402.6 crore, up 12.3% year-on-year, with a net profit of ₹49.3 crore. The company highlighted its entry into the Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) segment with a first order for 150 MW / 300 MWh, and reported a total order book of ₹788 crore.
filings.impactWhy: Routine quarterly earnings and segment entry without contract value specified.

filings.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 57% YoY to ₹1,538cr; PAT stood at ₹68cr
filings.summary: Shadowfax announced its Q2 FY27 results, reporting its highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹1,538 crore, up 56.6% YoY. Net profit for the quarter stood at ₹68 crore, a 422% increase YoY, while the adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 5.0%.
filings.impactWhy: Reported highest-ever quarterly revenue alongside sharp profit growth.

filings.headline: Plans ₹43cr capacity expansion across three subsidiaries

The project is expected to be completed by March 2027 and represents an investment equal to about 6% of the company's yearly sales.
filings.impactWhy: Capacity expansion capex represents only 6% of sales.

filings.headline: Approved ₹148cr greenfield facility for stainless steel pipes

The project will add an initial capacity of 14,400 MTPA, funded by ₹100 crore in debt and the rest via internal accruals, with completion expected by March 2028.
filings.impactWhy: Routine greenfield capex approval for future expansion.

filings.headline: Received ₹412cr additional order from Ministry of Railways for 1,020 wagons
filings.summary: Texmaco Rail has received an amendment to its contract with the Ministry of Railways, increasing the order by 1,020 BOXNS wagons. The additional order is valued at ₹412.32 crore, bringing the total contract value to ₹1,786.74 crore, to be executed by June 2027. At nearly 10% of trailing yearly sales, this is a material addition to the company's order book.

filings.headline: New UHV transformer manufacturing facility commences operations
filings.summary: The company announced that its new state-of-the-art Ultra High Voltage (UHV) Transformer manufacturing facility at Vadodara commenced operations on October 1, 2023. This marks a new capacity addition for the company's transformer business.
filings.impactWhy: Commercial operations announcement lacks details showing large scale.

It will be funded by ₹1,000 million in debt and the rest via internal accruals, with completion expected by March 2028.
filings.impactWhy: Routine capex approval for future greenfield manufacturing plant.

filings.headline: Sold residential apartments in New Delhi for approx ₹5,191cr via e-auction
filings.summary: NBCC has successfully concluded an e-auction to sell approximately 8.80 lakh sq. ft. of residential apartments at Avenue Towers in New Delhi for a total value of about ₹5,191 crores. The company will earn a marketing fee of 1% on the sale value, amounting to approximately ₹51.91 crores.
filings.impactWhy: NBCC earns only a 1% marketing fee on the sale.

filings.headline: Wins ₹688cr highway construction order from NHAI
filings.summary: Dilip Buildcon has received a Letter of Award from the National Highways Authority of India for constructing an elevated corridor in Solapur, Maharashtra, on a Hybrid Annuity Mode. The order is worth ₹688.23 crore (excluding GST), representing about 7.9% of the company's yearly sales, and is to be executed over 24 months.
filings.impactWhy: Order win is 7.9% of annual sales, below 10% threshold.

filings.headline: Secures ₹1,140cr wagon order from the Ministry of Railways
filings.summary: Jupiter Wagons has secured a contract worth ₹1,140 crore from the Ministry of Railways to manufacture and supply 2,583 wagons. This significant order represents roughly 36% of the company's last 12 months' sales. Management also expects incremental order inflows of approximately ₹2,000 crore in the next quarter.
filings.impactWhy: Order win represents approximately 36% of annual sales.

filings.headline: Q2 PAT doubles YoY to ₹125cr; AUM grows 68% to ₹9,317cr
filings.summary: OnEMI Technology reported strong Q2FY27 financial results, with Profit After Tax jumping 100% YoY to ₹125 crore. Assets Under Management grew 68% YoY to ₹9,317 crore, supported by a recent credit rating upgrade to A/Stable by Acuite Ratings.
filings.impactWhy: Quarterly financial results without record metrics.

filings.headline: Contract extended by 4 years, adding $180 million revenue potential
